Qualifications:

Exigences essentielles

  • Expérience à titre de gestionnaire de produit ou de gestionnaire principal·e de produit dans un environnement complexe et dynamique

  • Solide jugement produit et capacité à prendre des décisions avec une information limitée

  • Expérience de collaboration étroite avec des équipes d’ingénierie et de données / IA

  • Aisance technique avec les concepts en IA / apprentissage automatique (LLM, conception de prompts, systèmes basés sur des agents)

  • Excellentes aptitudes en communication et en gestion des parties prenantes

Atouts

  • Expérience en développement clinique, en santé ou dans des environnements réglementés

  • Expérience pratique avec l’IA générative ou agentique (projets professionnels ou personnels)

  • Connaissance de cadres d’IA agentique (ex. : LangChain, AutoGen, CrewAI)

  • Expérience avec des plateformes d’IA infonuagiques (Azure, AWS, Snowflake)

At IQVIA™, we are continuously expanding the boundaries of what’s possible in clinical development through advanced analytics, cutting edge technology, and deep scientific expertise. Within IQVIA’s AI and Technology Solutions (ATS) organization, we are investing in agentic AI systems—autonomous agents that can reason, plan, and act—to streamline clinical trial workflows and deliver meaningful operational impact. Our agentic AI portfolio has grown significantly, with multiple funded initiatives aimed at improving speed, quality, and efficiency across clinical operations.

We are seeking a Senior Product Manager to lead the strategy and execution of early stage, AI native initiatives focused on applying Generative and Agentic AI to clinical trial workflows. These initiatives range from rapid prototypes to scaled solutions and require strong product judgment to evaluate, prioritize, and mature.

This is a hands-on product leadership role that blends strategy, stakeholder engagement, and execution. You will work closely with AI, engineering, and clinical stakeholders to move quickly from concept to value—operating comfortably in ambiguity and fast moving environments.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Define product vision and roadmaps for agentic AI initiatives supporting clinical operations
  • Lead multiple early-stage investments in parallel, guiding rapid experimentation and scaling decisions
  • Partner with clinical and operational leaders to identify high value use cases and drive adoption
  • Translate business and user needs into clear product requirements and delivery priorities
  • Work closely with AI and engineering teams in an agile, highly collaborative model
  • Define and track OKRs tied to trial speed, quality, and cost efficiency

Qualifications:

Must Haves

  • Experience as a Product Manager or Senior Product Manager in a complex, fast paced environment
  • Strong product judgment and ability to operate with limited information
  • Experience working closely with engineering and data/AI teams
  • Technical fluency in AI/ML concepts (LLMs, retrieval-based systems, agent architectures, evaluation approaches, and human-in-the-loop workflows).
  • Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills
  • Demonstrated ability to lead cross-functional initiatives from concept through delivery
  • Experience defining product strategy and shaping new product opportunities in ambiguous environments.

Bonus Points

  • Experience in clinical development, healthcare, or regulated industries
  • Experience leading platform products or shared capabilities.
  • Experience redesigning operational workflows or business processes.
  • Experience working in modern AI product development environments and agile delivery models.
  • Hands on exposure to Generative or Agentic AI
  • Familiarity with agent architectures and AI orchestration patterns
  • Experience with cloud native AI platforms (Azure, AWS, Snowflake)

This is a remote position.

We are seeking a very hands-on GenAI Architect to take sole architectural ownership of a live, commercially deployed agentic product. A global consumer brand has already launched a GenAI-powered front-end agent in the UK, enabling customers to discover and explore products through natural language conversation. The platform is now entering a rapid multi-market roll-out: Germany first, then the Czech Republic, then Romania, with Poland and other markets running in parallel.This is a backfill in a formed, functioning squad - the product is in production and the delivery rhythm is established. You are joining to strengthen the team, not to rebuild it.
About the role:
You will be embedded in the development team, and your job is to stay ahead of it. New feature requirements arrive incomplete: you are the person who discovers the unknowns inside them, identifies where the technology risk actually sits, and resolves both before they turn into development issues mid-sprint.
You prove your designs rather than presenting them. Architectural decisions here are validated by delivering a working proof of concept, which the development team then takes forward to full implementation. The measure of success is simple: developers move faster because you were there first.
Tech stack:
  • Python, LangChain for LLM orchestration, LangGraph, LangSmith
  • AWS Bedrock for model access (Anthropic among the providers), with Bedrock Knowledge Bases and Bedrock Guardrails
  • AWS: ECS, Lambda, S3, API Gateway, DynamoDB, Cognito, EventBridge, WAF
  • Twilio (telephony, in production)
  • MCP and Agent-to-Agent integrations
What you'll be doing:
  • Owning the AI architecture underpinning the multi-market roll-out;
  • Discovering the unknowns in new feature requirements — surfacing ambiguity, hidden assumptions, and unstated constraints before implementation starts;
  • Identifying and mitigating technology risks early, well before they surface as development problems;
  • Proving designs by building proofs of concept, and handing them to the development team as the basis for full implementation;
  • Shaping the evaluation and observability architecture for the agentic system — this is a new area of the solution, and you will be expected to bring options and a point of view rather than inherit a design;
  • Designing and iterating on multi-agent architectures, and defining integration standards for MCP servers and agent-to-agent communication;
  • Working with the senior technical lead in Poland and the development team in India, supporting implementation day to day;
  • Collaborating with the data and domain architects on the wider programme to deliver joined-up solution designs;
  • Working closely with the Business Analyst to validate business designs and provide technical feedback;
  • Advising on prompt engineering strategy, tool use design, and agent reliability across multiple languages and markets.

Requirements

  • Advanced, production-level experience with LangChain, LangGraph, and LangSmith in Python;
  • Hands-on experience implementing Model Context Protocol (MCP) and Agent-to-Agent (A2A) integrations;
  • Solid experience with AWS, ideally including Bedrock, and comfort designing within a serverless and container-based AWS estate;
  • A genuinely hands-on approach — you build the proof of concept yourself rather than delegating it;
  • A considered view on GenAI evaluation and observability, and the ability to argue for an architectural approach in front of technical stakeholders;
  • Proven ability to work with under-specified requirements: extracting the real need from stakeholders and making defensible decisions under uncertainty;
  • Sound judgement in technology selection, with a track record of de-risking choices early rather than discovering problems in development;
  • Ability to work effectively with a distributed, cross-timezone team and to communicate designs clearly to mid-level and junior engineers;
  • Strong communication skills — able to translate complex AI concepts for technical and non-technical stakeholders;
  • English proficiency at B2 level or above.
Nice to have:
  • Experience with telephony and call centre applications, particularly Twilio and voice/AI integration patterns;
  • Experience scaling an AI product across multiple languages or markets;
  • Background in enterprise AI platform architecture.

Founded in 2018, we give banks and financial institutions one platform, nCore, to issue cards, move money, lend, settle, and manage financial crime as a single system, not separate vendors stitched together. nCore is AI-native and built on a real-time data core, so every product runs on one shared view of the customer.

We're a team of 180+ with a high bar. AI isn't a department here, it's how every team works, and we back decisions with data, not opinion. The way we work has a name, BOLD: we build trust through transparency, we own outcomes rather than tasks, we lead with speed because in payments a delay is a real cost, and we deliver excellence as a habit. If you want real ownership and room to move fast, this is the team for you.

The Role

As a Senior Backend Engineer at NymCard, you will play a key role in designing and implementing high-volume, low-latency APIs, and working across teams to deliver scalable, secure solutions that power frictionless payments. You will engage with Engineering, DevOps and Product teams from design through production support, while building new features at scale and collaborating in a trustful, agile environment.

Responsibilities:

  • Design and implement high-volume, low-latency APIs.
  • Engage with Engineering, DevOps, Marketing teams throughout design, implementation, testing, deployment and production support.
  • Work with engineers across the company to build new features at large scale.
  • Enjoy team collaboration within a trustful culture.

Skills & Qualifications:

  • Minimum of 5+ years of software development experience working with distributed projects and technologies (Java).
  • Hands-on experience with team management/leadership.
  • Experience with any NoSQL/RDBMS (Mongo, SQL Server, Oracle, PostgreSQL etc.).
  • Awareness of application security principles including secure coding standards and practices.
  • Familiarity with various API design and architectural patterns (API Gateway, OpenAPI, REST).
  • Understanding fundamental design principles behind a scalable application.

Additional Skills:

  • Experience with stream-processing systems such as Apache Kafka, Amazon SQS, Google Cloud Pub/Sub.
  • Upper-intermediate (B2) or higher English level.
  • Agile enthusiast (Scrum) knowledge, estimation practices.

Would be a plus:

  • Experience in payments, ISO8583 message format.
  • Experience with HSM (Thales preferred).
  • Knowledge of PCI Compliance standards.
  • Knowledge of CI/CD.
  • Knowledge in Kubernetes.
  • Knowledge of Cloud (Google, AWS, Azure) and Docker.

This role is remote based in Ukraine.

Instacart has become a lifeline for millions of people, and we’re building the team to help push our shopping cart forward. If you’re ready to do the best work of your life, come join our table.

Instacart is a Flex First team

There’s no one-size fits all approach to how we do our best work. Overview

Instacart is seeking a Senior Manager to build, train, and lead our Technical Account Management (TAM) practice and own post-launch technical excellence for our premier Storefront Pro (SFP) product.

Storefront Pro is the market leader in e-commerce solutions for grocery, combining Instacart's enormous scaling abilities with best-in-class customer experiences, while bridging online and in-store commerce.

Over the past two years, SFP has grown explosively, launching triple digits of retailers ranging from local independent favorites to midsize players to multinational giants — totalling billions in revenue. You will own post-launch technical health and excellence across the entire SFP space, founding and scaling a tiered TAM organization to match the size and complexity of that portfolio.

About the Job

  • Hire, train, and develop the Technical Account Management team from the ground up, growing it through coaching and mentorship into a world-class practice
  • Define, develop, and refine the approach to platform health for SFP; identify and monitor key metrics and establish measurement as a foundational team practice

  • Serve as a senior escalation point for critical issues, communicating with retailer stakeholders at all levels — including C-suite — across a range of platform matters
  • Negotiate scope and responsibility boundaries with partners and internally, holding a principled line on what the TAM function owns versus Customer Success, Project Management, Technical Support, Solution Architecture, and Engineering
  • Initiate and operate internal cross-functional initiatives that drive continuous technical improvement in SFP's deployments and operation, and synthesize systemic patterns into product and engineering roadmap influence

About You

Minimum Qualifications

  • 10+ years of experience in technical account management, solutions engineering/architecture, technical consulting, or engineering, ideally in SaaS or platform environments

  • Outstanding communication and presentation skills, including experience liaising with VP-level and C-suite stakeholders on high-priority issues

  • Engineering depth at scale and speed: ability to analyze and diagnose complex platform integrations — REST APIs, authentication, ETL, message queues, async patterns, error handling and recovery — and drive improvements
  • Proven ability to balance proactive and reactive approaches to technical health, delivering on urgent needs without compromising long-term maintainability
  • Ability to thrive in a highly collaborative landscape, coordinating across many internal partners (project management, customer success, product management, engineering, solution architecture) to consistently deliver successful outcomes

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience founding or bootstrapping a TAM, professional services, or post-launch technical delivery function
  • Deep domain expertise in at least one area of enterprise architecture: loyalty, identity, payments, point of sale, or catalog
  • Understanding of the grocery retail or e-commerce ecosystem, including in-store operations and last-mile fulfillment

jobs.title: Solution Architect (Senior AI / Technical Lead)
jobs.excerpt: Bits In Glass (BIG) is a high-growth AI and automation consulting firm with offices across Canada, the United States, India, and the United Kingdom.
jobs.description:
Bits In Glass (BIG) is a high-growth AI and automation consulting firm with offices across Canada, the United States, India, and the United Kingdom. Our portfolio spans more than 10 leading technologies across AI, cloud, data, automation, and business applications.

Recognized globally as a Great Place to Work and the recipient of multiple partner excellence awards, BIG is built on collaboration, innovation, and delivering measurable business outcomes for enterprise clients. We are a team of experienced technology professionals who enjoy solving complex challenges, celebrating wins together, and helping customers modernize with confidence.

AN EXCITING OPPORTUNITY WITH BIG AND CONVENE AI

BIG is excited to be partnering with Convene AI, an AI-focused technology company developing innovative solutions that leverage artificial intelligence to solve real-world business challenges.

As part of this partnership, we are looking for talented professionals to join BIG and work directly on Convene AI projects and initiatives. You will initially be hired as an employee of Bits In Glass, while working closely with the Convene AI team and contributing to the development and growth of their AI solutions.

The role is expected to remain on BIG’s payroll for approximately 12–18 months, with the intention of transitioning to a permanent position directly with Convene AI following this period, subject to business requirements and transition arrangements.This is an exciting opportunity to contribute to an emerging AI organization at an important stage of its growth, while benefiting from the support, culture, and established consulting expertise of Bits In Glass.

ABOUT THE ROLE

This is the highest-leverage technical role at ConveneAI. Every architectural decision you make is inherited by multiple client engagements, and the accelerators and standards you build determine how fast the next pod moves.

The mandate has three parts. You shape engagements before they are sold, by assessing what is genuinely buildable in 8 to 12 weeks and saying so honestly.

You govern architecture across live pods, making the decisions a single embedded engineer should not make alone: model hosting, data residency, security posture, integration patterns. And you lead the technical craft, through design review, mentorship, and the reference architecture that every pod starts from.

You will remain hands-on. You will read code, prototype when it is faster than arguing, and stand in front of a bank's or an insurer's architecture review board and defend a design under real scrutiny. If you have drifted into slideware architecture, this will not suit you.

WHAT YOU'LL DO

Shaping and Pre-Sales

  • Join client conversations during the sales cycle to assess technical feasibility, and scope what can realistically reach production in 8 to 12 weeks.
  • Push back on requirements that cannot be delivered, before they become contractual commitments on a fixed-fee or outcome-based engagement.
  • Own the architecture decisions that determine engagement profitability: model selection, build versus buy, reuse of existing accelerators versus bespoke work, and hosting approach.
  • Write the technical sections of proposals and statements of work, and help the commercial team define outcome metrics that are measurable and defensible.
  • Represent ConveneAI in client architecture, security, and vendor review boards, and clear the technical path to a signed deal.

Architecture Governance Across Pods

  • Run architecture review at kickoff and at defined gates for every live engagement, and hold the gate when a design is not ready.
  • Make the calls that carry risk beyond one pod: data residency, private versus hosted inference, identity and access design, network isolation, and integration patterns with systems of record.
  • Unblock pods when they hit something outside their depth, by pairing and reviewing rather than taking the work away from them.
  • Own the technical escalation path when an engagement drifts off track, and give the Product Owner and leadership an unvarnished read.
  • Monitor inference cost, latency, and reliability across engagements, and intervene before an architecture choice erodes gross margin.

Platform, Standards and Reuse

  • Own the ConveneAI reference architecture and accelerator library, and decide what gets harvested from an engagement versus rebuilt properly for reuse.
  • Set the standards every pod inherits for agent design, evaluation, observability, security, and cost management.
  • Evaluate new models, frameworks, and tooling with rigour rather than enthusiasm, and decide what enters the standard stack and what does not.
  • Build the technical assets that let a four-person pod deliver what a fifteen-person team used to, because that gap is the entire commercial thesis.

Technical Leadership

  • Mentor GenAI Engineers and Data Engineers across pods through design and code review, and raise the technical ceiling of the delivery organisation.
  • Interview and calibrate technical hires, and help define the engineering career path as we scale from the first pods to many.
  • Work with senior AI architects across our global operating bench to keep standards consistent across geographies.

WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR

  • 10 or more years building and shipping enterprise software, including at least 2 years on production LLM or agentic systems that real users depended on.
  • A track record as the technical owner across multiple concurrent client engagements, not just one long programme.
  • Deep hands-on capability: Python, cloud architecture (AWS, Azure, or GCP), distributed systems, and API and integration design. You will still be expected to read and write code.
  • Production experience with agent architectures, retrieval at enterprise scale, evaluation, and the operational side of AI systems: cost per task, latency, observability, and failure modes.
  • Enterprise architecture fluency: identity and access, security posture, data residency, network isolation, and model hosting options, plus the experience to get a regulated client's review board to approve a design.
  • Commercial literacy. You understand how an architecture decision flows through to gross margin on a fixed-fee engagement, and you make decisions accordingly.
  • Credibility in both directions: with a client CIO or Chief Architect, and with an engineer who suspects you have stopped building.
  • The judgement and standing to recommend against a deal that cannot be delivered, and to hold that position under commercial pressure.
  • Legally entitled to work in Canada and willing to travel to client sites.

BONUS POINTS

  • Architecture leadership at a consultancy or systems integrator, or a Field CTO or principal architect role at an AI, data, or cloud platform vendor.
  • Depth in a regulated industry with named systems: policy administration and claims platforms such as Guidewire or Duck Creek, core banking, or clinical systems.
  • Self-hosted or open-weight model deployment, fine-tuning, distillation, and private inference architecture.
  • Experience building a reference architecture or accelerator library that other teams genuinely reused rather than ignored.
  • Experience scaling a delivery organisation from a handful of teams to many, and the operational scar tissue that comes with it.
  • Published writing, conference talks, or open-source work on applied AI architecture.

WHY JOIN CONVENEAI

  • Your decisions compound. Architecture set here is inherited by every engagement that follows, which is a rare amount of leverage.
  • You define the standard rather than inherit someone else's, at the point in the company's life when it actually gets set.
  • Genuine breadth: pre-sales shaping through production operations, across multiple industries, without the politics of a large firm.
  • Direct working relationship with the founders and with senior AI operators from BCG X, Infosys, Mu Sigma, and enterprise AI startups.
  • Meaningful equity at the stage where technical decisions determine whether the delivery model scales or stalls.

Millions of companies—from the world’s largest enterprises to the most ambitious startups—use Stripe to accept payments, grow revenue, and accelerate new business opportunities. Our mission is to increase the GDP of the internet, and we have a significant amount of work ahead. That means you have an opportunity to put the global economy within everyone’s reach while doing the most important work of your career.

About the team

The Performance and Talent Planning team is part of Stripe’s broader Talent and Development organization. We shape how Stripes grow their careers and do their best work.

We build the programs, systems, and insights that help managers develop strong teams, help leaders plan for the future, and give Stripes clear opportunities to grow. Our work spans performance, talent planning, career development, succession, and organizational insights. Our goal is to make Stripe a place where talented people can build lasting careers and have an outsized impact.

What you’ll do

In this role, you will help translate Stripe’s performance and talent philosophy into scalable, global experiences. You will work across People Products, People Insights, Employee Relations, People Partners and other partner teams to design programs and systems that are clear for users, operationally durable, and aligned with Stripe’s future needs. You will bring a product mindset to all you do, starting with data driven problem statements, qualitative and quantitative signals, an understanding of the end-to-end user experience, an iterative design process, and an obsession with continuous improvement over time. You will be comfortable operating across time zones and navigating competing perspectives, incomplete information, and urgent priorities.

A Day in the Life

You start your day by reviewing your agenda in Slack or asking your AI agent to summarize ongoing work and priorities. Energized by a mix of workstream meetings across People Products, Manager Enablement, and M&A Transitions, you check overnight updates from teammates across time zones. Colleagues in Dublin have shared feedback that keeps the launch plan moving, while teammates in Melbourne have raised thoughtful questions about how a new performance process will integrate into the existing reporting capabilities they rely on for annual talent planning.

These questions are exactly the kind of challenge you value. They push you to build with a user-first mindset, anticipate downstream impacts, and mitigate risks before they emerge. You draw on expertise from across the organization while balancing the responsibility of integrating global perspectives, designing seamless end-to-end experiences, and coordinating work across interconnected teams. A new question sparks a new connection, and you quickly identify another stakeholder who should be brought into the next phase of the program.

As the day progresses, updates from cross-functional partners show steady progress across multiple fronts, but one critical area stalls. Rather than waiting for next week's meeting, you escalate immediately to keep momentum high and de-risk the program timeline. You end the day energized by the complexity of the work, the curiosity and collaboration of your colleagues, and the opportunity to continue to build, solve, and innovate every day.

Responsibilities

  • Drive and scale Stripe’s performance philosophy and practices. Design and improve performance experiences that help Stripes understand expectations, grow through feedback, and make meaningful contributions.
  • Evolve performance and talent tooling. Partner with People Products and cross-functional stakeholders to translate program needs into scalable systems, processes, and user journeys.
  • Strengthen career growth and talent investment. Help shape the programs, mechanisms, and insights that enable career development, talent planning, succession, and thoughtful investment in Stripe’s people as the company grows.
  • Lead complex, cross-functional workstreams. Build alignment among global stakeholders; surface risks and dependencies early; make progress in ambiguous environments; and unblock critical decisions quickly.
  • Use insights to improve outcomes. Define clear problem statements, gather qualitative and quantitative data, and use those insights to refine strategy, programs, and execution.

Who you are

You are a systems thinker who can connect the details of a program or product experience to the broader organizational context. You are energized by ambiguity and complexity, and thrive in bringing just enough structure, clarity, and strong momentum to the work. You build trusted relationships, communicate directly and thoughtfully, and create accountability across teams, with speed.

Minimum requirements

  • 10+ years of experience building and scaling global People or HR experiences, with experience across both process and product or systems design
  • Experience leading complex programs in fast-paced, ambiguous environments where high ownership and cross-functional problem solving are expected.
  • Strong systems thinking: the ability to understand how people, processes, tools, policies, and organizational decisions influence one another over time and how to augment workflows and processes using AI tools.
  • A demonstrated ability to build enduring, trusted stakeholder relationships; communicate effectively across levels and functions; and establish clear decision-making and accountability mechanisms.
  • A disciplined approach to problem solving. You begin with the “why,” define and refine problem statements steeped in both quantitative and qualitative data, and continuously ask “is this the right problem to solve, at the right time?”
  • High agency and sound judgment. You identify opportunities or risks, take action quickly, and escalate thoughtfully when progress is blocked.
  • Deep alignment with Stripe’s Operating Principle, Obsess over Talent. You believe that people are one of Stripe’s greatest unlocks: attracting exceptional talent, creating environments where they can thrive, building systems that support growth, and recognizing meaningful contributions.
  • Curiosity and humility. You are a continuous learner who seeks to understand before acting, welcomes ideas from many sources, and is willing to change course when new evidence suggests a better path.

Preferred qualifications

  • 10+ years of experience across a diverse portfolio of People programs: talent management, organizational development, leadership and/or executive development, program and talent operations, and compensation and benefits
  • People product design and management experience in high growth environments with fast iterative cycles, changing priorities, and a steady stream of feature requests and backlog
  • Experience and excellence leading executive level talent discussions that influence People strategy, with humility, curiosity, and a grounded presence

jobs.description:
About DualEntry

Founded in 2024, DualEntry is one of the world’s fastest-growing AI startups.

At DualEntry, the future of finance is being written today. ERP is one of the largest fintech markets in the world ($220,000,000,000+). Yet, tens of thousands of companies are still using on-premise systems, and the industry has not seen new entrants in more than 30 years.

Our AI-native ERP lets accounting teams achieve more in less time. $5M-ARR businesses to NYSE-listed companies trust DualEntry to automate away manual data entry work with AI. We’re finally making the one-person finance team a reality and putting the pain of legacy ERPs from the 1990’s in the past.

We operate with urgency and ownership. We move fast.

Why This Role Matters Now

Since starting 18 months ago, we’ve raised $100,000,0000+ from world-class investors such as Lightspeed Venture Partners, Khosla Ventures, Contrary Ventures and Google Ventures, as well as more than 20 angel investors who’ve built, scaled, and exited some of the most impactful companies of the last decade.

We got there by moving incredibly fast and hiring an exceptionally sharp, hard-working and deeply committed team from leading tech and accounting companies — Ramp, Meta, Microsoft, Lyft, PwC, Deloitte, J.P. Morgan, Bloomberg, Sage, Xero and Intuit. And some of us don't have a fancy logo on our resume and are here for a shot to prove ourselves.

We’re a small team, growing fast with huge momentum - join early.

This is an intense, hands-on role with full ownership. We expect you to push for excellence and raise the bar.

Where you'll create impact

  • Own end-to-end execution for backend systems and infrastructure

  • Own secure connectivity with banks and partners by provisioning host-to-host connections (SFTP), managing endpoint setup, and handling SSH + PGP key exchange and rotations.

  • Implement and validate end-to-end payment and data pipelines — from ISO 20022 parsing/validation (PAIN, CAMT) to real-world bank testing (penny tests), reconciliation, and production readiness.

  • Lead integration projects across both banking and enterprise systems, defining scope, designing the integration approach, and driving delivery for domestic + international payment flows.

  • Build and maintain customer-facing integrations between DualEntry and third-party platforms (AP/AR tools, billing, CRM, payroll, data warehouses), ensuring data accuracy, reliability, and clean sync behavior.

  • Debug and resolve connectivity, payment, and statement issues by tracing through logs, monitoring/observability tools, file payloads, and database records.

  • Increase reliability and scale by reducing manual work: automate onboarding and integration playbooks, standardize test frameworks, and build maintainable backend tooling that keeps pipelines stable.

  • Drive measurable outcomes that accelerate DualEntry’s product velocity and stability

What sets you up for success

  • 8+ years building backend systems, ideally in high-growth, high-ownership environments where you ship fast and own outcomes end-to-end

  • Deep expertise in Python and modern backend frameworks (FastAPI/Flask/Django)

  • Strong database fundamentals: PostgreSQL, SQL, schema design, migrations, ORMs

  • Experience building production-grade APIs

  • Hands-on with cloud infrastructure (AWS preferred) and the full delivery lifecycle: CI/CD, deployments, monitoring and incidents

  • Experience in payments, fintech, or financial services is strongly preferred

  • Familiarity with payment rails and flows (SEPA, ACH, Wires, Faster Payments, CHAPS, Bacs) and payment messaging/file formats (PAIN, CAMT) is a plus.

  • Able to operate in messy, evolving requirements — you design systems that scale while staying pragmatic.

  • Clear communicator (C1+ English). You can collaborate with banks, customers, and teammates across time zones without things slipping.

  • Hardcore work ethic and high agency

  • Bonus: you’ve built bank integrations using H2H, SFTP or ISO 20022

Why you’ll thrive here

  • Significant equity ownership in one of the top AI companies in the world

  • You’re joining early and will grow with DualEntry

  • Your feedback shapes the product directly

  • High-speed culture

  • High-trust environment with high expectations

  • Ambitious mission - ERP is one of the largest B2B software markets in the world ($220bn per year), this is a once in a lifetime opportunity to build the next generation ERP in an industry that has not seen new entrants in 30+ years

📍 Location:Remote - this role is available across all countries with 4hr+ overlap for the US ET timezone (NYC HQ)

Benefits & Perks

  • Base Salary: $100K–$175K USD

  • Equity: ~$50K USD

  • Contract type: B2B

  • Remote-first team - the fastest team you will have ever worked with

  • Time Off: 15 PTO days + 12 public holidays

  • Visa sponsorship option for relocation to NYC within 2+ years

  • Early-stage role with high autonomy and real long-term upside

  • Enjoy a learning & development budget for courses, certifications, and language learning to keep growing your skills

  • Work where you feel most productive at co-working spaces or from your home office with support for setup, internet, and phone

  • Plus, wellness perks and more to make your workday even better!

We hire the best, expect the best, and give you the masterclass of your career - an archaic and huge industry like ERP only goes through a seismic shift like this once in a lifetime. It’s hard, it’s intense, and it’s the most rewarding work you’ll do this decade.

If you’re hungry, driven, and ready to build something massive, climb aboard!

At DualEntry, we believe great products come from diverse teams. We’re an equal opportunity employer, and we’re committed to a culture where everyone feels included, supported, and able to do their best work.

Job Title: General Manager, Surgery International

Job Location: Remote

Job Location Type: Remote

Job Contract Type: Full-time

Job Seniority Level:

Job Description Summary

Description:

The position of General Manager, International Surgery, is responsible for developing and executing marketing strategies focused on increasing performance for the Surgery business in the International Region. The International Region is comprised of the following geographies: Europe, Middle East, Africa, Russia, LatAm, Japan, AKA, India and South Asia. Key responsibilities for the role include a focus on offering development, channel strategy, strategic pricing and commercial execution, coordinating across product lines, services and solutions.

This role is responsible within the International Region for selling product(s), services, parts, solutions, or projects and for driving growth by working across P&L and regional marketing & sales teams. The General Manager will gather voice of the customer and provide customer input on product and solutions definitions and requirements. In addition, he/she will collaborate with relevant commercial and product marketing teams, Global Strategic Marketing, and Marketing Communications to develop innovative strategies for the modality.

As part of the International Imaging leadership team, the Modality General Manager defines the proper channels (Direct, Indirect, Digital, etc.), the “go to market” strategy for the region and the commercial intensity programs on which to focus. The segment manager is responsible for the quarterly and yearly Orders/Sales forecast for the region, the yearly region’s target setting and the achievements versus targets.

Description:

Le poste de General Manager International Surgery est chargé de développer et de mettre en œuvre les stratégies de marketing axées sur l'amélioration des performances dans la modalité Surgery. La région International comprend l’Europe, le Moyen-Orient, l'Afrique, la Russie, l'Amérique latine, le Japon, AKA, l'Inde et South Asia. Les responsabilités clés de ce rôle incluent le développement de l'offre, la stratégie des canaux de distribution, la tarification stratégique, l’exécution commerciale et la coordination à travers les lignes de produits, les services et les solutions.

Ce rôle est responsable, au sein de la Région International, de la vente de produits, services, pièces, solutions ou projets et de la stimulation de la croissance en travaillant avec les équipes de marketing et de vente P&L et régionales. Le/la General Manager recueillera la voix du client et fournira des retours sur les définitions et les exigences des produits et solutions. De plus, il/elle collaborera avec les équipes commerciales et de marketing des produits concernés, le Marketing Stratégique Global et les Communications Marketing pour développer des stratégies innovantes pour la modalité.

En tant que membre de l'équipe de direction de Imaging International, le/la General Manager de la Modalité définit les canaux de distribution appropriés (Direct, Indirect, Digital, etc.), la stratégie de vente pour la région et les programmes d'intensité commerciale sur lesquels se concentrer. le/la General Manager est chargé de la prévision trimestrielle et annuelle des commandes/ventes pour la région, de la définition des objectifs annuels de la région et des réalisations par rapport aux objectifs.

Job Description

Job Description

Key responsibilities include (but are not limited to):

oDeep domain knowledge in surgical and/or interventional products or adjacencies

oLeading and cultivating a culture of GE Values, Integrity & Teamwork values.

oManaging sales team across large global markets: Select, train and develop personnel to optimize effectiveness. Also, responsible for driving horizontal working across all segments of GE Healthcare to maximize commercial strength and growth opportunities.

oTogether with the Product and Marketing managers, elaborating growth strategies of the equipment and Services business.

oEnsuring optimal sales coverage in each region, reviewing sales teams’ performance with region’s sales managers and improve performances.

oWorking closely with the global product managers and pushing for product releases to support customer satisfaction, International market opportunities and growth potentials.

oAs a member of the International senior leadership team, ensuring seamless teamwork with the Equipment & Service operation’s teams and other channels to provide total customer satisfaction. Drive a culture of cross modality teamwork, driving product synergies and solutions to maximize sales for the P&L.

oDeploying resources to meet financial and operating objectives including orders, revenue, contribution margin, and base cost control.

oProactively identifies customer needs and develops and implements customer specific solutions.

oEnsure all direct reports have approved annual Goals & Objectives and receive an annual performance appraisal based on these goals & objectives

oDevelop and maintain in-depth knowledge and understanding of market trends and requirements in the modality

oInterpret internal and external business challenges and recommends best practices to improve products, processes or services. Utilizes understanding of industry trends to inform decision making process

oAbility to attract and retain talents

oCoordinate the ‘virtual’ cross-functional and cross-business team that will deliver on the strategic business and marketing priorities

oHelp to identify current unmet needs and take the lead role on portfolio management. Partner across functions to identify and evaluate the value of new commercial concepts and technologies

oDrive or participate in the development of the Growth Playbook and Marketing Blueprint for the modality

oAlign cross-business marketing resources around the modality priorities and ensure the delivering of a common messaging and a holistic value proposition for the customer

oDirect market research and analysis

oProvide input to the development of pricing strategies for existing and new products

oHelp to develop a strategy to address the modality market including:

§Defining the strategy for the growth (sales and profitability)

§Obtaining the input and buy in of key stakeholders within the P&L

§Driving the cross-functional and cross-organization delivery of the strategy and global marketing plans for the category

§Partnering with leadership and Business Development to identify new growth opportunities

oDeveloping commercial expertise across one or more countries, product lines, markets, sales processes, or customer groups. Influences policy and ensures delivery across large and/or diverse sales territories

oComplete all planned Quality & Compliance training within the defined deadlines

oKnowledge and understanding of all Global Privacy and Anti-Competition Policies (including but not limited to GE Healthcare HIPPA Guidelines, NEMA Regulations, etc.) and operates within them to ensure that no company policy or US / Int’l Law is broken.

oKnowledge and understanding of all Environmental Health Policies (including but not limited to GE Healthcare EHS Policies, GE Healthcare Fleet Rules, etc.) and operate within them to ensure that no company policy or US / Int’l Law is broken

oInterpréter les défis internes et externes des affaires et recommander les meilleures pratiques pour améliorer les produits, les processus ou les services. Utiliser la compréhension des tendances de l'industrie pour informer le processus de prise de décision.

oConduire ou participer au développement du Growth Playbook et du Marketing Blueprint pour la modalité.

oDiriger la recherche et l'analyse de marché.

oDéveloppement de l'expertise commerciale dans un ou plusieurs pays lignes de produits, marchés, processus de vente ou groupes de clients. Influence la politique et assure la livraison à travers des territoires de vente larges et/ou diversifiés

oConnaitre et et se conformer au Manuel de Qualité GEHC, au Système de Gestion de la Qualité, à la Politique de Gestion de la Qualité, aux Objectifs de Qualité, ainsi qu'aux lois et réglementations applicables à ce type de poste/position.

oIdentifier et signaler toute préoccupation relative à la qualité ou à la conformité et prendre des mesures correctives immédiates si nécessaire.

oResponsabilité de la qualité des commandes et des configurations dès leur saisie pour garantir la précision, l'intégrité de la configuration et que toutes les exigences soient liées aux entrées documentées des clients.

oFavoriser l'amélioration continue et la simplification de tous les processus, instructions de travail et procédures liés pour garantir une standardisation et simplification continues du Système de Gestion de la Qualité.

Qualifications:

oMinimum de 8 ans d'expérience en gestion des ventes incluant la vente stratégique et la négociation.

oFort acumen commercial et expérience dans le domaine du produit.

oDiplôme d‘études suppérieures.

Job Title:

Seasonal Honors Reviewer

Department:

Strategic Enrollment | Undergraduate Admissions

The Honors Application Reviewer in Undergraduate Admissions within Strategic Enrollment Management (SEM) provides a holistic evaluation source for domestic and international applications for acceptance into the Honors Program at The Ohio State University. Develops a thorough understanding of Ohio State’s Honors Program enrollment goals, policies and procedures and completes holistic review and evaluation of application credentials. Reads, reviews, and evaluates applications. The honors application reviewer is required to enter recommendations for completed reviews into the review site on a weekly basis. This review is based on extensive training, written guidelines, and best practices set forth by Strategic Enrollment Management, Undergraduate Admissions, and the University Honors and Scholar Center. Files are assigned weekly via an online secure review site. Once completed, recommendations are submitted electronically, and new files are assigned for the following week. Application reviewers are also required to attend and participate in mandatory monthly trainings and monthly individual coaching sessions, and other meetings as needed during normal university business hours. It is the reviewer's responsibility to remain up to date with procedural and guideline changes which might affect the review process provided by Undergraduate Admissions. Opportunities for professional development during the review season will be offered.

Throughout the review process, reviewers must ensure confidentiality and security of admission files and university materials. Requires a flexible work schedule averaging 14-18 hours per week with some weeks during January and February requiring up to 20 hours. Reviewers will conduct a holistic review on an average of 80 files a week with some weeks during January and February requiring additional files. Reviewers are compensated at an hourly rate. Candidates must commit to completing the needed files per week and attending all virtual required trainings and meetings. Reviewers will use University issued equipment.

This is a seasonal position which begins in early December and ends in mid-March.

Bachelor’s degree, preferably in counseling, human relations, or education. Reasonable knowledge of high school guidance or teaching experience.

This position requires successful completion of a background check.

Familiarity and knowledge with college/university policies and procedures, recruitment or admissions, or counseling practices at higher education institutions. 1 -2 years of relevant experience preferred.

This is a remote position with occasional opportunities to come in-person to the Columbus campus.

An OSU staff member may have multiple positions provided the sum-total of the positions does not exceed 100% full-time equivalency (FTE) and the position combination is consistent with the following principles:

We’re looking for people who are relentlessly curious and committed to continuous learning. AI is reshaping every function across our business, and we enable every team member, regardless of role or level, to build fluency in AI tools and concepts.   • Partner closely with engineering teams across SentinelOne to solve cross-functional problems, influence technical direction, and deliver solutions that scale.

  • We provide engineers with modern AI-powered tools to improve both engineering productivity and software quality.

  • 8+ years of professional backend software engineering experience with deep expertise in at least one of Java, Go, or Python, and the willingness to work across all three as needed.

Why SentinelOne?

AI is redefining how the world operates and rewriting the rules of security in real time, and SentinelOne was built for this moment. From day one, we architected an AI-native platform designed to operate at machine speed, not as an add-on to legacy systems but as the foundation itself. Bright Vision Technologies is a technology consulting and software development company delivering cloud, AI, data, and enterprise solutions across the United States.

Job Summary
We are seeking an experienced SAP Data Migration Consultant to design, execute, and support large-scale data migration initiatives within SAP S/4HANA environments. This role focuses on the full data migration lifecycle — extraction, transformation, validation, reconciliation, and cutover — to ensure accurate, complete, and compliant migration of enterprise data from legacy systems into SAP. The ideal candidate will combine strong hands-on experience with SAP LTMC, SLT, LVM, and S/4HANA migration tools with deep understanding of SAP data structures, business processes, and data governance, and will partner closely with functional teams, business owners, and infrastructure stakeholders during all phases of migration.
Key Responsibilities
  • Design and execute SAP data migration strategies for S/4HANA implementations, including conversion and greenfield scenarios.
  • Perform data extraction from legacy systems using SAP-provided and custom tools and prepare data for ingestion into SAP.
  • Configure and utilize SAP LTMC (Legacy Transfer Migration Cockpit), including custom migration objects where required.
  • Implement real-time replication scenarios using SAP SLT (System Landscape Transformation), including transformation rules and filter conditions.
  • Manage logical system setups and replication configurations for hybrid SAP environments.
  • Support system refreshes and landscape virtualization activities using SAP LVM (Landscape Virtualization Management).
  • Design and execute data transformation, cleansing, and enrichment processes prior to migration.
  • Develop comprehensive validation and reconciliation reports to ensure data accuracy and completeness.
  • Identify and resolve data inconsistencies, duplicates, and orphan records prior to go-live.
  • Support mock migrations, dress rehearsals, and the final cutover, including detailed runbook execution and rollback planning.
  • Optimize performance for large-volume data loads, including parallelization, package sizing, and database tuning.
  • Collaborate with functional teams to validate master and transactional data against business expectations.
  • Ensure compliance with enterprise data governance, audit, and privacy standards.
  • Maintain comprehensive, current technical documentation — including architecture diagrams, design decisions, configuration references, runbooks, and operational procedures — so that the system remains supportable, auditable, and easy to onboard new engineers onto over time.
Required Qualifications
  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related technical discipline.
  • Five or more years of SAP data migration experience.
  • Strong hands-on experience with SAP LTMC and S/4HANA migration tools.
  • Experience with SAP SLT replication scenarios.
  • Working knowledge of SAP LVM for system refresh and landscape management.
  • Strong understanding of SAP master and transactional data structures.
  • Experience performing data validation and reconciliation processes.
  • Strong SQL and data analysis skills.
  • Experience working in enterprise SAP landscapes during major implementations.
  • Strong troubleshooting and documentation skills.
Preferred Qualifications
  • Experience participating in S/4HANA greenfield or brownfield implementations.
  • Exposure to SAP Data Services or other ETL platforms.
  • Experience with high-volume, multi-source data migrations.
  • Working knowledge of SAP HANA database structures.
  • SAP S/4HANA certification.

About this role

GiveDirectly’s Emergency Cash team delivers rapid, technology-enabled cash assistance to people affected by crises. The Technical Program Manager (TPM), Emergency Cash will build, configure, and manage the technology used for those responses - including systems for data collection, verification, payments, and monitoring - and ensure they are reliable, replicable, and ready for rapid deployment.

In this role, you’ll translate emergency response needs into actionable technical requirements, coordinate cross-functional teams during activations, and strengthen our global readiness by improving tools and surfacing technical gaps to inform the product and technology roadmap.

The Emergency Cash team is a remote-first team built around trust, ownership, and flexibility. Because this role supports emergency responses, the TPM may need to provide surge capacity and work across multiple timezones during activations, in line with pre-established on-call schedules.

This position is ideal for someone who thrives in fast-moving, ambiguous environments, can bridge the gap between technical teams and field realities, and is motivated to redefine how humanitarian responses leverage technology.

Reports to: Senior Product Manager, Solutioning, Emergency Cash

Level: Manager

Travel Requirement: Up to 20% international travel for emergency deployments, field testing, partner coordination, and team retreats.

This recruitment is for two vacancies.

What You'll Do:

  1. Lead Technical Program Delivery for Emergency Responses:
    • Embed (remotely or on-site) with the emergency response team during activations to manage end-to-end technical program delivery - leading scoping, requirements gathering, system configuration and implementation, QA and testing, troubleshooting, and closeout.
    • Collaborate with Product, Tech, Research, Engineering, Data, Payments, and Programs teams to ensure systems are aligned with programmatic objectives and work seamlessly in field conditions.
    • Ensure all systems comply with GD’s standards for data protection, privacy, and financial controls.
    • Manage technical training and onboarding for surge staff, collaborators, and local partners.
  2. Strengthen Rapid Response Technical Readiness:
    • Maintain and improve technical documentation, deployment guides, and incident-response protocols to ensure consistency and speed in future responses.
    • Partner with Programs and Engineering to develop product roadmaps and requirements, and prioritize and implement improvements that enhance emergency response scalability and reliability.
    • Track and report on technical readiness metrics (e.g. uptime, deployment speed, integration failures, data quality, testing coverage).
    • Lead and document technical design and implementation retrospectives, lessons learned and root cause analyses after each response to drive continuous improvement and contribute to product development strategies.
    • Support technical assessments, evaluations, testing and adoption of new products and solutions that strengthen emergency response technical capabilities.
  3. Drive Safety,RiskManagement, and Systems Resilience:
    • Support risk assessments for systems and data flows in high-risk operating environments.
    • Identify and mitigate technical risks - including connectivity, data loss, device theft, fraud, system misuse - before and during activations.
    • Contribute to incident reviews to improve our safety and resilience protocols.

What You'll Bring:

  1. Values & Core Competencies:
    • Exceptional alignment with GiveDirectly Values and active demonstration of our core competencies: emotional intelligence, problem solving, project management, follow-through, and fostering inclusivity. We welcome and strongly encourage applications from candidates who have personal or professional experience in the low-income and/or historically marginalized communities that we serve.
  2. Professional Experience:
    • 5+ years of professional experience; we welcome a wide range of relevant backgrounds (e.g. technical program management, product management, data analytics, software engineering, international development, emergency response, or management consulting).
    • Experience managing timelines, operational risk, stakeholders, and complex deliverables across multiple workstreams.
    • Proven ability to operate in fast-paced and ambiguous settings, exercising sound judgment to balance speed, risk, and quality.
  3. Technical Skills:
    • Experience owning technical decisions when no predefined playbook exists, including evaluating novel technologies, system designs, and risks.
    • Working proficiency with a programming or statistical language (e.g. Python, R, Matlab, Java, Apex) - this role involves building automation and business logic, but it is not an engineering or data science role.
    • High attention to detail and strong instincts for analysis and validating data and code creatively and rigorously.
    • Structured approach to problem-solving and a drive to uncover and fix root causes rather than surface-level issues.
    • Ability to clearly communicate technical concepts to both technical and non-technical stakeholders across varied cultural, national, and social backgrounds.
    • Fluency in English.
    • Preferred, not required: Experience working with relational databases (e.g. SQL).
    • Preferred, not required: Experience with data visualization.
  4. Contextual Understanding:
    • Understanding, or interest in learning, how technology enables emergency response operations (e.g. CVA platforms, identity verification, data collection tools, payment systems, mobile apps).
    • Preferred, not required: Experience working in humanitarian or emergency response contexts.
    • Preferred, not required: Familiarity with humanitarian coordination systems (UN clusters, INGO networks) and donor expectations.

jobs.title: Senior Engineering & Integration Manager
jobs.excerpt: Senior Engineering & Integration Manager About the company: In the coming decades, our world needs substantially more critical minerals such as copper, lithium, and cobalt, to build electric infrastructure, vehicles, data centers, and electronics.
jobs.description:
Senior Engineering & Integration Manager

About the company:

In the coming decades, our world needs substantially more critical minerals such as copper, lithium, and cobalt, to build electric infrastructure, vehicles, data centers, and electronics. The mining industry is making 10x fewer discoveries per dollar spent on exploration compared to 30 years ago, because the easy-to-find, near surface deposits have largely been discovered.

KoBold is a leading scientific mineral exploration, mine development, and technology development company. Our goal is to turn mineral exploration into a repeatable science to make discoveries faster—by integrating artificial intelligence, human intelligence, and new technology. We made our first discovery—Mingomba, one of the world’s largest undeveloped high-grade copper deposits—after spending materially less than the industry average. This asset is expected to operate for decades, and be a leading global copper supplier. KoBold is actively running exploration programs in 8 countries worldwide, all with the potential for another high-quality discovery.

We are developing Mingomba by applying the same technical rigor to resource development and mine planning as we do to exploration. Mingomba is also a scientific laboratory where we prototype new technology and workflows, combined with the expertise of veteran engineers. Our multidisciplinary team consists of mine and processing engineers, geologists, data scientists, software engineers, community, health & safety, construction, and operations specialists. We want to develop world-class mining projects that are safer and have more predictable outcomes for ourselves, partners, and communities.

KoBold is privately held; investors include institutional asset managers T. Rowe Price and Canada Pension Plan Investments; technology venture capitalists Andreessen Horowitz, Breakthrough Energy Ventures, BOND Capital, Durable Capital, StepStone, and Standard Investments; and strategic natural resources companies BHP and Mitsubishi.

About the role

This is a senior Engineering leadership role for the development of a significant Copper mining complex in Zambia. The Mingomba deposit contains over 10 million tonnes of copper more than half of which exceeds 6% grade. This role will help turn that world class deposit into a world class mine.

The Senior Engineering & Integration Manager is the primary technical authority for the Mingomba copper project through its design and construction phase. Reporting to the Project Director, this role carries end-to-end accountability for the quality, integrity, and integration of all engineering across the owner's team, the EPCM and specialist contractors. The role is the technical decision-maker and design authority for the project, responsible for safeguarding Kobold’s interests through stage gates, design reviews, and construction handover to operations. The Senior Engineering & Integration Manager sets the direction for engineering delivery, resolves complex cross-discipline technical issues, and directly influences how the Mingomba project is designed and built.

What this role is accountable for delivering

This role exists to ensure against common failure modes on major capital projects, with particular emphasis on scope creep driven by unresolved technical decisions, design quality that does not survive construction, and an owner's team that cannot effectively challenge or govern its engineering service providers.

The successful candidate will be judged on:

  • Engineering delivered on time, within sanction cost, and to the standard required for safe, operable, and maintainable facilities.
  • A design that has been constructability-reviewed, value-engineered, and operability-tested before it is frozen.
  • An EPCM that is technically directed, not just administered, with KoBold holding design authority.
  • A project that passes independent technical assurance reviews and stage-gate approvals without material qualification.
  • A technical risk register that is live, owned, and actively driven down.

Key responsibilities

Technical authority and design governance

  • Hold and exercise design authority on behalf of KoBold. Making and recording binding technical decisions across all disciplines, with a clear escalation path to the Project Director for issues that affect schedule, cost, or safety.
  • Establish the basis of design, engineering standards, and design criteria for the project, and enforce them with both the owner's team and the EPCM.
  • Own the technical risk register: identify, quantify, and drive the resolution of engineering risks before they become scope changes or construction rework.
  • Approve key engineering deliverables including P&IDs, design criteria, equipment datasheets, and technical specifications.
  • Direct the scope freeze process: define what decisions must be made to freeze design at each stage, own the timeline for those decisions, and prevent scope growth after sanction.

EPCM direction and performance management

  • Act as KoBolds senior technical interface to the EPCM as an active director of engineering scope, priorities, and performance.
  • Monitor engineering service provider progress against the engineering management plan using earned value metrics and escalate deviations in quality, schedule, or cost before they compound.
  • Direct EPCM and specialist contractor technical performance by challenging design solutions, enforcing design and lifecycle cost requirements, and proactively mitigating interface risks to ensure scope alignment.

Constructability, operability, and value engineering

  • Lead formal constructability reviews at FEL 2 and FEL 3, ensuring construction knowledge is embedded in the design before it is frozen.
  • Drive operability and maintainability reviews with the operations and maintenance readiness team at each design milestone, ensuring the facility can be safely operated and maintained as designed.
  • Lead structured value engineering sessions; ensure cost optimisation decisions are evidence-based, preserve safety and operability margins, and are captured in the design basis.
  • Benchmark key design parameters and cost drivers against comparable copper projects and IPA / industry data; identify outliers and resolve them with the EPCM and design leads.

Project integration and stage-gate delivery

  • Own the engineering integration across all disciplines and resolve inter-discipline conflicts, managing shared interfaces, and ensuring the project design is coherent end-to-end.
  • Prepare and present the engineering case for each stage-gate review; ensure the technical content is decision-ready, the assumptions are explicit, and the residual risks are quantified.
  • Oversee and enforce the project change control process, ensuring EPCM compliance and managing the technical, cost, and schedule impacts of scope changes.
  • Lead lessons-learned integration from comparable projects into the Mingomba design; establish a formal mechanism for capturing and applying lessons during execution.
  • Direct engineering interface management with external stakeholders, regulators, power counterparties, infrastructure providers, and the Zambian technical authorities.

Process safety and hazard management

  • Own the engineering dimension of process safety for the project and be accountable that HAZOPs, HAZIDs, SIL assessments, and process safety reviews are completed, actioned, and closed out.
  • Act as design authority for safety-critical systems (including isolation philosophies, shutdown logic, and structural integrity), ensuring all decisions are documented, traceable, and preserved throughout project design and construction.
  • Provide engineering input to the project's safety case and regulatory submissions; represent the KoBold engineering position in interactions with regulators.

Engineering data, quality, and handover

  • Establish and oversee the engineering data management framework, including version control and handover protocols, while maintaining the deliverables register to ensure a current, complete, auditable technical record.
  • Direct the engineering quality plan: define hold points, witness points, and independent review requirements across the design and construction phases.
  • Implement KoBold engineering and business standards; provide technical governance through a structured review and audit programme across the owner's team and EPCM.

People, capability, and operational readiness

  • Build and lead a high-performing KoBold engineering team, setting clear accountabilities, developing capability, and creating a culture of technical rigour and challenge.
  • Define the engineering resourcing plan through each project phase; identify gaps and direct recruitment or secondment to fill them ahead of demand.
  • Ensure the operational readiness team is embedded in the design process from the outset, and that design decisions reflect operability and maintenance requirements.
  • Mentor senior engineers; establish a structured technical development pathway within the project organisation.

Qualifications and experience

  • 18+ years of professional engineering experience in major capital projects in mining, minerals processing, oil and gas, or equivalent heavy industry, with a significant portion as the lead engineering authority on the owner's side.
  • Demonstrated track record of delivering projects through full lifecycle from FEED to mechanical completion, including at least one project above $700M total capital cost.
  • Deep experience managing and directing EPCM contractors with the ability to distinguish between EPCM advisory and owner technical authority, and to hold that line under schedule pressure.
  • Strong multi-discipline technical foundation with the ability to assess and challenge designs across civil/structural, mechanical, process, electrical, and instrumentation disciplines. Experience with Mine Processing and Infrastructure is an advantage.
  • Capability in constructability reviews, operability reviews, value engineering, and HAZOP/HAZID facilitation on complex facilities.
  • Experience developing and executing engineering management plans, technical risk registers, design basis documents, and stage-gate technical submissions.
  • Exposure to earned value management, engineering progress measurement, and performance reporting in an owner's team context.
  • Strong communication and influencing skills: able to present technical positions to project leadership, boards, regulators, and external technical stakeholders with equal clarity.
  • Bachelor's degree (or higher) in an engineering discipline; Chartered Engineer status or equivalent professional registration strongly preferred.
  • Experience in African or similarly complex operating environments is an advantage
  • Ability and willingness to travel internationally to Zambia, with anticipated travel of 90+ days per year.

KoBold Metals is an equal opportunity workplace and an affirmative-action employer. We are committed to equal employment opportunities for people of any race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, marital status, national origin, age, citizenship, or disability.

Location: Global with Africa or Europe (preferred) otherwise North America.

A DAY IN THE LIFE

Blattner Company, a Quanta Services operating company, is building a Crane & Rigging Center of Excellence (CoE) to coordinate crane expertise, standards, training, and fleet deployment across the Quanta family of operating companies. This is a founding role: the Senior Director will stand up a function that does not fully exist yet, earn the trust of operating companies across the enterprise, and deliver measurable value within the first year backed by a mandate, a budget, and the support of Blattner and Quanta leadership.

Quanta’s operating companies collectively run one of the largest crane fleets in North American construction. The CoE exists to help those operating companies navigate that complexity, deploy assets more effectively, and operate to a consistent standard of safety and technical excellence.

STEP INTO THE ROLE

  • Stands up the CoE from an early-stage function into a recognized enterprise resource hiring the team, establishing operating cadence, and building the operating-company relationships that make the function valuable.
  • Manages a growing team of crane and rigging professionals, including dedicated hires, fractional contributors from Blattner’s operations, and subject matter experts from other Quanta companies.
  • Manges the CoE’s budget and is accountable for the value it delivers utilization improvement, cost avoidance, standards adoption, and incident reduction.
  • Represents the CoE to Quanta operating company leadership, Blattner’s executive team, and Quanta corporate leadership.

WHAT YOU’LL NEED

  • Bachelor’s degree in construction management, engineering, business, or a related field, or an equivalent combination of education and field experience.
  • 12 or more years of leadership in crane and rigging operations, heavy lift planning, or construction equipment management in heavy civil, power generation, renewable energy, or industrial construction; hands-on experience across more than one crane market strongly preferred. 9 or more years of experience leading teams required.

WHAT SETS YOU APART

  • Ability to travel 40-50% of the time.
  • NCCCO certification (any applicable discipline) preferred; AEMP, CEMP, or equivalent equipment-management credentials preferred.
  • Crane knowledge — deep working knowledge of crane types (lattice boom crawlers, all-terrain, rough terrain, boom trucks, and tower cranes) and the lift environments each is suited to.
  • Experience — hands-on experience across more than one crane market; a background spanning utility-scale renewable work and at least one of gas generation, data center construction, heavy industrial, or high-voltage transmission is strongly preferred.

HOW WE INVEST IN YOU

  • Competitive pay
  • 100% employer paid HDHP insurance premiums for employees
  • 401(k) with company match
  • HSA and FSA options
  • Dental and Vision insurance
  • Education Assistance (Tuition Reimbursement)

$195,966.00 - $284,150.00 Individual Compensation to be determined based on the applicant's applicable experience and qualifications balanced against internal equity.

  • Define Ads ontologies and canonical metrics across campaigns, budgets, bids, creatives, audiences, and placements to power consistent reasoning and recommendations.

  • Establish evaluation suites and dashboards tracking precision/recall, calibration, hallucination rate, latency, and cost; drive continuous model and system improvements.
  • Run A/B and uplift experiments to quantify business impact; own KPIs such as ROAS lift, pacing accuracy, RCA precision/recall, forecast MAPE, and time-to-insight.
  • Partner with Ads Product, Ads Engineering, Sales leadership, Data Engineering, and R&D to align roadmaps, de-risk launches, and ship high-quality production agents.
  • Own your workstream end to end—from data and pipelines to the UI and agent logic—delivering secure, observable, and reliable tooling that’s adopted by the field.

About You

Minimum Qualifications

  • 4–7 years of experience in analytics engineering, data science, or applied AI, with advanced proficiency in Python and SQL.
  • 2+ years working with ads, retail, or e‑commerce data.
  • Hands-on experience with dbt and Snowflake or BigQuery, including data modeling, testing, documentation, and managing data contracts.
  • Experience orchestrating data pipelines with Airflow (or a similar scheduler), including alerting and on-call support for data SLOs.
  • Ability to design and run offline/online evaluations and A/B or uplift tests; familiarity with experiment design and statistical inference.
  • Fluency in Ads analytics concepts: ROAS, CPA, CTR, CVR, LTV, pacing, auction dynamics, and incrementality.
  • Shipped at least one production data or AI system used by business stakeholders, with demonstrable business impact.
  • Experience with evaluation and guardrail frameworks and human‑in‑the‑loop QA workflows.
  • Proficiency with at least one BI/visualization tool (e.g., Looker, Tableau, Mode, or Power BI).
  • Bachelor’s degree in a quantitative field (e.g., Computer Science, Engineering, Statistics) or equivalent practical experience.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience building AI-driven products or agents end to end, including retrieval design (hybrid search, re-ranking) and vector search.
  • Deep expertise in advertising products and operations, with a track record of driving automation that improved ROAS, pacing, or operational efficiency.
  • Applied experience with Ads modeling techniques such as forecasting, anomaly detection, uplift modeling, and causal inference.
  • Hands-on experience with workflow automation or internal tooling (e.g., Retool, Superblocks, Zapier, n8n, Gumloop) and/or front-end frameworks (e.g., React) to translate insights into actions.
  • Familiarity with retail media and ad ecosystems (e.g., Amazon Ads, Google Ads, Meta, Shopify, DoorDash) and their measurement frameworks.

About Stripe

Stripe is a financial infrastructure platform for businesses. The Growth organization drives Stripe's self-serve growth engine: from a user's first interaction with Stripe through onboarding, activation, and expansion across our products. Growth focuses on building the systems and surfaces that help any user find, understand, and adopt the right set of Stripe products, regardless of how or where they start.

Within Growth, the onboarding program is how new and existing users get to their first successful use of Stripe as quickly and completely as possible.
