The Opportunity

FutureSight is seeking a Co-Founder & CEO to lead Concordance, an AI-native clinical documentation compliance venture. This is a co-founder partnership with meaningful founder equity, not a salaried executive role.

Concordance AI audits 100% of healthcare charts in real-time, catches payer-specific gaps before they hit billing, and eliminates the manual QA overhead that costs organizations millions in denials and clawbacks every year. Currently, manual QA teams consume 25%+ of operational labour budgets, yet audit only about 10% of patient charts, leaving organizations massively exposed.

Market Context

We didn't just build a thesis; we validated it directly with the market. We have spoken directly with Compliance Directors, QA Leaders, and Revenue Cycle Directors across behavioural health organizations. The market signal is incredibly strong:

  • Unprompted Product Pull: Every single lead described the exact product we want to build: a pre-billing, real-time, EHR-integrated flagging layer that checks documentation against payer-specific rules before claims are submitted.
  • Massive Financial Pain: The real pain comes from post-payment recoupments (clawbacks). Buyers cited chronic, aggressive payer audits happening weekly or monthly, with single audit events causing catastrophic losses ranging from $150,000 to $850,000.
  • Budget is NOT the Blocker: Buyers explicitly stated that if the tool integrates cleanly with their EHR and meets a high accuracy bar, securing the budget is not a problem.

We are targeting a large, highly fragmented market where revenue cycle teams are increasingly struggling to manage denials at scale. The total addressable market is estimated at $4.0B–$6.0B+, spanning more than 20,000 organizations, including multispecialty groups, behavioural health providers, and health systems. The ROI case is compelling: at current price points, the software can quickly pay for itself by reducing manual auditing labour by an estimated 80–85% while also preventing clawbacks that translate into millions in avoided losses.

About FutureSight

FutureSight is a leading venture builder that co-creates world-class software companies with values-driven entrepreneurs from inception to exit. We are a team of founders, operators and designers with experience successfully bringing software to market at scale.

You’ll co-create with a proven studio team, led by John Carbrey (4x entrepreneur, $100M ARR), Krista LaRiviere (3x exited, E&Y Top Women Entrepreneur), Alan Smith (Strategyzer co-founder, $120M in products built), Prathna Ramesh (former MD of Maple Leaf Angels, $275M in follow-on capital), and Johnny Tong (0-to-1 builder, acquired by SAP and Stripe) bring a rare combination of operator exits, institutional investing, and AI product depth.

The Partnership

  • Founder equity with meaningful ownership from inception
  • Pre-seed capital committed by FutureSight for early hires and MVP development, with potential for follow-on funding
  • Venture building resources, including embedded design, engineering, growth, and fundraising support from day one
  • Investor and advisor network across vertical AI and early-stage capital markets
  • A true co-creation model in which you operate as CEO with FutureSight's cross-functional team as your partner

What You’ll Own

As Co-Founder & CEO, you will set the venture's direction and lead its execution.

  • Strategy — Refine the ICP, pricing model, and product positioning
  • Customer Development — Lead pilots with compliance and revenue cycle leaders, convert them to paid engagements, and build the go-to-market motion
  • Product — Partner with the FutureSight product and engineering team to ship V1 and iterate on user feedback
  • Capital — Lead the seed raise, supported by FutureSight's network and traction
  • Team — Recruit and lead the founding team, and establish the cultural foundation of the company

Co-Founder Profile

  • Previous founding experience at a venture-backed company
  • Demonstrated success in B2B SaaS or B2B AI go-to-market, including sales and customer engagement
  • Fundraising fluency, with the ability to develop investor narratives and close capital
  • Proven ability to attract, develop, and retain top talent
  • Clear-eyed understanding of the risks and demands of co-founding a venture-backed company
  • RCM Domain & Workflow Depth: Deep, operational exposure to healthcare revenue cycle, medical billing, or denial management. You must intuitively understand the operational differences between clinical/coding denials and administrative roadblocks. You are familiar with the fragmented realities of smaller EHR/PM systems and the "band-aid" tech stacks billers use to survive

How to Apply

Please submit your resume, LinkedIn profile, and a brief note on why this venture aligns with your goals as a founder. We will move quickly for the right candidate.

The desired start date is 10/12/2026. Only applicants selected for interviews will be contacted. No telephone calls, please.

ABOUT THE CENTER
The Center for Biological Diversity, a national 501(c)(3) non-profit organization, believes the welfare of human beings is deeply linked to nature — to the existence of a vast diversity of wild animals, plants and people. Because diversity has intrinsic value, and because its loss impoverishes society, we work to secure a future for all species, great and small, hovering on the brink of extinction. We do so through science, law, activism and creative media, with a focus on protecting the lands, waters and climate that humans, other species and all communities need to survive and thrive.

We want those who come after us to inherit a world where the wild is still alive.

POSITION SUMMARY

The attorney will work as part of a team using law and advocacy to address threats and increase marine wildlife and habitat protections. The Oceans program leverages our bedrock environmental laws to protect coral reefs, sea turtles, whales and other marine animals. They will work with experienced attorneys who will provide supervision, training, and mentorship. The attorney will assist with legal research and writing, litigation, and administrative advocacy. This is a two-year position with opportunities to learn unique skills from our motivated, experienced, and creative staff of lawyers, scientists, campaigners, and organizers to launch their careers in public interest environmental law.

ESSENTIAL JOB DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Litigate under the supervision of experienced attorneys, including oral argument;
  • Conduct legal research and writing, including preparing legal memos, brief writing, cite checking, and preparing filings;
  • Administrative advocacy including legal and scientific comments on proposed rulemakings and environmental review documents and oral testimony;
  • Coordinate with our team and partner organizations to advance an ocean policy reform agenda, including developing policy and legal strategies that protect biodiversity;
  • Research and develop expertise on ocean issues and science;
  • Prepare communications such as press releases, op-eds, fact sheets, action alerts and white papers;
  • Complete other project work outside of the program as needed to meet changing organizational priorities;
  • Perform other job-related duties as assigned.

ESSENTIAL QUALIFICATIONS AND SKILLS

  • Juris Doctor degree
  • Admission to the bar of your state, California or District of Columbia bar membership a plus
  • Two to five years of civil litigation experience, environmental law preferred.
  • Excellent legal research, writing, and oral advocacy skills.
  • Familiarity with environmental laws.
  • A demonstrated commitment to environmental protection.
  • A strong work ethic, time management, and organizational skills.
  • Ability to work independently and as a part of an effective team.
  • Competence in and commitment to principles of justice, equity and inclusion.
  • Scientific literacy is preferred.
  • Ability to work 40+ hours per week.

WORKING CONDITIONS

Travel required, at times on short notice. Requires work in an office setting, with a typical schedule of Monday-Friday with some night and weekend work required at times due to deadlines. May need to use typical office equipment such as computers, printers, copiers, etc.

Parallels has an immediate vacancy for this role.

Push the boundaries of tech. In your sweatpants.

We’re looking for an experienced Principal Backend Engineer to help us change the way the world works, withParallels:anytime, anywhere, any-device productivity. Here, you’ll drive the outbound prospecting effort by executing strategic prospecting campaigns to target accounts and executive personas with our Parallels team.

The top creative and technical minds could work anywhere.So why are so many of them choosing Parallels? Here are three reasons:

  1. This is the moment.It’s an exciting time at Parallels, with strong leadership, a refreshed brand, and a whole new approach to changing the way the world works. We’re at the forefront of a movement, and we want you to ride this wave with us.
  2. We want you to be you.Too often, companies tell you about their culture and then expect you to fit it. Our culture is built from the people who work here. We want you to feel safe to be who you are, take risks, and show us what you’ve got.
  3. It’s your world.We know you have a life. We want to be part of it, but not all of it. At Parallels, we’re serious about empowering people to work when, how, and where they want. Couch? Sweatpants? Cool with us. We believe that happy employees mean happy customers. That’s why we hire amazing people and get out of their way.

Sound good so far? Awesome. Let’s talk more about thePrincipal Backend Engineer roleand see if we’re destined to be together.

Requirements

  • Expert knowledge of modern backend infrastructureand asynchronous messaging/storage (RabbitMQ, Celery, Kafka, PostgreSQL, Redis, etc.).
  • Solid foundation in Python (or deep expertise in Go/C++/Rust with a working knowledge of Python)coupled with the engineering maturity to quickly master the Python backend ecosystem.
  • Extensive Backend Experiencewith a proven track record in principal-level roles designing complex, distributed systems.
  • Pragmatic Architectural Mastery.Expertise in designing highly cohesive, loosely coupled systems. Deep understanding of software design patterns and architectural methodologies such as Domain-Driven Design, Clean Architecture, Hexagonal combined with the clear judgment on when simpler approaches are better.
  • Strong background in designing client APIs.Not just individual APIs or groups, but the entire API schema and contract of a system.
  • Deep understanding of cloud architecture, containerization, and CI/CD pipelines.
  • Demonstrated ability to influence engineering practices, drive technical consensus, andlead complex architectural transitions across multiple teams.
  • You have skills and authority to coach and mentor the team. You have skills or knowledge the team can learn from you.
  • Experience working in Agile/Scrum environments.

Nice to have

  • Experience with Azure as a cloud platform.
  • Experience designing and implementing GraphQL APIs.
  • Experience with Kubernetes or other container orchestration tools.
  • Experience implementing Identity Management in enterprise applications (SCIM provisioning, OAuth2, OpenID Connect, SAML).
  • Polyglot background:Experience with Golang, Rust, or C++ for performance-critical domains.
  • Spec-Driven Development (SDD) & AI-Native Engineering.Experience designing formal, machine-readable specifications and strict contracts, tests as the single source of truth. You know how to define strict system boundaries and executable contracts that constrain AI agents, ensuring they accelerate code generation without introducing architectural drift or spaghetti code.

What You’ll Do

  • Drive and define architectural roadmaps for backend systems.
  • Architect and lead the strategic decomposition of a mature Django application into scalable, asynchronous microservices.
  • Define technical strategy, tech stack, and how code is organized across repositories.Make critical build-vs-buy decisions, including evaluating whether to proceed with internal implementation vs. using a 3rd-party tool.
  • Write code for the most complex, critical system mechanisms.While you won't be fixing everyday bugs, you will implement the most critical mechanisms, and features for the business. Help teammates when needed.
  • Architect secure and scalable integration patternsacross the system, establishing best practices for 3rd-party integrations, identity management, and SSO/SCIM integrations.
  • Redefine system architecture & designby auditing existing microservices and implementing strict bounded contexts.
  • Design robust, scalable, and standardized APIs. Take ownership of the cloud architecture strategy with a strong emphasis on backend resilience, fault tolerance, and performance.
  • Act as the technical cornerstone for the engineering team.Partner directly with engineering leadership to define and enforce technical standards. You will have the organizational backing to drive complex architectural transitions across a team of 7-8 engineers.

Parallels is a top VDI/EUC product helping businesses since 1999. Whether it's desktop or cloud, on-prem or hybrid, Parallels delivers speed, security, and affordability for the modern work environment.

About us

Intellum is the leader in corporate education technology and powers the largest, most successful customer, partner, and employee learning programs in the world. Large brands and fast-moving companies like Google, Meta, Amazon, Walmart, Xero, Atlassian, Mailchimp, Airbnb, Stripe, and TikTok rely on Intellum to engage and educate the audiences they touch.

We have always been a “remote first” company and are proud to have team members located all over the world. We value Curiosity, Creativity, Perseverance, and Kindness and strive to demonstrate these core values every day. Our culture is very important to us. We invest in our people in fun and exciting ways, including personal development budgets and an annual all-company retreat that is focused less on work and more on human connections. We are in growth mode, and our “smart growth” approach ensures that we will continue to scale our company effectively.

The Lead Systems Engineer is a senior individual contributor responsible for the reliability, scalability, and modernization of Intellum's platform infrastructure. Intellum serves large enterprise customers with demanding availability expectations, and this role will help shape the technical direction for how our platform runs, deploys, and scales.

This is a highly hands-on role with significant ownership across infrastructure architecture, cloud environments, deployment systems, observability, and platform reliability. The Lead Systems Engineer will also provide technical leadership across the Systems Engineering function through architecture guidance, mentorship, knowledge sharing, and strong operational standards.

A key focus of this role is continuing to modernize the platform toward portable, container-orchestrated infrastructure, improving deployment and observability capabilities, and maintaining an architecture that can operate effectively across multiple cloud providers.

Responsibilities

  • Own and drive key infrastructure modernization initiatives, including the continued evolution from legacy compute environments toward modern, container-orchestrated infrastructure while maintaining reliable service for enterprise customers.
  • Design and maintain infrastructure as code across multiple cloud providers, ensuring infrastructure decisions support portability, maintainability, and long-term scalability.
  • Improve the reliability and maturity of Intellum's CI/CD systems and deployment tooling so releases are efficient, observable, and recoverable.
  • Provide technical leadership across the Systems Engineering team through mentorship, architecture guidance, knowledge sharing, and support for strong engineering practices.
  • Establish and evolve SLI and SLO practices, along with the monitoring, alerting, and load-testing capabilities needed to support platform reliability.
  • Participate in and provide leadership during platform incidents, including troubleshooting, root cause analysis, and follow-through on corrective actions.
  • Drive visibility into cloud infrastructure costs and incorporate cost considerations into architecture and infrastructure decisions.
  • Improve developer experience by evolving the infrastructure and tooling engineers depend on, including development environments, deployment workflows, and production feedback loops.
  • Partner closely with Security and Engineering teams on access controls, infrastructure hardening, compliance requirements, and secure infrastructure practices.
  • Identify operational and infrastructure risks early, recommend priorities, and help drive the technical roadmap for the Systems Engineering function.
  • Contribute to the continued development of the Systems Engineering team and function, including mentoring engineers and helping build strong technical practices as the organization evolves.
  • Perform other duties as assigned.

Required Skills

  • 8+ years of hands-on experience in infrastructure, DevOps, platform engineering, site reliability engineering, or a related discipline, including experience building and operating production systems.
  • Deep hands-on experience designing, operating, and troubleshooting highly available production infrastructure.

jobs.description:
Work Arrangement: Remote / Offshore - Independent Contractor
Hours: 20 hours per week, Monday to Friday
Schedule: 10:00 AM to 2:30 PM Sydney time, including a 30-minute break
Reports To: Managing Director / Recruitment Consultant
Supports: Recruitment Consultants
Works With: Finance and Administration Team

About the Role

The client is an established Australian recruitment agency specialising in accounting and finance, HR, and supply chain recruitment across temporary and permanent placements.

A significant portion of the client's roles are filled through candidates already within its recruitment database. Maintaining accurate candidate records, conducting proactive candidate searches, coordinating interviews, and ensuring strong candidate engagement are therefore critical to the success of the business.

The Candidate Manager will support the recruitment consultants across the recruitment process, with a strong focus on candidate sourcing, database management, interview coordination, candidate care, and recruitment administration.

Key Systems

The Candidate Manager will regularly use:

  • JobAdder – jobs, placements, candidates, and client records
  • Metaview – interview and briefing recordings and summaries
  • Truity – candidate psychometric assessments
  • Adobe Acrobat – PDF editing and document compilation
  • Microsoft Outlook and Teams – interview scheduling and communication
  • Microsoft SharePoint – document storage and sharing
  • Microsoft Word – Candidate Reports and documentation
  • LinkedIn – candidate research and profile information
  • DocuSign – electronic signing of contractor documentation
  • VXT – softphone, call recording, and JobAdder integration

Key Responsibilities

1. Daily Recruitment WIP Meetings

  • Attend daily Teams WIP meetings and review progress across active vacancies, upcoming opportunities, contractors, and priority actions.
  • Keep relevant recruitment activities and candidate records updated following meetings.

2. Candidate Search and Interview Coordination

  • Conduct candidate searches in JobAdder based on instructions and search criteria provided by Recruitment Consultants.
  • Review job briefing information and Metaview recordings where additional context is required.
  • Attach suitable candidates to relevant jobs and maintain accurate application statuses in JobAdder.
  • Contact shortlisted candidates and coordinate interviews within the availability provided by consultants.
  • Send interview confirmations and create Microsoft Teams invitations.

3. Candidate Reports and Documentation

  • Prepare Candidate Reports using templates stored in SharePoint.
  • Populate information including education, software skills, availability, and reasons for leaving.
  • Download and prepare candidate CVs, removing personal contact information where required.
  • Update Candidate Reports following consultant interviews using relevant information from Metaview.
  • Combine Candidate Reports, candidate CVs, and psychometric assessment results into a single professional PDF using Adobe Acrobat.
  • Provide completed candidate packs to the Recruitment Consultant for client submission.

4. Candidate Database Management and Candidate Care

  • Maintain clean, complete, and accurate candidate records in JobAdder.
  • Update information including location, current employer, work location, transport, working rights, availability, salary expectations, skills, software experience, and education.
  • Apply appropriate candidate coding and alerts to support future database searches.
  • Upload relevant LinkedIn information and profile photographs where available.
  • Conduct candidate care calls with active candidates to understand their current situation and interest in new opportunities.
  • Update employment status, salary, notice period, contract end dates, and market availability.
  • Request and upload updated CVs where required.

5. Client Interview Coordination

  • Coordinate candidate interviews with clients based on times provided by Recruitment Consultants.
  • Contact candidates to confirm availability and send interview confirmations.
  • Create and manage Teams invitations using the relevant consultant's account.
  • Ensure client interviews are not recorded unless specifically authorised.
  • Coordinate face-to-face interviews where applicable.

6. Contractor Documentation

  • Prepare contractor engagement or employment documentation once placements have been confirmed.
  • Complete assignment details using approved templates.
  • Send documentation for electronic signature through DocuSign.
  • Send contractor confirmation emails using approved JobAdder templates.
  • Ensure relevant placement information and documents are accurately recorded.

7. Candidate Declines

  • Process candidate decline communications as directed by Recruitment Consultants.
  • Use the appropriate JobAdder email template depending on the candidate's status.
  • Carefully distinguish between applicants who should receive decline communications and database candidates who were considered without formally applying.
  • Ensure candidate communication remains professional and consistent with the client's recruitment process.

Must-Have Requirements

Candidates must have:

  • Previous experience working within an Australian recruitment agency, executive search firm, or similar Australian recruitment environment.
  • Demonstrated experience supporting Australian clients, candidates, and recruitment processes.
  • Strong hands-on experience using JobAdder for candidate management, database searches, job management, interview coordination, placements, and recruitment record maintenance.
  • Previous experience recruiting for accounting and finance roles in the Australian market.
  • Experience conducting candidate database searches and identifying suitable candidates against job briefs.
  • Experience coordinating candidate and client interviews.
  • Experience preparing Candidate Reports, CVs, recruitment documentation, and candidate packs.
  • Strong understanding of candidate care, database management, recruitment administration, and follow-up processes.
  • Strong written and verbal English communication skills.
  • Excellent attention to detail and a high level of accuracy.
  • Strong organisational and time-management skills, with the ability to manage multiple priorities.
  • Ability to work independently and proactively while supporting multiple recruitment consultants.
  • Confidence communicating directly with candidates, clients, and internal stakeholders.
  • Experience using Microsoft Outlook, Teams, Word, SharePoint, and similar business tools.
  • Reliable internet connection and a professional remote working environment.
  • A computer or laptop running Windows 11 Pro or higher. This is an essential technical requirement and must be confirmed during screening.

Highly Desirable

  • Experience recruiting across HR and/or supply chain roles in addition to accounting and finance.
  • Experience with Metaview, Truity, DocuSign, VXT, Adobe Acrobat, or similar recruitment tools.
  • Experience preparing contractor documentation and supporting temporary or contract placements.
  • Experience managing candidate care programs and proactive database engagement.

The Ideal Candidate

The successful candidate will be highly organised, proactive, and comfortable working in a fast-paced recruitment environment. You will enjoy keeping systems and candidate records accurate, following up outstanding actions, and ensuring recruitment processes continue moving without requiring constant supervision.

You will understand that strong database management and candidate care are just as important as sourcing new candidates and will take pride in keeping recruitment information organised, accurate, and up to date.

Our mission: eliminating every barrier to mental health.

Spring Health is a global mental health company on a mission to eliminate every barrier to mental health. We're building a world where getting support is simple, personal, and built around the person, so care can continue through every job, move, health plan, and life stage.

Spring Health is seeking a Revenue Execution Lead to build and lead field training for our Revenue organization. Reporting to the Associate Director, Revenue Enablement, this person will design and facilitate high-impact training for Account Executives, Customer Success Managers, Account Managers, Business Development Representatives, and the revenue leaders of those teams. This is a full-time position that is fully remote. Travel may be required for company, revenue, or field-team moments.

This is a new capability within Spring Health's Revenue Enablement function. The person in this role will not simply inherit an existing program; they will define what excellent field training looks like here, build the rituals and measurement infrastructre that make it durable, and help shape the future operating model of the Revenue Enablement team. This is a full-time, fully remote position on our team. Occasional travel may be required for team or company events/meetings.

What you'll do:

  • Build and deliver a practical field-training system that improves how AEs, CSMs, AMs, and BDRs learn, practice, and execute the most important motions in their roles.
  • Facilitate live trainings, workshops, role-plays, manager sessions, and other field-practice moments with the presence, clarity, and credibility needed to carry a room.
  • Partner with Revenue and Product Marketing leaders to diagnose execution gaps across discovery, qualification, messaging, objection handling, account strategy, expansion conversations, renewal readiness, pipeline progression, and customer value conversations.
  • Translate field priorities into training programs that are simple, repeatable, and measurable, using adult-learning principles and practical reinforcement rather than one-time enablement events.
  • Create formal coaching and mentorship programs that help revenue leaders and experienced ICs develop talent, reinforce key behaviors, and create stronger peer-learning loops across the organization.
  • Build learning paths for different Revenue audiences, including role-specific training for AEs, CSMs, AMs, and BDRs, along with leader-facing curricula for managers field-wide.
  • Use call recordings, field feedback, performance data, manager input, and learner signals to identify what is working, where execution is breaking down, and where training should be adjusted.
  • Use AI thoughtfully and innovatively to increase the speed, quality, personalization, practice depth, and measurement of training while maintaining strong judgment, confidentiality, and human coaching standards.
  • Build the tools, templates, facilitator guides, coaching rubrics, practice scenarios, and measurement loops that make training scalable beyond any single session.

What success looks like in this role:

  • Revenue teams have a clear, repeatable field-training operating system for priority skills, role-specific practice, certification, and reinforcement.
  • New hire and internal-transition ramp improves through faster time to readiness, clearer skill expectations, and stronger manager reinforcement.
  • AEs, CSMs, AMs, and BDRs show observable improvement in the field behaviors targeted by training, such as discovery quality, qualification discipline, value articulation, objection handling, account planning, customer conversations, and next-step execution.
  • Revenue leaders have practical coaching tools, shared language, and routines they use to reinforce training after sessions end.
  • Training programs are measured with clear leading indicators, including attendance where relevant, completion, practice quality, certification outcomes, manager observation, call-quality signals, CRM or workflow adoption, and post-training behavior change.
  • Training priorities are connected to business needs such as pipeline quality, conversion, deal progression, expansion readiness, renewal risk reduction, productivity, and customer-facing consistency, without overstating causation where evidence is still developing.
  • The role creates durable team leverage: programs, playbooks, rubrics, AI-assisted practice flows, and coaching systems that others can operate and improve over time.
  • The field experiences enablement as inclusive, practical, credible, energizing, and directly connected to the moments that determine revenue execution.

What you'll bring:

  • 10+ years of experience in revenue enablement, sales training, sales leadership, customer-facing commercial roles, learning and development, or a related GTM role.
  • Experience in at least one of the following: quota-carrying sales, revenue leadership, customer success/account management leadership, or field-facing enablement/training.
  • Strong business acumen and the ability to connect training work to commercial execution, customer outcomes, and revenue priorities.
  • Exceptional live facilitation skills, including the ability to command attention, create productive practice, manage group energy, and make complex concepts simple and actionable.
  • Comfort operating in ambiguity, building from a blank page, and turning unclear field needs into focused programs with clear owners, measures, and next steps.
  • Strong coaching instincts, including the ability to observe behavior, give clear feedback, and help others improve without making training feel theoretical or punitive.
  • Ability to partner with senior revenue leaders and frontline managers while staying close enough to the field to understand what actually happens in calls, meetings, handoffs, and account work.
  • Analytical judgment and comfort using qualitative and quantitative signals to diagnose gaps, prioritize interventions, and evaluate training effectiveness.
  • Eagerness to build with AI and use it responsibly to improve role-plays and other forms of practice, along with content generation, feedback loops, manager reinforcement, and learning personalization.
  • Clear, concise communication and strong project management skills, with the ability to build programs that are practical, well-run, and easy for busy field teams to adopt.

Nice to have:

  • Experience in B2B, healthcare, benefits, SaaS, or complex consultative selling environments.
  • Experience enabling multiple Revenue audiences, such as AEs, BDRs, Customer Success, Account Management, and frontline managers.
  • Experience with sales methodologies, manager coaching systems, certification programs, onboarding/ramp programs, mentorship programs, or field coaching.
  • Experience using tools such as Salesforce, Gong or other conversation-intelligence platforms, LMS tools, enablement platforms, AI assistants, or content management systems.
  • Experience designing blended learning programs that combine live facilitation, asynchronous learning, peer practice, manager reinforcement, and field application.
  • Experience building programs in a fast-growing or changing organization where processes are still being defined.

We think good software should make community work easier, not add to the pile. We are a remote team that ships carefully, shares credit, and gives people real room to grow.

Reporting to the VP of CX & Retention and leading the Retention Analyst, this person works hands-on in the data itself, not from summaries handed off by others. This is a hybrid data-and-execution role, not a pure lifecycle marketing or reporting position.

ROLE & RESPONSIBILITIES

What You’ll Do

  • Own subscriber retention analytics: build and maintain cohort retention reporting (rebill rates, skip/pause rebill behavior, LTV by cohort, churn drivers) and translate patterns directly into program priorities

  • Conduct root-cause churn analysis across structured and free-text cancellation data to identify segment-level drivers and quantify their impact on churn and revenue

  • Build and maintain the subscriber journey map, identifying key intervention points from trial through long-term retention and anchoring each to where the data shows subscribers actually churn

  • Design, test, and optimize proactive save programs: identify at-risk subscribers before they cancel and execute targeted, personalized interventions

  • Design and optimize cancellation flows, including deflection offers, pause options, and retention messaging, to reduce voluntary churn

  • Own win-back strategy and execution for recently churned subscribers, including sequencing, offer structure, and rigorous testing of what actually converts

  • Lead and develop the Retention Analyst, setting analytical priorities and ensuring findings translate into specific, testable program decisions

  • Partner with Marketing, Product, and Analytics on retention-driven campaigns, subscription management features, and cancellation experience improvements

  • Report retention program performance to the VP on a regular cadence, including cohort trends, program ROI, churn impact, and win-back conversion rates

  • Run structured A/B tests to validate retention interventions before scaling them

  • Stay current on DTC subscription retention benchmarks and analytics practices to continuously improve RYZE's approach

  • Additional duties as assigned by management.


WHAT WE OFFER

What We’re Looking For

Required:

  • 4+ years of experience in retention analytics, subscriber lifecycle management, or CX retention program management within a DTC subscription or physical-product recurring-revenue business

  • A demonstrated, quantifiable track record of reducing churn or improving retention and LTV in a subscription business, with the ability to speak specifically to the metrics moved and how

  • Hands-on proficiency in cohort analysis, LTV modeling, and subscriber segmentation using SQL and/or BI tools (e.g., Sigma, Looker, Amplitude); this is a skill the person applies directly, not one delegated entirely to a direct report

  • Experience building or maintaining subscriber or customer journey maps and using them to identify intervention points

  • Experience designing and owning cancellation flows, save programs, and win-back sequences, including offer testing and conversion optimization

  • Experience leading or partnering closely with an analytics function, working directly from data to build programs rather than only receiving reports

  • Strong cross-functional collaboration skills with Marketing, Product, and Analytics teams

  • Excellent written communication skills, with experience writing or reviewing retention-focused member communications

Preferred:

  • Background in health, wellness, food/beverage, or other physical-goods subscription brands (as distinct from SaaS retention)

  • Experience managing a direct report or analyst, including setting analytical direction and translating outputs into program decisions

  • Familiarity with churn prediction or other predictive modeling approaches applied to subscriber behavior

  • Experience with Recharge, Klaviyo, Zendesk, Sigma, or similar subscription and CRM/analytics platforms

  • Experience building win-back and lapsed subscriber reactivation programs at scale

What We Offer

  • Competitive base salary commensurate with experience

  • Health, dental, and vision insurance

  • 401(k) with company match

  • Paid time off and company holidays

  • Remote-first work environment with flexible scheduling

Our Purpose

At SentinelOne, we are driven by a clear purpose: to give the advantage to those who secure our future. As AI reshapes how organizations build, operate, and innovate, the responsibility to protect them becomes more critical than ever. When you join SentinelOne, your work helps protect global enterprises, critical infrastructure, and the technologies shaping tomorrow. If you are motivated by meaningful challenges and want your impact to be real, measurable, and global, you will find purpose here.

About Us

SentinelOne is a company at the intersection of AI and security, pioneering a new operating model for cybersecurity. Our AI-native platform unifies protection across endpoint, cloud, identity, data, and AI systems to deliver autonomous detection and response with clarity and speed. By combining real-time analytics, intelligent automation, and a unified data foundation, we reduce noise, simplify complexity, and empower security teams to focus on what truly matters.

Our teams are builders, problem-solvers, and innovators committed to shaping the future of security. If you are excited to solve hard problems alongside talented, mission-driven people, we invite you to help us build a safer future for humanity.

What Are We Looking For?

We’re looking for people who are relentlessly curious and committed to continuous learning. AI is reshaping every function across our business, and we enable every team member, regardless of role or level, to build fluency in AI tools and concepts. Those who thrive here actively seek out new solutions, experiment thoughtfully, and apply what they learn to drive better, faster, smarter outcomes.

As a Manager of Developer Tooling, you will be tasked with leading the team responsible for designing, building, and operating our CI/CD pipelines. This team sits within the Developer Experience organization and is at the center of how every engineer ships code. You will set the technical direction for our pipeline platform and partner with Infrastructure Services and product engineering teams to deliver a fast, reliable, and self-service path to production.

What Will You Do?

Primary responsibilities include:

  • Lead, grow, and develop a team of engineers building and operating CI/CD pipelines and pipeline tooling.
  • Own the architecture, roadmap, and reliability of our CI/CD pipelines from source to production.
  • Integrate AI capabilities into the developer workflow including AI code review on pull requests, AI generated tests, intelligent test selection and flake detection, AI assisted failure triage, and engineering intelligence dashboards that surface bottlenecks and impact.
  • Partner with the broader DevEx organization to roll out, support, and measure adoption of AI coding assistants (e.g., Claude Code, Cursor, Copilot) across product engineering teams.
  • Build paved road templates, reusable libraries, and golden paths that make doing the right thing the easiest thing for product teams.
  • Drive measurable improvements in pipeline reliability, build and test duration, and developer wait times.
  • Partner with security to build supply chain controls, policy enforcement, and AI specific guardrails into the pipeline.
  • Work closely with the Infrastructure Services team that owns CI/CD orchestration, GitOps continuous delivery, artifact management, and related platforms, and with product engineering teams that consume the pipelines.
  • Establish on call practices, incident response, SLOs, and continuous improvement loops for pipeline systems.
  • Recruit, mentor, and grow engineers and create an environment where strong engineers do their best work.
  • CI/CD pipelines are the circulatory system of an engineering organization, and AI is rapidly becoming part of that bloodstream. The Manager of Developer Tooling will lead the team that defines how code reaches production, safely, quickly, confidently, and increasingly with AI as a first class participant in the workflow. This is a critically important role with significant impact on engineering velocity and reliability across the company.

What Skills and Knowledge Will You Bring?

Ideal candidates will have:

  • 7 or more years of engineering experience with 2 or more years managing engineers, ideally in DevOps, platform engineering, or developer experience teams.
  • Strong hands-on background with CI/CD systems including Jenkins, GitHub Actions, GitLab CI, Tekton, or similar, including pipeline as code patterns.
  • Hands-on experience integrating AI tooling into the development workflow including AI code review, AI test generation, AI coding assistants, or engineering intelligence platforms such as LinearB, DX, Jellyfish, Faros, or similar.
  • Working knowledge of ArgoCD or comparable GitOps tooling and artifact management systems like Artifactory, Nexus, or Harbor.
  • Solid understanding of Kubernetes, containers, and cloud native deployment models.
  • Experience designing shared libraries, templates, or platforms used by many internal teams.
  • Demonstrated ability to balance hands-on technical leadership with people management responsibilities.
  • Strong written and verbal communication with the ability to translate technical strategy for both engineers and non-technical stakeholders.
  • A service mindset measured by the productivity and happiness of the engineers you serve.

Why SentinelOne?

AI is redefining how the world operates and rewriting the rules of security in real time, and SentinelOne was built for this moment. From day one, we architected an AI-native platform designed to operate at machine speed, not as an add-on to legacy systems but as the foundation itself. If you want to build where innovation and impact move together, this is that place.

We provide numerous opportunities for advancement. You’ll be in a certified ASTM and ISO environment. You'll also be supported by a Senior Language Specialist, as well as our Interpreter and Technology Help Desks.

Join our team now!

Job Description

Work at Home Bilingual Moroccan Arabic-English Phone Interpreter

Job Title: Moroccan Arabic Interpreter

Location: Work at Home position in United States

Position: Phone Interpreter

Status: Independent Contractor

Pay: $0.60 - $0.75 per minute.

We Offer:

  • Employee Referral Program.
  • Advancement opportunities within the organization.
  • Interpreter support.
  • An inclusive and diverse work environment.
  • **This is an independent contractor position and therefore not eligible for employee benefits.**

Position Overview:

The Moroccan Arabic Telephone Interpreter is responsible for handling calls on demand, and renders the meaning of conversations between Moroccan Arabicand English speakers. The interpreter breaks the communication barrier in a wide range of industries that LanguageLine Solutions serves: Healthcare, Government, Insurance, Financial, Utilities, Travel & Hospitality, General Business, Law Enforcement, Court, and 911.

The interpreter processes information quickly, concisely and recognizes sensitive cultural differences. The interpreter is professional and courteous at all times and uses appropriate terminology and understands common industry procedures and practices. The interpreting sessions may involve simple or complex, technical or non-technical subjects.

This position does not involve written translation however translators and other skilled linguists are encouraged to apply. The Interpreters translate verbally.

**This is a remote position. The Interpreter works from his/her home-office. It is essential to ensure a quiet & secure environment.**

Essential Job Functions

  • Respond to the interpreting sessions promptly and conduct interpretation in a friendly and professional manner.
  • Render correct concepts and meanings according to the conventions of established interpretation protocol, avoiding omissions or additions.
  • Speak clearly in both languages using proper pronunciation, enunciation and polite expressions.
  • Maintain a professional demeanor throughout the interpreting sessions at all times.
  • Remain calm during interpreting sessions in the event that one of the primary speakers is incoherent or upset, especially in emergency situations such as 911 calls.
  • Maintain punctuality and availability during work hours.
  • Follow client instructions, in compliance with protocol to ensure client expectations are met with the Limited English-speaking Person (LEP), avoiding interaction with the LEP without client’s permission.
  • Understand protocol and terminology for various industries including, but not limited to, Medical, Insurance, Finance and Law.
  • Demonstrate commitment to cultural sensitivity and working in a diverse environment.
  • **Some calls may be highly emotional and/or stressful in nature. The interpreter may need to remain on a call for extended periods without breaks due to the nature of the call or may, at times experience high call volumes. The interpreter must have the ability to provide the required, company standards of service within this dynamic environment. **

Qualifications

  • Fluency inMoroccan Arabicand English and skilled in the associated cultural dynamics.
  • Ability to provide cultural competency and assess regional and accent differences to find ways of communicating with the LEP.
  • Excellent listening, retention and note-taking skills to maintain a high level of accuracy during interpretation.
  • Ability to concentrate, stay detached from the conversation, remain neutral and objective at all times, and remain on calls that involve sensitive subjects such as end of life conversations, pregnancy termination, vaccinations, and matters concerning sexual orientation and/or gender expression.
  • Education or work experience in language-related fields such as teaching, language assessment, translation or interpretation preferred.
  • Must be able to adapt to any LLS technology enhancements that improve service delivery and meet client demands.
  • Must be at least 18 years of age.
  • Legally authorized to work in the United States
  • Applicants for employment in the US must have work authorization that does not now or in the future require sponsorship of a visa for employment authorization in the United States and with LanguageLine Solutions (i.e., H1-B visa, F-1 visa (OPT), TN visa or any other non-immigrant status).
  • High school diploma or equivalent.
  • Candidates who are currently employed by a client of LanguageLine Solutions or an affiliated LanguageLine Solutions business may not be eligible for consideration.
  • Ability to read and write the requested languages - highly preferred.

**Based on your location, a post-offer, a pre-employment background check and/or drug screen may be required**

Technical Requirements:

  • Dedicated personal device for business purposes.
    • Desktop / Laptop Computers with any of the following Operating Systems: Windows, MacOS, or ChromeOS.
    • Tablets (iPadOS or Android) are acceptable.
    • Smartphones (iOS or Android) are also acceptable.
  • Restricted brands:
    • Kaspersky products.
    • Huawei hardware.
  • High speed Internet connection for work related electronic communication. This internet connection should provide download speeds of no less than 5 Mbps, upload speeds of 3 Mbps, Ping value of no more than 300 ms, Jitter value of no more than 30 ms.
  • Must have access to a quiet space free from background noise or distraction.

Physical Requirements:

  • Must be able to operate a keyboard and mouse and remain in a stationary position in front of a computer the majority of the workday.
  • Must be able to operate company provided software and systems to perform all aspects of the job.
  • Must have sufficient manual dexterity to type or write.

About DualEntry

Founded in 2024, DualEntry is one of the world’s fastest-growing AI startups.

At DualEntry, the future of finance is being written today. ERP is one of the largest fintech markets in the world ($220,000,000,000+). Yet, tens of thousands of companies are still using on-premise systems, and the industry has not seen new entrants in more than 30 years.

Our AI-native ERP lets accounting teams achieve more in less time. $5M-ARR businesses to NYSE-listed companies trust DualEntry to automate away manual data entry work with AI. We’re finally making the one-person finance team a reality and putting the pain of legacy ERPs from the 1990’s in the past.

We operate with urgency and ownership. We move fast.

Why This Role Matters Now

Since starting 18 months ago, we’ve raised $100,000,0000+ from world-class investors such as Lightspeed Venture Partners, Khosla Ventures, Contrary Ventures and Google Ventures, as well as more than 20 angel investors who’ve built, scaled, and exited some of the most impactful companies of the last decade.

We got there by moving incredibly fast and hiring an exceptionally sharp, hard-working and deeply committed team from leading tech and accounting companies — Ramp, Meta, Microsoft, Lyft, PwC, Deloitte, J.P. Morgan, Bloomberg, Sage, Xero and Intuit. And some of us don't have a fancy logo on our resume and are here for a shot to prove ourselves.

We’re a small team, growing fast with huge momentum - join early.

This is an intense, hands-on role with full ownership. We expect you to push for excellence and raise the bar.

As our Backend Engineer, you’ll build and own critical features end-to-end, increasing product velocity and powering DualEntry’s AI-native ERP. This is an intense, hands-on role with full ownership.

📍 Location: Remote - this role is available across all EU/LATAM countries with overlap for the US ET timezone (NYC HQ)

Where you'll create impact

  • You’ll own end-to-end execution for backend systems and infrastructure

  • You’ll build APIs, services, and real-time systems handling complex accounting logic

  • You’ll collaborate with founders, product, and frontend engineering to turn complex workflows into secure, performant systems

  • You’ll design, implement, and ship production-ready features at high speed

  • You’ll manage data migrations, scaling challenges, external integrations, and end-to-end reliability

  • You’ll drive measurable outcomes that accelerate DualEntry’s product velocity and stability

What sets you up for success

  • Hardcore work ethic and high agency

  • 5+ years of experience in backend engineering

  • Proven track record in high-growth, high-ownership environments

  • Strong skills in PostgreSQL, SQL, ORMs, migrations, and schema design

  • Experience with AWS or comparable cloud infrastructure

  • Strong API design and testing experience

  • Understanding of CI/CD, deployment, and production readiness

  • Bonus: expertise in Python and modern frameworks (FastAPI, Flask, or Django)

  • Ability to manage complex systems with evolving requirements

  • Fluent English (C1+) with clear communication

How You Operate

  • Pragmatic: you like to move forward and make decisions based in reality (not theory). We don't debate if Cassandra has the most theoretical scalability -- we use Postgres until it breaks

  • Hard working: 'You can work long, hard, or smart, but [here] you can't choose two out of three" - Jeff Bezos. We wrote this job post during the weekend

  • Curious: you love to learn, are highly curious about new frameworks and solutions to engineering problems

  • Fast-moving: you deploy daily, iterate quickly, and never wait for permission

Why you’ll thrive here

  • Significant equity ownership in one of the top AI companies in the world

  • You’re joining early and will grow with DualEntry

  • Your feedback shapes the product directly

  • High-speed culture

  • High-trust environment with high expectations

  • Ambitious mission - ERP is one of the largest B2B software markets in the world ($220bn per year), this is a once in a lifetime opportunity to build the next generation ERP in an industry that has not seen new entrants in 30+ years

Benefits & Perks

  • Base Salary: $65,000 – $135,000 USD

  • Equity: $50,000+ USD

  • Contract type: B2B

  • Remote-first team - the fastest team you will have ever worked with

  • Time Off: 15 PTO days + 12 public holidays

  • Visa sponsorship option for relocation to NYC within 2+ years

  • Early-stage role with high autonomy and real long-term upside

  • Enjoy a learning & development budget for courses, certifications, and language learning to keep growing your skills.

  • Work where you feel most productive at co-working spaces or from your home office with support for setup, internet, and phone.

  • Plus, wellness perks and more to make your workday even better!

We hire the best, expect the best, and give you the masterclass of your career - an archaic and huge industry like ERP only goes through a restructure like this once in a lifetime. It’s hard, it’s intense, and it’s the most rewarding work you’ll ever do.

If you’re hungry, driven, and ready to build something massive, climb aboard!

At DualEntry, we believe great products come from diverse teams. We’re an equal opportunity employer, and we’re committed to a culture where everyone feels included, supported, and able to do their best work.

The Director, Product Development, Innovation & Commercialization leads Manchester Mills’ textile product strategy from market insight and concept development through sourcing alignment, testing, commercialization, launch, and lifecycle performance. The Director partners closely with Sales, Sourcing, Quality, Marketing, Finance, Operations, and external customers to support new business wins, customer retention, product innovation, and Manchester Mills’ long-term growth strategy.

35% Product Strategy, Innovation & Commercialization
• Lead the end-to-end product development roadmap for Manchester Mills textile categories, including bedding, bath, filled goods, and related hospitality textile solutions.

20% Textile Technical Expertise, Quality Standards & Supplier Collaboration

Suki also offers its proprietary A, Suki Platform, to partners who want to create best-in-class ambient and voice experiences for their solutions. We’re a team of technologists, clinicians, and industry experts working together to push the limits on technology used in medicine. We’re confident enough to move fast and talented enough not to break things. Check out this short video to learn more about our mission and our culture.

As part of our growing Platform Customer Success team, you will also be responsible for improving existing processes and developing new approaches to create high levels of client and user satisfaction. You are excited to join the fast-moving Suki team, and committed to excellence!

Account Management: Be the overall quarterback of “Suki for Partners” (platform) accounts to manage relationships, drive adoption, retention and expansion for their book of business, and make Suki’s platform customers successful.

Solution Understanding & Technical Partnership: Have a working knowledge of platform architectures to be able to partner closely with customer product/engineering teams and Suki’s Solutions engineering team and manage relationships with our platform customers.

Partner Enablement: Collaborate with the Suki’s partner enablement & customer’s sales, marketing, and channel teams to build training programs, collateral, and success stories that effectively position and sell the jointly-developed solution.

Flexibility: You will need to work flexible hours based upon client’s and providers’ schedules in different time zones across the US.

  • Demonstrated ability to drive significant business outcomes (revenue, scale, efficiency) for large, complex enterprise customers.
  • Exceptional communication, presentation, and executive-level relationship management skills
  • Bachelors in engineering, science or a technical discipline

Preferred

  • Proven experience in managing channel partnerships or solutions that are resold, licensed, or embedded by a strategic customer.

This position can be remote and supports team members with clients across the United States. You are welcome to visit and/or work out of our office in Redwood City, California. One week a year, we gather for a company-wide retreat. Quarterly, we gather for an in-person working session at/near our office.

  • On a roll: Named by Fast Company as the Next Big Thing in Tech, by Comparably for the Best Leadership Team, by Frost & Sullivan for a Technology Innovation Leadership award, just to name a few.

About the role:

The Senior Fellow, Regulatory Affairs is a highly influential enterprise individual contributor responsible for advancing regulatory excellence and accelerating FDA approval pathways across Boston Scientific's Cardiology portfolio. This role serves as a strategic leader and trusted adviser, leveraging deep expertise in cardiovascular technologies, regulatory science and FDA engagement to improve regulatory outcomes, reduce approval timelines and build sustainable organizational capability.

Operating across franchises and functions, the Senior Fellow drives systemic improvements in submission readiness, regulatory strategy, evidence generation, agency engagement and regulatory execution. This role is accountable for creating repeatable frameworks, governance models and best practices that strengthen regulatory performance across priority programs.

Boston Scientific was recognized as a Glassdoor Best Place to Work in 2026, ranking No. 15 on the Top 100 list, reflecting the culture our employees experience every day.

Work model, sponsorship, relocation:

This is a remote position. Boston Scientific will not offer sponsorship or take over sponsorship of an employment visa for this position at this time.

Your responsibilities will include:

Enterprise regulatory strategy and FDA acceleration

  • Own and continuously evolve the enterprise FDA acceleration strategy for priority Cardiology programs.
  • Identify opportunities to reduce submission-to-approval timelines while maintaining regulatory rigor and patient safety.
  • Challenge teams to pursue the most effective regulatory pathways rather than relying on historical approaches.
  • Develop strategic recommendations for premarket approval applications (PMAs), investigational device exemptions (IDEs), pre-submissions and other complex regulatory submissions.

Submission readiness and quality

  • Lead independent submission readiness assessments to strengthen right-first-time quality.
  • Anticipate reviewer concerns and evaluate evidence packages before submission.
  • Establish common readiness standards and review mechanisms across franchises.
  • Drive improvements that reduce deficiencies, avoidable review cycles and regulatory delays.

Regulatory metrics and operational excellence

  • Establish and monitor portfolio-level regulatory key performance indicators, including submission readiness, FDA review cycle time, deficiency rates, time to response, approval timelines and root causes of delays.
  • Create governance mechanisms that drive accountability and corrective action across businesses and functions.
  • Measure and communicate the business impact of regulatory performance improvements.

Strategic FDA engagement

  • Develop enterprise approaches for FDA interactions, including Q-Subs, pre-submission meetings, interactive reviews and escalation strategies.
  • Embed FDA reviewer perspectives into product development, clinical strategy, statistics, manufacturing and labeling decisions.
  • Improve organizational preparedness for high-risk regulatory interactions and reviews.

Capability building and organizational impact

  • Institutionalize lessons learned from FDA interactions, approvals and deficiencies.
  • Create reusable playbooks, decision frameworks, tools and training resources.
  • Develop advanced regulatory capabilities across the Cardiology organization.
  • Promote portfolio-wide adoption of best practices that improve regulatory outcomes.

Enterprise leadership and influence

  • Serve as an independent expert who challenges assumptions, influences senior leaders and drives decisions on high-priority programs.
  • Identify systemic barriers affecting regulatory performance and lead cross-functional solutions.
  • Partner closely with Regulatory Affairs, Clinical, Research and Development, Quality, Medical Affairs, Operations, Health Economics and Market Access, and business leadership teams.
  • Operate with significant autonomy and enterprise accountability without direct people-management responsibility.

Qualifications:

Required qualifications:

  • Advanced degree in medicine, science, engineering, regulatory affairs, public health or a related discipline.
  • Recognized expertise in cardiovascular medical devices and regulatory science.
  • Deep knowledge of FDA Center for Devices and Radiological Health processes, PMA and IDE submissions, clinical evidence generation, benefit-risk assessments and life cycle management.
  • Strong network across the medical device industry and among FDA cardiovascular thought leaders.
  • Experience influencing or reviewing regulatory strategy for complex, high-risk medical technologies.
  • Demonstrated ability to drive enterprise-wide change through influence, expertise and thought leadership.

Preferred qualifications:

  • Previous experience as an FDA reviewer or significant experience interacting with FDA cardiovascular device review teams; previous direct employment with the FDA in a cardiovascular reviewer role is preferred but not required.
  • M.D. or clinically relevant Ph.D.
  • Expertise in real-world evidence, clinical trial design, outcomes research and evidence strategy.
  • Experience developing enterprise frameworks, governance processes and organizational capability-building programs.
  • Strong executive presence and demonstrated ability to influence senior leadership without formal authority.

Success measures:

Success in this role will be demonstrated through:

  • Improved submission quality and readiness.
  • Reduced avoidable FDA deficiencies and review cycles.
  • Faster approval timelines and improved time to market.
  • Adoption of enterprise regulatory frameworks and best practices.
  • Measurable improvements in regulatory cycle-time metrics.
  • Enhanced organizational capability and regulatory effectiveness across the Cardiology portfolio.

This Senior Fellow-level position is an enterprise individual contributor accountable for building and sustaining regulatory acceleration capabilities that create measurable business impact across the Cardiology portfolio.

jobs.description:
The Director of Systems Strategy & Technology Planning connects customer needs with the Company’s technology strategy. This leader translates market and product requirements into technology roadmaps, development priorities, and executable engineering programs while aligning long-term investments, portfolio decisions, and execution. The role leads systems planning, technical strategy, technology portfolio governance, and Technical Program Management (TPM).

The ideal candidate brings deep expertise in battery technology, systems engineering, safety engineering, and product development, along with proven success building teams, developing talent, and driving cross-functional alignment. This role may be remote or based at ZincFive’s Tualatin, Oregon headquarters and reports to the SVP, Technology and Engineering.

Director of System Strategy & Technology Planning Job Duties:

  • Define and maintain multi-generation technology roadmaps across battery systems hardware, including battery cells and critical components, controls and software manufacturing technologies, and safety engineering and testing
  • Identify capability gaps and technology investment priorities
  • Serve as primary technical counterpart to Product Management in strategic planning and translate customer requirements and market opportunities into system-level product requirements
  • Lead technical feasibility assessments for future products and roadmap concepts and ensure technology roadmaps and product roadmaps remain synchronized
  • Establish system architecture strategy and standards across all product platforms and drive requirements flow-down from system-level requirements through target subsystem specifications, including battery cell specifications
  • Facilitate architecture reviews and alternative technology assessments, including assisting in trade-off analysis related to performance, cost, safety reliability, and manufacturability
  • Ensure architectural consistency across product families
  • Lead a team of Technical Program Managers responsible for converting technology and product strategy into executable new product development programs
  • Foster strong interdepartmental collaboration to enhance responsive customer service, timely issue resolution, streamline processes, and support shared business goals
  • Drive cross-functional alignment between Product Management, Engineering, Manufacturing, Quality, Supply Chain, and Service organizations
  • Translate roadmap objectives into structured development initiatives
  • Manage technical dependencies across concurrent programs
  • Identify and mitigate technical risks before they become schedule risks
  • Lead technical readiness reviews and milestone assessments
  • Establish development metrics and portfolio health indicators
  • Ensure program execution remains aligned with intended system architecture and product strategy
  • Build and lead a high-performing team and foster a culture of rigorous systems thinking, accountability, and innovation

Job Requirements:

  • BS in Electrical Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, Chemical Engineering, Systems Engineering, or related field
  • 15+ years of experience in battery systems, energy storage, electrification, power systems, or related technologies
  • 8+ years leading multidisciplinary technical organizations
  • Demonstrated success leading system-level product strategy and roadmap development
  • Experience in Model Based System Engineering (MBSE)
  • Deep understanding of battery cell technologies, BESS architecture, safety engineering, reliability engineering, and product development processes
  • Experience building and managing technical portfolios
  • Experience leading Technical Program Management organizations
  • Strong understanding of DFM, quality engineering, and manufacturing scale-up
  • Proven ability to recruit, develop, and retain high-performing technical talent

  • Advanced degree in Electrical Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, Chemical Engineering, Systems Engineering, or related field

  • Strategic and operational leadership
  • Excellent verbal, written and presentation skills
  • Planning, organizational and problem-solving skills
  • Strategic thinking, strong business acumen and pragmatic decision making
  • Creativity and innovation
  • Teamwork and collaboration

  • Work involves sitting, standing, and lifting up to 10 pounds
  • Repetitive typing and computer work for extended periods of time
  • Ability to wear PPE on face and body when required
  • Manufacturing, warehouse, lab, and office environments
  • Domestic and international travel (up to 25%)

jobs.description:
About Silo

Help us rebuild the oldest system in the world — the agricultural supply chain

Silo builds the software that fresh produce runs on. Our ERP handles the business end: sales orders, lot-level traceability, landed cost, invoicing, payments, and working capital. With our acquisition of Pet Tiger, we now cover the field end too — crew and labor management, piece-rate tracking, and harvest data capture. Field to Financial. No other platform covers both.

The timing is not an accident. Most produce businesses still run on QuickBooks, spreadsheets, or software written twenty years ago. We are building what replaces it, and we are building it for growers, packers, shippers, wholesalers, distributors, and importers alike.

We are engineers, designers, and produce people working across two products, several time zones, and one of the least digitized industries left. The work is real, the customers are real, and what you ship this quarter shows up in a packhouse next quarter.
We are looking for people who want ownership, not a lane. If you would rather solve a problem nobody has solved than maintain one somebody already did, this is the place.

About the Role

Silo builds the technology that runs the produce and food supply chain — from the Silo Platform, our ERP for wholesalers, distributors, shippers, and importers, to Pet Tiger, our agricultural labor management platform. We're hiring Customer Success Managers across experience levels — from entry-level CSM I through Senior CSM — to own the full relationship with our customers on both product lines: driving adoption and renewal, and serving as their first point of contact when something isn't working.

This is a blended role by design. Unlike a traditional CSM seat that hands support tickets off to a separate team, our CSMs own both sides of the customer relationship — proactive account management and reactive, front-line support — for the customers in their book of business. You'll be the person a customer calls whether they want to talk about renewing their contract or their invoice totals don't match their purchase orders. That end-to-end ownership is what makes the relationship stick.

What You'll Own

Every CSM on this team — at every level — independently exercises judgment across account strategy, product recommendations, and problem resolution. This isn't a scripted, escalate-everything role: you're expected to size up a situation, decide on a path, and act on it.

Customer Success & Growth

Account health monitoring — track usage and adoption metrics and independently flag and act on churn risk before it becomes a problem.

Independent module and configuration recommendations — assess a customer's actual operation (multi-entity structure, grower accounting needs, EDI complexity, multi-state labor footprint) and recommend the right add-ons or configuration without a preset script.

Renewal and pricing structuring — independently structure and negotiate renewal terms within Silo's pricing framework (e.g., standard annual increase vs. multi-year structure), rather than reading numbers off a sheet.

Upsell identification and execution — independently identify expansion opportunities and make the recommendation directly to the customer.

Business reviews — run QBRs and build lasting relationships with customer-side ops and finance stakeholders.

Cross-functional partnership with Implementation, Product, and Engineering to close the loop on customer-impacting issues.

Customer Support — With Real Discretion

Ticket resolution makes up roughly 30–40% of the role's day-to-day work — but it isn't rote, scripted work. Each case requires independent problem-solving:

Root-cause diagnosis — independently determine whether an issue is a customer training gap, a customer process gap, or a genuine product defect, across Silo's order, inventory, invoicing, and EDI modules or Pet Tiger's labor and time & attendance workflows.

Workaround design — independently establish and implement interim workarounds for customers when a fix isn't immediately available, judging what's safe and appropriate for that customer's specific setup.

Escalation judgment — independently decide whether and when to escalate to Engineering, Product, or a Strategic Account Manager, rather than following a fixed escalation script.

Clear, patient communication that translates technical issues into plain language for non-technical users.

Process & Training

Process ownership — own a specific internal playbook or workflow (e.g., an EDI escalation process or a compliance-flagging process) with authority to revise it based on what's working, not just assist with someone else's.

Training content design — adapt onboarding and training materials to a customer's specific configuration, and document playbooks used to train newer team members.

Domain Knowledge (either or both, depending on the customers you support)

Silo Platform: produce and food supply chain fundamentals — lot codes, bills of lading, PO matching, and core EDI concepts (850/810/856).

Pet Tiger: agricultural labor management fundamentals — time & attendance, payroll interfaces, and the compliance context (FLSA, WPS, state ag-labor rules) our customers operate under.

Domain Knowledge (either or both, depending on the customers you support)

Silo Platform: produce and food supply chain fundamentals — lot codes, bills of lading, PO matching, and core EDI concepts (850/810/856).

Pet Tiger: agricultural labor management fundamentals — time & attendance, payroll interfaces, and the compliance context (FLSA, WPS, state ag-labor rules) our customers operate under.

Additional duties as assigned.

Levels We're Hiring

We're hiring across the full CSM career ladder. Every level independently exercises discretion and judgment across account strategy, recommendations, and problem resolution — what scales with experience is the complexity of the accounts and decisions, not whether judgment is required at all.

Level

Experience

Scope

Senior CSM

4–7 yrs

Owns the most complex accounts and support cases; go-to resource for the team; mentors CSM II/III.

CSM III

2–4 yrs

Independently manages a full book of business, including moderately complex configuration recommendations, renewal structuring, root-cause diagnosis, and escalation decisions; owns at least one internal process or training asset.

CSM II

1–2 yrs

Independently manages an account portfolio and resolves standard support cases — including diagnosis, workarounds, and escalation judgment — with periodic manager check-ins rather than case-by-case guidance.

CSM I

0–1 yrs

Entry-level — learns account management and support fundamentals with close guidance from senior team members.

What We're Looking For

As a Designer on the Presence team, you'll contribute to the strategy and execution of Stripe’s most visible web surfaces. You’ll design new product pages, evolve storytelling for specific industries or audiences, and refine reusable patterns that make it easier to scale exceptional work across stripe.com. This is a high-impact role for a thoughtful, collaborative designer who deeply values visual craft, user clarity, and iteration.

We’re looking for someone who’s excited to operate at the intersection of storytelling, systems, and scale—and who takes pride in the pixels.
