jobs.description:
About bunny.net

Some people accept the internet as it is. We see what it could be.

At bunny.net, we don’t wait for change. We make it happen. You won’t find layers of red tape or play-it-safe thinking here. You’ll find people who move quickly, take ownership, and push ideas all the way to the edge. Literally.

You’ll build things that solve actual problems, not add to them.

We’re not perfect, and we don’t pretend to be. But we’re always improving. We’re looking for people who want to do the same, who take pride in their work, and aren’t afraid to challenge what’s possible.

Because everyone deserves a better internet. And we’re here to help it hop faster.

Accountant

As an Accountant at bunny.net, you'll be joining our six-person strong Finance team, supporting our Financial Controller on month-end close, audits, AR, and our UK entity, keeping everything behind it running cleanly, accurately, and on time.

We operate a global SaaS platform with high transaction volumes and customers across multiple countries, which means there’s a lot happening behind the scenes to keep the books tight and compliant.

Finance plays a key role in that, and it’s what keeps everything steady as we grow. This is a hands-on role where the details genuinely matter, and you'll be the person making sure nothing slips through the cracks.

You’ll report directly to our Financial Controller and work alongside another Accountant, as well as our Slovenian partners: a small, collaborative setup where people stay close to the details and support each other as we scale.

What will you do?

  • You’ll contribute to our month-end close process, helping us close the books faster and with greater accuracy

  • Own and manage AR end-to-end: maintaining records to ensure aging is up to date, credits and collections are applied, uncollectible amounts are accounted for, and miscellaneous differences are cleared

  • Support the UK entity, for example with payroll reviews and VAT returns

  • Keep financial data clean, reconciled, and audit-ready (always, not just when someone's looking)

  • Handle high-volume payment flows across gateways, banks, and currencies

  • Support AP and payroll journals, including working with international payroll setups and external providers

  • Assist with audit queries

  • Stay in sync with the German entity accountant and our Slovenian partners, so nothing drifts between entities

  • Spot what's slow or not scalable and make it better, without overcomplicating it

What success looks like in this role

  • Month-end happens predictably, every time

  • The UK entity runs like clockwork: no surprises, nothing unaccounted for

  • Audits are smooth because everything is already in order

  • The team trusts your numbers without needing to double-check

  • Problems get fixed before most people even notice them

  • Repetitive work quietly gets simpler or automated over time

To make your application stand out (we meant it when we said details matter), include the word ledger in the first sentence of your cover letter.

What will you bring?

  • 2–5 years of experience in a hands-on accounting role (such as Accountant, GL Accountant, Financial Accountant, or similar), ideally in a SaaS or high-growth environment

  • A strong accounting foundation: ACCA, CIMA, or equivalent (or working towards one)

  • Experience with UK accounting, including UK GAAP and/or IFRS in multi-entity or international environments

  • A habit of spotting what could work better, and fixing it, without waiting to be asked

  • Confidence handling volume and complexity (transactions, reconciliations, moving parts)

  • Clear ownership: if it's yours, you get it done

  • Great attention to detail and strong organizational skills

  • Clear communication when working across teams and with external partners

What will make us extra happy?

  • Exposure to broader EU accounting environments, especially Germany or Slovenia

  • Familiarity with NetSuite

  • Experience working in a fast-moving, sometimes undefined or high-growth environment

  • A practical mindset for improving and automating repetitive work

Where should you be located?

This job is fully remote from Europe (ideally CET or close time zone) with a flexible schedule, to make collaboration easier. You’re still free to hop around the world and switch up your scenery whenever you want.

What's in it for you?

Life at bunny.net comes with benefits that make work (and life) better.

  • 100% flexible hours - Your work, your rhythm. Whether you thrive at 3 am or on a beach at noon, we've got you.

  • Remote-first by design - No offices, no commute, just the freedom to work anywhere. Miss the office? We’ll give you a 3-night voucher for visiting our headquarters.

  • Performance-based bonuses - Great work pays off, and we reward impact annually.

  • Medical, dental, and vision insurance - Coverage worldwide.

  • Paid time off - Love the slopes or the sea? Enjoy them with 25 vacation days, plus an extra loyalty day each year, capped at 5 years (30 days total), on top of your local public holidays.

  • Meeting-free Thursdays - We keep Thursdays meeting free internally so you can focus on deep work without interruptions.

  • Home office budget - We believe everyone is more efficient working in a comfortable office, and we're happy to help you set it up with an annual budget of €500.

  • Paid sick leave - Feeling ill? Take time off to fully recover without having to worry about your finances.

  • Parental leave - Paid 16 weeks for birthing parents, 8 weeks for non-birthing parents. If your country gives more, that’s your baseline. If it gives less, we top it up. Take your leave all at once or split it across the first year for maximum flexibility. After paid leave, your local statutory rules apply.

  • Annual fluffle building - We're remote, but not distant! Once a year, we meet in a sunny location where virtual high-fives turn into real ones.

  • Employee Stock Option Plan (ESOP) - Everyone at bunny.net gets a piece of the pie, starting with 0.01% equity.

  • Mental health support - Feeling down? We've got your back. bunny.net provides mental health resources and help via .

  • Wellness budget - An annual well-being budget of €480 is here to help you stay fresh and focused.

  • Educational budget - €500 yearly for books, seminars, or online courses to keep your learning on track, work-related or not.

  • Music on us: Work is better with music. Enjoy a yearly Apple, Spotify, or YouTube Premium subscription on us.

Grove Collaborative is a sustainability-focused consumer products company creating household and personal care essentials that are effective, beautifully designed, and healthier for people and the planet. We are a certified B Corp, plastic-neutral, and on a mission to transform the CPG industry for good.

THE ROLE

Grove is hiring an AI-First Android Engineer — a senior, single-threaded owner of our Android surface who operates as an “engineer-as-a-team.” This isn’t a role where you hand-write every line and lean on AI for autocomplete. This is a role where AI is your primary instrument: you direct fleets of coding agents, generate, review, and refactor at orders of magnitude beyond what a traditional engineer can produce, and take total ownership of features end-to-end — from discovery through production. You will be measured by what ships, what stays up, and what customers feel — not by lines of code or tokens used.

You operate in a new-world environment where one well-equipped engineer can deliver the output of a small team. We expect you to compound your own leverage every quarter: better prompts, better evals, better agent harnesses, better guardrails. The bar isn’t “uses AI tools.” The bar is “runs AI like a team you manage.”

WHAT YOU’LL OWN

  • Direct multiple AI coding agents in parallel to design, build, test, and ship Android features in Kotlin against the Android SDK.
  • Take total ownership of a slice of the Android app — discovery, scoping, architecture, implementation, QA, release, monitoring, and iteration.
  • Run an “engineer-as-a-team” workflow — spawn agents for spec drafting, codegen, test generation, code review, refactoring, doc writing, and bug triage, then merge, judge, and ship.
  • Develop and defend a strong point of view on what good Android code looks like inside Grove’s architecture (Clean Architecture, multi-module Gradle with base/middleware/data/app, MVVM with DataBinding, Koin for DI, Coroutines/Flow, Moshi) so you can critically review AI output and reject what doesn’t meet our bar.
  • Design prompts, evals, and harnesses that make AI-assisted mobile development repeatable and measurable, not artisanal.
  • Stand up automation that closes the loop: Fastlane lanes, CircleCI checks, AppCenter/Play Console distribution, device test farms, telemetry-driven rollback, and AI-powered review gates.
  • Drive architecture decisions with AI as a research and prototyping partner — explore three options in a day instead of one in a week, including the path to introducing Jetpack Compose into a DataBinding/XML codebase.
  • Collaborate with other engineers on architecture and trade-offs — bring designs for review before you ship them. Solicit business context from PMs, designers, and platform engineers; don’t guess in isolation.
  • Own production health autonomously — monitor Sentry, Datadog, Cloudflare, and Firebase to assess system health, triage incidents, and re-prioritize your own backlog without being asked. You set the queue; you don’t wait for someone to tell you what’s broken.
  • Mentor the Heady contractor team on AI-native workflows and share learnings with mobile peers.
  • Triage Sentry crashes, hotfix, and root-cause incidents with AI-assisted investigation and remediation (we already run Sentry’s auto-fix agent — you’ll push it further).

ABOUT YOU

  • 5–8 years of professional Android development experience with a portfolio of shipped consumer apps at scale.
  • Native, demonstrable fluency with modern AI coding tooling (Claude Code, Cursor, Copilot, Codex, agentic workflows) — you can walk us through a feature you shipped where AI did the majority of the coding and you did the orchestration.
  • Strong, opinionated taste in Kotlin and modern Android architecture (Clean Architecture, MVVM, multi-module Gradle, Koin for DI, Coroutines/Flow, Moshi) — and a clear point of view on when MVI or Compose is worth introducing.
  • Comfort working in a DataBinding/XML codebase today, with the judgment to drive a phased Compose migration when and where it’s worth it (not a rewrite-from-scratch reflex).
  • Experience integrating with REST + JSON:API-style backends and the Shopify Buy/Checkout SDKs at consumer scale.
  • A bias toward owning end-to-end outcomes rather than handing off work at team boundaries — paired with the judgment to know when to pull another engineer in for an architecture review or business-context check.
  • Genuinely autonomous in operation: you read Sentry/Datadog/Firebase/Cloudflare dashboards on your own, prioritize your own queue, and don’t need a manager to surface what’s on fire.
  • Comfort writing prompts, evals, and guardrails — you treat AI as a system to be engineered, not a search box.
  • Sharp written communication — specify clearly, review rigorously, and explain decisions to teammates. You’ll drive async standups, design reviews, and Slack debugging sessions with a distributed team.
  • A collaborative, ego-light disposition — orchestrators thrive when they care more about the result than the byline, and welcome a sharp design critique from a peer.

EVEN BETTER IF YOU HAVE

  • Experience designing custom agents, MCP tools, or AI-assisted code review pipelines.
  • Experience leading an XML/DataBinding → Jetpack Compose migration on a production app.
  • Strong command of Coroutines, Flow, and structured concurrency patterns.
  • Comfort with the Grove-adjacent stack: Shopify SDK (Buy/Checkout), Stripe, Heap, Braze, AppsFlyer, Sentry, Firebase, Contentful, Constructor.io, Bazaar Voice, WorkManager.
  • Familiarity with Cicerone (or similar) for navigation and Spek/Kluent/Espresso for testing — or a strong opinion on what should replace them.
  • CI/CD for Android: Fastlane, CircleCI, AppCenter, Play Console automation, Gradle build optimization, version catalogs.
  • Subscription / e-commerce mobile experience — selling plans, recurring orders, cart-sidecar contracts, OOS handling at scale.
  • Exposure to feature flags, experimentation platforms, and analytics instrumentation.
  • Experience contributing to a team’s shift toward AI-native development practices.

WHAT'S IN IT FOR YOU

  • This full-time, exempt position is remote for candidates based in the following states: California, Maine, Pennsylvania, Nevada, North Carolina, Texas, Colorado, Washington, Illinois, New York, Missouri, and Massachusetts.
  • Competitive benefits - medical, vision, dental

COMPENSATION

Our compensation bands are determined based on market-specific cost of living data, meaning that the top of our salary range is reserved for the most experienced candidates in the highest cost of living areas across the country. The U.S. Oncology business within our company is a growing and dynamic organization committed to advancing innovative therapies for patients with cancer. We have an exciting opportunity to join our dynamic commercial team as we prepare for the potential U.S. launch of an mRNA-based individualized neoantigen therapy for early-stage melanoma, being developed through an alliance partnership. This novel product has the potential to redefine personalized cancer treatment and requires a highly coordinated operating model to support seamless therapy delivery across a complex treatment ecosystem.

Reporting to the Director, Patient Support Strategy Lead, the Associate Director, Patient Support Program Strategy will be responsible for establishing the vision, strategy, and governance framework for the Patient Support Program (PSP) supporting an individualized therapy. This role will oversee the development and continuous evolution of hub services, enrollment and consent processes, affordability solutions, and case management capabilities designed to help patients successfully navigate a complex treatment journey. The Associate Director will translate patient support priorities into scalable program requirements, service models, business rules, and performance standards while ensuring seamless integration across reimbursement, affordability, patient navigation, and support services. Through close partnership with internal stakeholders and external vendors, this individual will drive the development of innovative, compliant, and patient-centered solutions that support patient access and overall patient experience.

Description

Model Validation Specialist (AML Transaction Monitoring)

About the Role

We are seeking a highly skilled Model Validation Specialist to join our Financial Crime Analytics team. In this role, you will be responsible for validating, optimizing, and enhancing AML Transaction Monitoring models to ensure regulatory compliance, model effectiveness, and alignment with industry best practices. You will work closely with data scientists, compliance teams, model developers, and business stakeholders to assess model performance, conduct threshold tuning, and identify opportunities for continuous improvement.

Key Responsibilities

  • Perform independent validation of AML and Financial Crime models, ensuring compliance with regulatory expectations and model risk management standards.
  • Conduct threshold tuning and optimization of AML transaction monitoring scenarios to improve detection effectiveness while minimizing false positives.
  • Evaluate model methodologies, assumptions, data quality, and performance metrics.
  • Develop comprehensive validation documentation, including validation reports, model assessments, playbooks, and runbooks.
  • Analyze large datasets to identify trends, anomalies, and potential areas of model enhancement.
  • Assess risks associated with model design, implementation, and ongoing monitoring processes.
  • Provide recommendations for model improvements, process optimization, and risk mitigation.

  • Support the implementation and validation of new detection scenarios, models, and monitoring strategies.
  • Leverage data analytics and statistical techniques to evaluate model performance and suspicious activity detection capabilities.

About Re:Build

At Re:Build, our mission is to ensure the next generation of important products are made, at scale, in America. We are laying the foundation for a better future for our customers, employees, and communities by revitalizing America's manufacturing base and creating meaningful jobs across the country, including in historically deindustrialized regions.

We operate an advanced, end-to-end manufacturing platform that partners with industrial companies and innovators to take products from first concept to full-scale production in critical verticals including aerospace and defense, electrification, medical, energy and environment, and robotics and automation.

The way we operate is as important as the work we do. It's guided by The Re:Build Way, 16 principles that shape how we collaborate with each other, partner with our customers and vendors, and contribute to the communities where we operate. (link to The Re:Build Way principles)

The Opportunity

If you've worked alongside hardware teams, you know the damage that results from a missed change request or critical context that was never relayed to the right person. Reflow exists to close that gap. We're building the first AI-powered platform purpose-built for hardware product development, one that listens across the tools teams already use, maintains a structured picture of every program, and proactively coordinates across disciplines when things inevitably change.

This is a ground-floor opportunity for a hands-on SecDevOps engineer to define the infrastructure, delivery pipelines, and operational foundation of a high-potential product with the support of a parent company leading innovation in engineering and manufacturing.

Who We’re Looking For

We’re seeking a SecDevOps engineer who cares deeply about building infrastructure that is reliable, secure, and scalable. The ideal candidate has designed and operated cloud-native production environments, has strong opinions on CI/CD pipeline design and infrastructure-as-code, and treats observability as a first-class concern. You should already be using AI coding tools like Cursor, Copilot, or Claude to accelerate your work, with excitement about supporting the platform that finally replaces the spreadsheets and status meetings that hardware teams have been stuck with for decades.

This senior engineer will work alongside our engineering team and head of product to build and maintain the infrastructure that powers our platform—including deployment pipelines, cloud environments, monitoring systems, and the operational tooling that keeps AI agents and real-time data flows running reliably at scale. The role is hands-on - you will be writing code and configuration daily while contributing to infrastructure architecture decisions and helping establish operational best practices as we scale.

What You’ll Do

Your day-to-day responsibilities will include:

  • Designing, building, and maintaining cloud infrastructure on GCP, AWS and third-party providers using Terraform
  • Building and optimizing CI/CD pipelines for rapid, reliable deployments across multiple services and environments
  • Implementing comprehensive observability—monitoring, logging, alerting, and distributed tracing—to ensure platform health and fast incident response
  • Establishing and enforcing security best practices including secrets management, network policies, vulnerability scanning, and compliance automation
  • Supporting AI/ML infrastructure including model serving and the data pipelines that power our ambient AI agents
  • Building developer experience tooling—local development environments, preview deployments, and self-service infrastructure provisioning
  • Collaborating with backend and frontend engineers to ensure seamless integration between application code and infrastructure

Technical Requirements

Must Have:

  • 5+ years of experience in SecDevOps, SRE, or platform engineering roles
  • Demonstrated proficiency using AI coding tools (Cursor, Copilot, Claude, etc.) to accelerate development
  • Expert-level experience with at least one major cloud provider (GCP preferred; AWS or Azure also accepted)
  • Strong proficiency with Terraform
  • Deep experience with Docker
  • Proven track record designing and maintaining CI/CD pipelines (GitHub Actions, GitLab CI, or similar)
  • Solid understanding of networking fundamentals, DNS, load balancing, and CDN configuration
  • Proficiency in Python for automation and tooling
  • Ability to balance rapid iteration with reliable, well-documented infrastructure

Highly Valuable:

  • Experience supporting AI/ML workloads in production (model serving, GPU scheduling, streaming inference)
  • Familiarity with database operations and optimization (PostgreSQL, Redis, or similar)
  • Background in observability platforms (Datadog, Grafana, Prometheus, OpenTelemetry)
  • Understanding of authentication/authorization infrastructure (OIDC, OAuth2, JWT, SSO)
  • Experience with cost optimization and FinOps practices in cloud environments
  • Background in B2B SaaS platforms, particularly multi-tenant architectures
  • Familiarity with SOC 2, FedRAMP, or ITAR compliance requirements relevant to hardware and defense industries

What We Offer

Real Impact: The opportunity to build purpose-built tooling for an entire industry that has never had it

Customer Access: Direct exposure to hundreds of real hardware projects annually through Re:Build’s engineering and manufacturing companies

Technical Growth: Hands-on work with cutting-edge AI technologies solving novel infrastructure challenges

Autonomy: Backed by Re:Build while operating with startup independence

Benefits: Full health/dental/vision, bonus program, generous 401K, paid time off, annual learning stipend

Equity & Growth: Participation in Re:Build’s LTIP equity program and opportunity for founder equity in potential spin-out

Compensation & Location

Location: Remote-first, with preference for candidates in Boston, Seattle, Los Angeles, or other cities with Re:Build offices

Compensation: The base salary range for this position is $165,000 – $200,000 per year. This range represents the Company’s good faith estimate of the base compensation for this role at the time of posting. Actual compensation will be determined based on several factors, including but not limited to relevant experience, skills, qualifications, internal equity, and geographic location. In addition to base salary, this role may be eligible for annual incentive compensation and/or long-term incentives, subject to Company plans. The Company offers a comprehensive benefits package including medical, dental, vision, retirement, paid time off, and other benefits. Potential equity stake under independent spinout scenario.

Export Control Requirement: Due to applicable export control laws and regulations, candidates must be a U.S. citizen or national, U.S. permanent resident (i.e., current Green Card holder), or lawfully admitted into the U.S. as a refugee or granted asylum.

The BIG payoff

We are a company who is going to make a difference in the industries and the communities in which we choose to operate. Every employee of Re:Build will share ownership in the company and will share in the financial rewards of the success we achieve together, at all levels of the company!

jobs.description:
It's fun to work in a company where people truly BELIEVE in what they are doing!

We're committed to bringing passion and customer focus to the business.

Mission

The Vice President, Channel and Partner Programs will lead CenTrak's Channel and Partner team, owning the strategy, structure, governance, enablement, and performance of CenTrak's partner ecosystem. This leader will design and operate a scalable partner program that increases partner-sourced and partner-influenced growth, improves partner accountability, strengthens executive-level partner relationships, and creates a consistent operating model across partner types, regions, and internal teams.

This highly visible role balances program leadership, partner enablement, channel governance, strategic relationship management, and partner-led growth. The role requires strong collaboration across US Sales, Strategic Accounts, International Sales, Sales Operations, Product, Marketing, Services, Customer Success, Legal, Finance, and executive leadership.

Overview of Role

This leader is accountable for building and leading a high-performing Channel and Partner organization focused on scalable growth, partner productivity, operational discipline, and customer value. The role owns the partner program framework, including partner segmentation and tiering, recruitment, onboarding, enablement, certification, rules of engagement, QBR cadence, performance scorecards, discount governance, and partner lifecycle management across referral, reseller, service, technical, and strategic partner models.

The role will not simply function as another sales execution seat. The Channel and Partner team will set standards, enable partners, monitor performance, improve ease of doing business with CenTrak, and drive accountability while creating clear alignment with the sales teams closest to each customer, partner, and opportunity.

Key Results / Performance Metrics

  • Increase partner-sourced and partner-influenced pipeline contribution across priority partner types and regions.
  • Improve partner activation, time-to-productivity, certification completion, and enablement effectiveness.
  • Implement and maintain partner scorecards that measure revenue, pipeline, certifications, quality, on-time delivery, customer satisfaction, QBR cadence, and executive engagement.
  • Improve partner forecast visibility and leadership confidence through consistent pipeline reviews, scorecards, and QBRs.
  • Expand the partner ecosystem through recruitment and development of strategic, technical, service, regional, national/global, and referral partners aligned to growth priorities.
  • Reduce channel conflict through clear governance, deal registration, crediting frameworks, and rules of engagement.
  • Improve ease of doing business with CenTrak and remove bottlenecks that limit partner-led revenue growth and partner accountability.

Essential Responsibilities

Strategy and Operating Model

  • Define and evolve CenTrak’s channel and partner strategy, including partner segmentation, tiering, partner value propositions, and long-term ecosystem roadmap.
  • Build a unified partner operating framework with clear ownership and accountability across regions, partner types, and internal teams.
  • Establish standardized rules of engagement that clarify the roles and responsibilities of Channel, US Sales, Strategic Accounts, International Sales, National Accounts, Product, and other stakeholders.
  • Create a scalable channel governance model that reduces conflict, improves collaboration, and supports a consistent partner and customer experience.
  • Separate program ownership, partner relationship management, and sales execution, where appropriate, so the channel organization can scale without creating unnecessary role confusion.

Partner Program and Operations

  • Build and lead a centralized channel organization responsible for consistent partner management, partner communications, QBR cadence, program compliance, and governance.
  • Develop repeatable systems, playbooks, procedures, and workflows that streamline partner onboarding, reporting, communication, and ongoing engagement.
  • Establish and maintain deal registration, crediting frameworks, discount governance, partner scorecards, compliance expectations, and performance review processes.
  • Build tools and processes that increase transparency and communication with internal and external stakeholders.
  • Document partner and internal workflows to support long-term operational success, scalability, and accountability.

Partner Recruitment, Enablement, and Activation

  • Identify, evaluate, recruit, and activate strategic partners aligned to CenTrak’s growth priorities, including technology, integration, service, regional, national/global, and strategic partner categories.
  • Develop scalable partner enablement programs, including sales training, technical certification, solution positioning, pricing education, and process support.
  • Reduce process bottlenecks and expand training and certification to build partner capability, independence, and time-to-productivity.
  • Enable partners to sell, deploy, support, and expand CenTrak solutions where appropriate, including partner-led services and software implementation capacity.
  • Use voice-of-partner insights to improve partner experience and ensure CenTrak is easier to do business with.

Strategic Partner Relationships

  • Build and maintain executive-level partner relationships that strengthen alignment, growth, and long-term partner commitment.
  • Manage key global and strategic partner relationships, including joint business planning and growth strategy development with priority partners.
  • Serve as an internal advocate for partner needs while balancing CenTrak’s revenue, margin, customer experience, service delivery, and strategic priorities.
  • Collaborate with Product, Marketing, Services, Customer Success, Legal, Finance, and Sales to align CenTrak offerings, programs, and support models to partner opportunities.
  • Support multiple partner models, including regional resellers, service partners, national/global partners, strategic partners, international partners, government partners, technology partners, and integration partners.

Revenue Growth, Pipeline, and Market Expansion

  • Shift the partner ecosystem from opportunistic resale activity toward strategic growth contribution through new logo acquisition, account expansion, pipeline generation, and partner-sourced or partner-influenced opportunities.
  • Work with sales leadership to establish partner revenue and pipeline targets, improve forecast visibility, and use partner scorecards and QBRs to drive accountability.
  • Extend CenTrak’s market reach by leveraging partner networks, partner insights, and complementary channels.
  • Collaborate with Marketing to create programs and events that extend partner relationships to new prospects.
  • Monitor market trends, competitive dynamics, partner capability gaps, and growth opportunities to continuously improve the channel strategy.

Governance, Rules of Engagement, and Conflict Resolution

  • Define and enforce clear rules of engagement between Channel, field sales, Strategic Accounts, International Sales, National Accounts, Product, and other teams.
  • Establish and maintain deal registration, crediting, and governance frameworks that reduce ambiguity and minimize channel conflict.
  • Proactively manage and resolve channel conflict when multiple sales roles or partners are involved in the same account, facility, IDN, or use case.
  • Ensure clarity of partner management responsibilities versus end-user sales ownership.
  • Own one consistent partner program standard that applies across partner types while allowing execution responsibility to vary based on partner model and market coverage.

Partner Performance and Analytics

  • Develop and implement KPI frameworks, dashboards, and scorecards to measure partner revenue, pipeline, activation, productivity, certification, quality, on-time delivery, customer satisfaction, QBR cadence, and coverage effectiveness.
  • Partner with Sales Operations to implement data-driven performance management and continuously optimize program effectiveness based on insights and analytics.
  • Use Salesforce or other CRM/reporting tools to improve pipeline visibility, forecasting accuracy, partner accountability, and leadership confidence.
  • Establish partner scorecards and performance reviews that connect partner enablement, partner activity, and partner outcomes.
  • Work with Sales Operations, Finance, and leadership to support quota design, TAM/SAM/SOM analysis, partner heat maps, and performance-based partner governance.

Team Leadership and Cross-Functional Influence

  • Build and lead a high-performing Channel and Partner team focused on process discipline, scalability, accountability, collaboration, and continuous improvement.
  • Lead, mentor, and develop team members responsible for partner program operations, partner enablement, partner sales execution support, and new partner development.
  • Create a culture of ownership, empowerment, trust, and cross-functional alignment across the partner ecosystem and sales organization.
  • Lead through influence in a matrixed commercial organization, balancing partner needs, sales execution, customer outcomes, revenue growth, and operational discipline.
  • Provide leadership with forecasts, partner performance updates, strategic recommendations, and actionable insights into the health of partner relationships and partner-led growth.

Partner Ecosystem Scope

Category Accountability- Regional Resellers Enable and govern regional partners that resell CenTrak products and may provide consulting, software, implementation, or managed services.

Service Partners- Establish standards and accountability for subcontracted service delivery, implementation, maintenance, managed services, and related partner-led services.

National / Global Partners- Align broad partner relationships that may touch multiple regions, sales leaders, customer segments, and use cases.

Strategic Partners- Develop executive relationships, joint business plans, and growth strategies with priority strategic partners.

International Partners- Ensure global program standards are adopted while recognizing market-specific ownership and operating models.

Government Partners- Coordinate governance and support for government partner models where CenTrak relies on partner transaction support.

Technology / Integration Partners- Collaborate with Product and technical teams to evaluate fit, enable integrations, and expand market access.

New Partner Development- Identify, recruit, onboard, and activate new strategic, technical, service, and referral partners aligned to growth priorities.

Qualifications

Experience and Education

  • Bachelor’s degree required; MBA or advanced degree preferred.
  • 10 to 15+ years of experience in channel strategy, partner program leadership, enterprise sales, business development, or commercial program development.
  • Proven track record building scalable partner programs in enterprise technology, healthcare technology, healthcare software/hardware, RTLS, nurse call, hospital IT, or related markets.
  • Experience designing structured partner frameworks, including segmentation, tiering, onboarding, enablement, certification, governance, QBRs, and partner performance management.
  • Experience working alongside direct sales organizations with clear separation of partner ownership, end-user sales ownership, and sales execution responsibilities.
  • Demonstrated success managing partner relationships and collaborating with partners to drive end-user sales, pipeline growth, and partner satisfaction.
  • Proven success prospecting, building pipeline, moving opportunities through the sales cycle, and presenting solutions to C-level and other decision-makers.

Knowledge, Skills, and Abilities

  • Strong strategic and systems thinking with the ability to design scalable commercial and partner programs.
  • Deep understanding of channel dynamics, partner lifecycle models, conflict management, rules of engagement, and partner governance.
  • Highly data-driven, with experience developing KPIs, scorecards, dashboards, pipeline reporting, and performance analytics.
  • Strong executive presence and excellent verbal, written, listening, and presentation skills.
  • Ability to align diverse stakeholders across regions, functions, partner models, and commercial teams.
  • Strong leadership capability with experience building process-oriented, high-performing teams.
  • Change leadership experience in evolving go-to-market models and improving partner operating discipline.
  • Ability to create solutions using appropriate products and services based on customer and partner business goals.
  • Customer and partner service orientation, with a strong drive to meet or exceed expectations.

We're transforming the grocery industry

At Instacart, we invite the world to share love through food because we believe everyone should have access to the food they love and more time to enjoy it together. Instacart has become a lifeline for millions of people, and we’re building the team to help push our shopping cart forward. If you’re ready to do the best work of your life, come join our table.

Instacart is a Flex First team

There’s no one-size fits all approach to how we do our best work. Our employees have the flexibility to choose where they do their best work—whether it’s from home, an office, or your favorite coffee shop—while staying connected and building community through regular in-person events. Why this role is on the menu

Instacart's Strategic Finance team partners across the business to drive disciplined growth and long-term value creation. Within this group, the Retailer pod supports our Retail Partnerships organization as we expand and deepen relationships with grocers and retailers across North America.

In this role you will be the finance lead for retailer deal flow—setting financial strategy, shaping pricing philosophy, and driving portfolio-level decision-making across the full lifecycle of retailer partnerships. You will develop decision frameworks, build robust models, and advise senior leaders through high-stakes negotiations that shape Instacart’s revenue and margin profile. This is an individual contributor role to start, with a clear path to people management as the team grows. This person will report to the Director of Retailer Finance.

The ideal candidate brings deep deal and business development finance experience—ideally from a marketplace, platform, or consumer internet company—and is comfortable operating at the intersection of finance and commercial strategy.   • Analysts and managers in the pod are operating at a higher bar—stronger modeling rigor, sharper business judgment, and a culture of ownership that elevates the team's executive storytelling.

The secret ingredients we're looking for

Must-have pantry staples (Minimum Qualifications)

  • 8 or more years of recent experience in strategic finance, corporate finance, investment banking, private equity, or management consulting, with significant time spent directly supporting deal flow, business development, or commercial partnerships.
  • Bachelor's degree in Finance, Economics, Business, Mathematics, or equivalent practical experience.
  • Deep, hands-on deal experience: a track record of owning the finance workstream across a high volume of complex commercial agreements end-to-end, from initial scoping and pricing through negotiation, signature, and post-close performance tracking.
  • Experience as the senior finance partner in negotiations with C-suite and VP-level executives, both internally and externally, structuring contract terms that balance growth and unit economics across a fast-moving pipeline.
  • Advanced financial modeling skills in Excel or Google Sheets, including multi-scenario and sensitivity analyses for complex, multi-year agreements.
  • Strong command of accounting fundamentals and unit economics; ability to build, reconcile, and present partner- and portfolio-level P&Ls and cash flow impacts to executive audiences.

This role sits at the intersection of science, operations, and patient care—where robust clinical execution and smart, data-informed decisions accelerate both trials and future commercial delivery.

As a regional expert, you will guide treatment centers through complex cell therapy workflows, from site strategy and activation to ongoing operational and clinical oversight. You will connect frontline teams with internal experts, turning standards into daily practice and removing barriers that slow patient access. Can you envision yourself setting the pace for how advanced therapies are introduced and sustained across multiple sites?

This is a remote, regional role reporting to a Regional Operations Director and partnering closely with cross-functional leaders to build scalable, patient-centered service lines that uphold the highest quality and compliance standards.

Accountabilities:

  • Regional Site Strategy: Partner with regional leadership to shape site selection and expansion plans that accelerate patient access and trial readiness while ensuring sustainable operations.

  • Training and Mentorship: Design and deliver training for site staff and junior team members to elevate capability and consistency across the region.

  • Issue Management and Continuous Improvement: Respond constructively to SOP deviations, implement corrective actions, and share guidelines to strengthen system-wide performance.

  • Reporting and Insights: Lead research and internal reporting on standards, performance, and guidelines to inform governance and strategy across multiple countries and local contexts.

  • Travel: Travel up to 50% to engage with sites, support activations, and maintain ongoing operational oversight.

Essential Skills/Experience:

  • Bachelor’s degree or equivalent experience with detailed knowledge/hands-on experience in Cell Therapy (preferred: nursing, Life Sciences, healthcare administration, Business).

  • Experience selecting/overseeing external providers and developing contracts.

  • Advanced scientific degree or equivalent experience; broad understanding across patient operations, manufacturing interfaces, quality, regulatory, market access; project management experience.

  • Program/Quality qualifications (e.g., PMP, CPHQ).

  • Experience across academic/Sponsor settings and countries.

  • Early-phase delivery across product lifecycle and multiple therapeutic areas.

  • Salesforce or similar CRM experience.

In-person working gives us the platform we need to connect, work at pace and challenge perceptions. That's why we work, on average, a minimum of three days per week from the office. jobs.title: Senior Marketing Manager
jobs.excerpt: About Starbond Starbond is a high-speed direct-to-consumer brand on a mission to build incredible products and unforgettable customer experiences.
jobs.description:
About Starbond

Starbond is a high-speed direct-to-consumer brand on a mission to build incredible products and unforgettable customer experiences. We don’t do corporate fluff or autopilot campaigns. We’re hunting for a high-octane Senior Marketing Manager who can turn raw data, customer psychology, and relentless execution into pure, profitable scale.

About the Role

As our Senior Marketing Manager, you hold the keys to the entire Starbond DTC engine. You will own growth across paid ads, lifecycle, content, SEO, Answer Engine Optimization (AEO), social media, and site conversion.

This isn't just a marketing role—it’s a unit economics role. You live and breathe LTV, CAC, CAC payback, gross margins, and contribution margins. You’ll direct world-class agencies (Meta, Google, Email, AEO) and lead our internal creative crew, setting bold performance standards and delivering crystal-clear, fluff-free updates straight to the CEO.

Key Responsibilities

1. Scalable Acquisition & Growth

  • Build and scale high-performing acquisition channels across Meta, Google, Shopify, Email, SEO, and Amazon.

  • Drive profitable growth—optimizing for contribution margin and high-value customers, not just top-line revenue or vanity ROAS.

  • Establish strict CAC thresholds; scale what wins, pivot what stalls, and ruthlessly kill what loses money.

  • Synchronize ad creative, landing pages, offers, and inventory for seamless, high-converting customer journeys.

2. Retention & LTV Obsession

  • Master our LTV engine—analyzing repeat purchase rates, cohort health, and cross-sell dynamics to fuel acquisition strategy.

  • Design high-impact lifecycle campaigns that boost repeat orders, raise AOV, and turn one-time buyers into lifelong brand fans.

  • Keep email and lifecycle channels operating at peak deliverability, sharp segmentation, and undeniable revenue contribution.

3. Paid Media & Conversion Magic

  • Lead paid media strategy, budget pacing, creative testing frameworks, and attribution modeling.

  • Enforce a "data-first" rulebook: every budget shift or creative test must be backed by unit economics.

  • Team up with our web developer to turn our Shopify store into a frictionless, high-converting conversion engine.

4. Agency Command & Accountability

  • Keep external Meta, Google, Email, and AEO agencies on their toes using clear scorecards, tight SLAs, and bold performance targets.

  • Audit agency recommendations independently; demand rapid root-cause analysis when targets slip.

  • Protect the brand: ensure Starbond maintains total ownership of all ad accounts, tracking, dashboards, and creative IP.

5. Creative Execution & Team Leadership

  • Rally and mentor the internal marketing team with clear ownership, high standards, and fast feedback loops.

  • Build a rapid creative pipeline—briefing, testing, and scaling new hooks, ad angles, and formats every single week.

  • Protect brand equity by winning on value and story—never relying on lazy, margin-killing discounts.

  • Ship a weekly CEO scorecard that breaks down what moved, why it moved, and what we're executing next.

What Success Looks Like

  • Profitable Scale: Marketing dollars directly boost contribution margins and capture high-retention customer cohorts.

  • Flawless Velocity: Creative tests, ad launches, and agency deliverables hit the mark on time, every time.

  • Data Clarity: LTV, CAC, CAC payback, MER, and ROAS are tracked with absolute precision to steer every decision.

  • Uncompromising Ownership: Internal teams and agency partners operate with total alignment, urgency, and pride.

What We’re Looking For

  • DTC Battle-Tested: Proven track record running end-to-end growth for a fast-scaling DTC e-commerce brand.

  • Unit Economics Master: Deep, intuitive fluency in CAC, LTV, MER, Contribution Margin, and Cohort Retention.

  • Modern Stack Savvy: Hands-on experience with Meta Ads, Google Ads, Klaviyo (or similar), SEO/AEO tactics, and Shopify.

  • Agency Handler: Unafraid to challenge assumptions, audit agency performance, and demand top-tier results.

  • Natural Leader: Experience coaching creative teams, setting clear KPIs, and cultivating a culture of accountability.

  • Sharp Analytical Mind: Able to slice through noise, challenge weak data, and translate numbers into profitable action.

Candidates must be able to work 40 hours (9AM to 6PM Pacific Standard hours)

Boulevard provides the first and only client experience platform for appointment-based, self-care businesses. We empower our customers to give their clients more of the magical moments that matter most.

Before launching in 2016, our founders spent months interviewing salon managers and working behind front desks to understand their pain points so we could design a modern, user-friendly platform that meets the unique needs of their business. Our roots may be in hair salons, but we are built for the broader self-care industry, including many types of salons, spas, medspa, barbershops, and more. Our technology not only helps our customers survive but thrive. Take a look at how we (and YOU) can make that happen.

We have an insatiable curiosity and embrace experimentation. We believe that simple solutions require the most sophistication, and we design each and every detail to maximize potential, power, and impact. Do our values match? Read through our story and what we value the most.

Our team values and celebrates our diverse backgrounds. Being open about who we are and what we do allows us to do the best work of our lives. We believe in equal opportunity for all, and you should too.

About the Role

The Onboarding Specialist I is responsible for coordinating and executing customer onboarding projects from contract signature through successful activation. This role serves as the primary day-to-day project coordinator for customers during onboarding, helping ensure projects remain organized, on track, and aligned to onboarding milestones.This role will work across a range of customers to deliver a tailored onboarding experience based on their industry, size, and needs.

This role is ideal for individuals who are highly organized, customer-focused, and motivated to develop strong project management and implementation skills within a SaaS environment.

Director, Customer Solutions Architecture- Capital One Software, Databolt (Remote)

Ever since our first credit card customer in 1994, Capital One has recognized that technology and data can enable even large companies to be innovative and personalized. As one of the first large enterprises to go all-in on the public cloud, we built cloud and data management tools that didn’t exist in the marketplace to enable us to operate at scale. In 2022, we launched Capital One Software to help other businesses address these same needs.

About the Product: Databolt We are scaling our newest offering, Databolt—a pioneering data security and tokenization solution designed for the modern enterprise. Databolt is a data enabler, allowing companies across regulated and data-intensive sectors to balance data utility with strict privacy compliance.

Databolt sits at the intersection of critical enterprise shifts: securing Cloud Migrations and enabling safe Generative AI adoption. Built with a flexible architecture, Databolt integrates directly into modern cloud environments to secure data where it lives, requiring a seamless connection between our platform and the customer's infrastructure.

The Role We are seeking a Director, Solutions Architect who possesses a blend of deep infrastructure expertise, data security acumen, and executive presence. You will serve as the strategic technical anchor for our most critical accounts.

You will act as a bridge between the customer’s legacy past and their AI-driven future. You won't just be validating architecture; you will be leading workshops to align diverse stakeholders (from CISOs to Data Engineers) and collaborating with our partner ecosystem to ensure successful value delivery.

Key Areas of Focus:

  • Secure Cloud Migration: You understand that moving workloads from on-prem to the cloud is a transformation, not just a "lift and shift." You will guide customers on securing their migration journeys to modern platforms like Snowflake, Databricks, and major cloud data warehouses.

  • AI & Data Privacy Strategy: You will help customers navigate the emerging privacy challenges of Generative AI and Large Language Models (LLMs), specifically advising on how to prevent PII leakage within training sets and inference pipelines.

  • Cloud-Native Architecture & Integration: You will guide customers on how to best integrate our solution into their existing multi-cloud environments, utilizing your deep knowledge of Kubernetes and container orchestration to ensure a smooth, scalable deployment.

  • Executive Alignment & Workshops: You are comfortable leading the room. You will facilitate discovery workshops and strategy sessions to align C-Suite executives (CIO, CISO, CDO) and technical practitioners on the business value and architectural fit of Databolt.

  • Partner & SI Collaboration: Deployment in large enterprises often involves an ecosystem. You will collaborate closely with System Integrators (SIs) and Channel Partners, enabling them to implement our solution effectively.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Navigate Complex Stakeholder Maps: Identify and align technical decision-makers, economic buyers, and influencers across the organization. You will translate technical capabilities into clear business value for CxOs.

  • Lead Technical Discoveries: Dig deep into customer environments to understand their cloud infrastructure, data pipelines, and regulatory constraints (GDPR, PCI, PII) to determine the optimal Databolt fit.

  • Architect Scalable Solutions: Design and document implementation plans that align with the customer's cloud strategy, addressing questions regarding ingress/egress, latency, and resource management in Kubernetes environments.

  • Manage Partner Engagements: Act as the technical liaison for System Integrators involved in the customer's implementation, ensuring they are properly trained and aligned with our architectural standards.

  • Execute Proof of Concepts (POCs): Hands-on management of technical POCs, helping customers validate the solution against their specific use cases.

  • Champion Data Security: Educate customers on tokenization best practices, differentiating our solution from generic encryption, and mapping our capabilities to their compliance requirements.

Basic Qualifications:

  • Bachelor’s degree or Military experience

  • At least 7 years of experience in Solutions Architecture, Systems Engineering, or Technical Consulting for enterprise software

  • At least 4 years of experience with Kubernetes and Container Orchestration (for example: managing clusters, helm charts, deployments)

  • At least 3 years of experience with Data Security technologies (for example: Tokenization, Encryption, Key Management, or IAM)

  • At least 4 years of experience with public cloud platforms (for example: AWS, GCP, or Azure)

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Master’s Degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or Information Technology

  • Demonstrated understanding of cloud migration patterns and the modern data stack (for example: Snowflake, Databricks) and how security integrates into data pipelines

  • Familiarity with data privacy challenges in the context of AI/LLMs (for example: sanitizing training data, preventing model inversion attacks, PII leakage)

  • Experience architecting solutions for highly regulated or data-intensive industries (for example: Financial Services, Healthcare, Telecommunications, Retail)

  • Demonstrated success in leading workshops and presenting to C-level executives (for example: CIOs, CISOs, CDOs)

  • Demonstrated experience working with and managing technical relationships with System Integrators (SIs) and VARs

jobs.title: Technical Program Manager
jobs.excerpt: Portcast is a venture-backed, Singapore-based logistics technology startup helping freight forwarders turn data into better decisions and measurable business impact.
jobs.description:
Portcast is a venture-backed, Singapore-based logistics technology startup helping freight forwarders turn data into better decisions and measurable business impact. Portcast uses AI to surface shipment exceptions, cost risks, and the right actions, helping teams focus on the shipments that need their attention, keep freight costs under control, and make procurement decisions with confidence. Our vision is to be the AI data and intelligence layer that powers exception management and margin improvement on every shipment.

Founded in 2018 and backed by leading technology investors, we are a lean, globally distributed team building technology for an industry going through a major digital transformation.

ABOUT THE ROLE

You'll be the person accountable for the delivery state of our product initiatives once they move into execution. You'll report directly to our Senior Product Manager and make sure ownership is clear across Engineering, Data, and Solutions, work is progressing as expected, dependencies are being managed, and risks are surfaced early rather than when they become launch problems.

We're looking for someone who understands our product, technology, and data well enough to follow the work, understand why we're building something, spot when execution is drifting from the intended outcome, and know when to bring an issue back to Product for clarification.

This is a hands-on IC role and you'll be the first person in this role at Portcast, giving you the opportunity to shape how we manage and deliver product initiatives as we scale. This role requires daily working-hour overlap with our Asia-based Tech Team.

WHAT SUCCESS LOOKS LIKE IN THIS ROLE

  • No launch delays, cleaner releases, and shorter cycle times, driven by earlier identification of risks, dependencies, and blockers, better coordination across Product, Engineering, Data, and Solutions, and clearer visibility into what is moving, what is blocked, and what needs attention.

WHAT YOU’LL OWN

  • Own delivery from kickoff to release: Take ownership of the operational delivery state once a product initiative moves into execution. Make sure ownership is clear, work starts when expected, progress is visible, and initiatives continue moving through development, testing, and release.

  • Track dependencies and surface risks early: Monitor cross-functional dependencies, blockers, competing priorities, scope changes, and potential delays.

  • Coordinate across Product, Engineering, Data, and Solutions: Make sure teams know who owns what, dependencies are understood, and the right people have the context they need. Act as the central point of coordination so Product has a clear view of delivery.

  • Coordinate handover and launch readiness: Help coordinate the handover between Engineering, Data, Solutions, and Product so that the relevant teams have what they need for testing and acceptance.

  • Keep execution aligned with product intent: Understand the goals and key requirements behind an initiative well enough to spot when implementation appears to diverge from what was intended. Surface questions, gaps, or inconsistencies early and bring them back to Product for clarification before they become testing or release issues.

  • Maintain a clear source of truth: Keep tickets, timelines, project status, dependencies, key decisions, and risks up to date so that the team can quickly understand what is moving, what is blocked, and where attention is needed.

  • Keep delivery moving without creating bureaucracy: Bring structure, follow-through, and accountability to the delivery process without adding unnecessary processes. Join relevant standups and working sessions so you can identify issues and resolve them quickly.

WHAT WE’RE LOOKING FOR

  • Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related technical field.

  • At least 3+ years in project management, program management, delivery, product operations, or a similar role.

  • A proven ability to close things and keep initiatives moving: Experience managing projects or initiatives involving multiple technical and cross-functional teams in a startup or B2B SaaS environment, ideally in data-heavy domains, and even better in logistics tech or supply chain tech.

  • Understands data and strong technical foundation. You can read code, understand how systems and data pipelines fit together, and dig into the work alongside engineers and data scientists. You know the difference between a real blocker and noise.

  • Strong execution instincts: You naturally keep track of the details that others might miss. You chase loose ends, surface blockers, follow up on dependencies, and make sure decisions actually turn into action.

  • First-principles problem solving: When something is stuck or going off track, you understand why rather than simply following the existing process. You work out what needs to change and involve the right people to resolve it.

  • Comfort with ambiguity: You can create clarity when the requirements, ownership, or process aren't fully defined. You are comfortable making progress without having every answer upfront.

  • Strong cross-functional communication: You can translate between Product, Engineering, Data, and customer-facing teams. You know what different teams need to know, communicate clearly, and escalate issues early without creating unnecessary noise.

  • High ownership: You don't see your job as simply tracking whether someone completed a task. You take responsibility for the overall delivery state and stay on an issue until it is actually resolved.

  • Startup mindset: You enjoy working in a lean environment where there isn't a dedicated person for every function. You're willing to get into the details, solve problems yourself, and build lightweight processes when they are genuinely useful.

WHAT’S IN IT FOR YOU

  • Own a high-leverage problem: You'll be the person responsible for keeping delivery moving across teams, directly influencing how quickly and reliably we turn product ideas into something customers can use.

  • Work at the intersection of Product, AI, Data, and Logistics: Our products combine software, data, machine learning, and deep logistics expertise. You'll get exposure to complex product problems where the challenge isn't simply building software, but making sure data, models, workflows, and customer needs come together.

  • Real impact from day one: we’re lean by design so you'll have a high degree of ownership. There is no large PMO or layer of project managers around you. You'll need to be comfortable getting into the details, figuring things out independently, and knowing when something needs to be pushed, clarified, escalated, or simply solved.

  • Globally distributed, remote-first flexibility: work with a fully distributed team across Asia and Europe, built on trust, accountability, and collaboration.

OUR CORE VALUES GUIDE EVERYTHING WE DO

  • Curiosity: We dig into why something's slipping, not just how to patch it. We stay close to the work and the data.

  • Ownership: We act like founders. We hold a project together end to end and stay on it until it ships cleanly.

  • Raising the bar: We don't settle for "it launched." We aim for delivery that's predictable, aligned, and free of last-minute surprises.

  • Effective: We focus on shipping what was actually intended, on time, with real impact, not process for its own sake.

Join us at Portcast in our vision to become the AI data and intelligence layer that powers exception management and margin improvement on every shipment.

The Role

In a culture built on accountability, trust, and bold thinking, the Principal Architect, Cloud FinOps, plays a pivotal role in shaping the future of AI-ready connectivity. Working at the intersection of innovation and impact, this leader thrives in an environment where challenging work is embraced, expectations are clear, and meaningful contributions drive lasting value for customers, partners, and the industry.
As the enterprise’s technical authority for FinOps architecture, cloud economics, and financial governance, the Principal Architect leads the design of cost-aware cloud strategies across a complex multi-cloud ecosystem. By combining deep technical expertise with strategic business insight, this individual helps ensure that every cloud investment delivers measurable outcomes while supporting performance, scalability, resiliency, and security.
Partnering closely with Engineering, Enterprise Architecture, Finance, Cloud Platform teams, Strategic Sourcing, Product organizations, and Executive Leadership, the Principal Architect brings people and ideas together to solve complex challenges. Through collaboration and influence, they champion a shared vision of financial accountability and operational excellence across the cloud landscape.
Their impact extends beyond architecture design. By establishing enterprise standards, cloud consumption guardrails, unit economics frameworks, commitment optimization strategies, and migration blueprints, they create a foundation that empowers teams to innovate with confidence. Every decision is guided by a commitment to delivering business value, enabling sustainable growth, and helping the organization stay ahead in an increasingly connected, AI-driven world.

• FinOps Leadership

Partner with engineering teams to automate cost controls, budget management, policy enforcement, optimization recommendations, and reporting. Support FinOps platforms, dashboards, operational tooling, and promote Infrastructure-as-Code (IaC) and FinOps-as-Code practices.

• Executive Leadership

Present architecture strategies, cloud economics recommendations, and optimization roadmaps to senior leadership. Develop business cases, ROI analyses, TCO assessments, and cloud investment strategies. Mentor architects, engineers, and FinOps practitioners while driving enterprise-wide cloud financial accountability.

We are Folqs, a fast-growing D2C supplement brand in the United States focused on colostrum + beef organs.

Our goal is simple: bring in someone who can jump in, take ownership of our growth engine, and take Folqs to the next level.

What you'll own

  • Paid media: Own and scale Meta as the primary acquisition channel, with additional experience across Google and/or TikTok Paid
  • Creative strategy: Identify winning customer angles, hooks, messaging, formats, and concepts based on performance data and customer research

  • Scaling: Take proven creative and media-buying strategies and turn them into significant increases in profitable spend
  • Funnels: Work on advertorials, landing pages, VSLs, offers, and other conversion assets to improve overall acquisition efficiency
  • AI: Use AI aggressively to accelerate research, creative ideation, scripting, production, analysis, and workflows

What success looks like

We don't measure activity; we measure results. This is a 100% performance role focused on scaling spend while maintaining CAC ceiling.

Success means:

  • Scaling paid spend while maintaining healthy unit economics
  • Improving ROAS and reducing CPA
  • Increasing creative win rate and testing velocity
  • Finding new winning angles and audiences
  • Improving conversion rates across the funnel
  • Building a repeatable creative and media-buying system
  • Ultimately, taking Folqs to the next level

You are

  • 4–6+ years of experience creating performance creatives for D2C/eCommerce brands or eCommerce agencies (not B2B, not a generalist)
  • A proven Meta media buyer who has personally scaled campaigns, not just overseen them (at least $50k/month in ad spend)
  • Equally strong on creative strategy and performance marketing
  • Deeply experienced with direct-response advertising and customer psychology
  • Able to look at an ad account, creative performance, and funnel data and immediately identify what needs to change
  • Experienced scaling DTC/eCommerce brands - not B2B, SaaS, lead generation, or general marketing
  • Hands-on with creative: you can write or heavily edit hooks, scripts, headlines, briefs, and landing page copy
  • Experienced managing creative production with UGC creators, editors, and designers
  • An operator, not a consultant. You don't just make recommendations - you execute, test, learn, and scale
  • Comfortable working directly with founders and taking significant ownership with minimal hand-holding
  • AI-native: you use AI daily to accelerate research, creative development, analysis, and execution
  • Fast-moving, highly analytical, and obsessed with finding what works

Strong bonus points

  • Experience scaling supplements, health, wellness, beauty, or other DTC consumer brands
  • Experience with advertorials, VSLs, or aggressive direct-response funnels
  • Experience with TikTok Paid / Spark Ads
  • Experience with Outbrain or Taboola
  • Experience with tools such as Triple Whale, Northbeam, Motion, Foreplay, or similar
  • Strong understanding of FTC/FDA considerations for supplement advertising

Important: Who this role is NOT for

This is not a fit if:

  • You've managed less than $50K/month in ad spend
  • Your background is primarily organic social or influencer marketing
  • You're primarily a creative strategist who doesn't understand media buying
  • You're primarily a media buyer who relies on someone else for all creative strategy
  • You've worked mainly in B2B, SaaS, lead generation, or non-eCommerce environments
  • You're looking for a role where someone else tells you what to do

We want someone who can walk into an eCommerce brand, look at the numbers and the creative, figure out what's broken, and start making it better immediately.

Schedule

  • Design, build, and support scalable data pipelines, data products, and data applications that serve business and analytics needs.

  • Contribute to estimates, delivery planning, and solution design for new data initiatives and enhancements.

  • Maintain ongoing professional development in modern data, cloud, and engineering practices to help keep AstraZeneca current with a changing technology landscape.

Mandatory Skills

  • Strong software engineering background, with hands-on experience building production-grade solutions using sound engineering principles such as modular design, testing, code review, and maintainability.

  • Strong Python engineering skills, including building reusable packages, APIs, automation scripts, data processing components, and integration services.

  • Hands-on experience designing and operating solutions in Snowflake, including virtual warehouse configuration, resource monitors, governance, and performance tuning.

  • Expert SQL for analytics and transformation, with strong skills in query optimization, pruning, caching behavior, and result set reuse.

  • Experience building robust pipelines into Snowflake with tools such as dbt, Airflow, dataops.live, Fivetran, AWS Glue, or AWS Lambda, with strong understanding of staging patterns, incremental loads, CDC, retries, error handling, and observability.

  • Practical experience with data modeling, including dimensional and normalized approaches, and strong understanding of schema design, standardization, clustering keys, micro-partitioning, and workload/performance strategies.

  • Experience with dbt modeling layers, materializations, testing, project configuration, documentation standards, and data contracts.

  • Experience implementing automated testing and quality controls for data solutions, including unit, integration, and data validation testing.

  • Strong experience with CI/CD pipelines, Git-based workflows, and deployment automation for data and application components.

  • Experience with DevOps/DataOps practices, including environment management, release management, infrastructure automation, monitoring, and production support.

  • Experience integrating Python-based data engineering solutions with serverless and cloud-native services, such as AWS Lambda and AWS Glue.

  • Demonstrated track record delivering solutions on modern data platforms such as Snowflake or Redshift, and integrating them with downstream analytics or visualization tools.

  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, including diagnosing and resolving production issues in complex data environments.

  • Ability to translate business requirements into reliable technical solutions and data products with clear ownership, SLAs, and acceptance criteria.

  • Strong understanding of FAIR data principles and data product best practices, including discoverability, metadata, lineage, interoperability, access controls, versioning, and consumer-oriented design.

  • Effective working independently and within cross-functional, cross-cultural teams, with the ability to communicate technical concepts clearly to non-technical stakeholders.

  • Demonstrable passion for learning and for improving engineering practices across a team.

Desired Skills

  • Experience using Starburst/Trino for distributed SQL across heterogeneous data sources.

  • Familiarity with Terraform, GitHub Actions, and highly automated platform or pipeline delivery patterns.

  • Experience with infrastructure as code and environment provisioning in cloud-based data platforms.

  • Familiarity with metadata and catalog tooling such as Collibra to improve lineage, standards adoption, reuse, and observability.

  • Experience using PySpark for large-scale data processing and transformation in distributed environments.

  • Experience building lightweight application or service layers that complement data pipelines, such as APIs, internal tools, or operational utilities.

  • Experience mentoring peers and helping establish engineering standards across a team or community of practice.

Summary

The Full Stack Data Engineer is responsible for the design, development, deployment, and operational support of scalable data products and data applications in a DevOps/DataOps delivery model. This role combines strong data engineering expertise with a solid software engineering background, especially in Python, cloud-native development, and engineering automation.

The role is expected not only to build reliable data solutions, but also to raise engineering maturity across the team by disseminating best practices in software design, testing, CI/CD, observability, reuse, and operational excellence.

jobs.description:
About Us:

STACK is a leading provider of cloud-based construction estimating and takeoff software solutions, committed to helping businesses transform through innovative solutions. We pride ourselves on fostering a collaborative, dynamic environment where team members have the opportunity to grow and make a real impact.

About the Role:

We are hiring aSenior Computer Vision Engineerto improve our computer vision system for construction documents. This role focuses on detection and segmentation quality, geometric accuracy, and production-grade pipelines that work reliably with messy real-world PDFs and drawings.

What You’ll Do:

  • Design, build, and improve end-to-end detection and segmentation pipelines for document images.
  • Improve document ingestion for PDFs and other unstructured files, including parsing, rendering, and handling of multi-page and multi-view content.
  • Increase model accuracy, boundary and geometric quality, and overall reliability of predictions for downstream use.
  • Integrate modern detection and segmentation models into production workflows and build the post-processing that turns model output into structured, usable geometry.
  • Define evaluation metrics, investigate failure cases, and drive continuous quality improvements.
  • Optimize latency, reliability, and cost across the inference and post-processing stack.
  • Own training infrastructure, dataset curation, annotation quality, and continuous-improvement loops.
  • Make architectural decisions and own system quality end to end.

What You Bring:

  • 5+ years experience building computer vision systems: detection, segmentation, or structured geometry extraction, used high volume in production.
  • Experience working with messy, real-world image data or large unstructured visual datasets.
  • Strong understanding of detection and segmentation tradeoffs, including model architecture choices, training data design, and post-processing.
  • Ability to measure system performance with evaluation, testing, and production metrics.
  • Ability to explain failure modes clearly and improve systems through debugging, dataset work, and iteration.
  • Experience with multimodal models (vision-language models, document AI systems)
  • Understanding of grounding — linking model outputs to source data or coordinates
  • Backend engineering experience, including APIs, async processing, and scalable GPU services.

Additional Preferred Qualifications:

  • Experience with polygon or mask post-processing, geometric regularization, or CAD-style structured output.
  • Experience with layout-aware document processing, PDF vector extraction, or combining raster and vector signals.
  • Background in document-heavy CV domains such as construction, real estate, medical imaging, geospatial, or similar workflows.
  • Experience optimizing inference cost and latency at scale.
  • Familiarity with open-source detection / segmentation ecosystems, training infrastructure, or model serving.

What Success Looks Like:

  • Accurate, geometrically correct predictions suitable for downstream measurement, and analysis use.
  • Fast, reliable inference across large and messy real-world document sets.
  • Clear quality metrics and a repeatable improvement loop.
  • Systems that perform consistently under real-world production constraints.

What This Role is Not:

  • Not a model-training-only role. You'll own data, training, post-processing, and serving.
  • Not a research-only role.
  • Not a plug-and-play CV tools environment.

Why Join STACK?

  • Opportunity to work in a fast-paced, growth-oriented, remote-first environment.
  • Async-friendly environment with a focus on ownership and deep work.
  • Be part of a dynamic, supportive team where your contributions are valued.

At STACK, our values shape how we work, collaborate, and serve our customers:

  • Radical Honesty:Communicate directly, respectfully, and transparently—even when conversations are difficult. Give and receive feedback with care.
  • Customer Obsession:Put the customer at the center of every decision. Solve real problems, follow through, and measure success by customer outcomes.
  • Move With Purpose:Take thoughtful action, remain accountable, and own both successes and mistakes. Anticipate what’s next and adapt as you learn.
  • Grow Together:Share knowledge, collaborate across teams, and invest in one another’s development. Celebrate collective wins and treat setbacks as opportunities to learn.

We are an equal opportunity employer and value diversity at our company. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, or disability status. We are committed to building a team that represents a variety of backgrounds, perspectives, and skills. The more inclusive we are, the better our work will be.

We are interested in every qualified candidate who is eligible to work in the United Kingdom. However, we are not able to sponsor visas.

We take into account an individual’s qualifications, skillset, and experience in determining final salary. This role is eligible for health insurance (medical, dental & vision), life insurance, 401(k) & paid time off. The actual offer will be at the company’s sole discretion and determined by relevant business considerations, including the final candidate’s qualifications, years of experience, skillset, and geographic location.

RHI Magnesita is seeking a Warehousing & Inventory Specialist to support inventory accuracy, warehouse operations, and third-party logistics (3PL) performance across North America.
