jobs.description:
Hello! ✨

We’re Wildix, a global leader in Unified Communications & Collaboration as a Service (UCaaS) and we’re on a mission to redefine how businesses connect. Our secure, web-based and AI-powered solutions help companies around the world collaborate smarter, serve customers better and grow stronger — and we want you to help shape what’s next.

About Us…

In 2005, brothers Dimitri and Steve Osler set out to reimagine how businesses communicate, and that vision became Wildix. Today, from our headquarters in Tallinn, Estonia, Wildix is one of the world’s fastest-growing UCaaS companies, with 300+ team members from 15+ nationalities, working across Europe, the UK, the Americas and beyond. We serve businesses in 135+ countries through a partner-first ecosystem, delivering secure, intuitive solutions that keep companies connected, productive and ready for what’s next.

At Wildix, we don’t just build technology, we live it. As a remote-first company, we rely on our own platform every day to collaborate globally and innovate fast. With steady growth and a strong foundation, we offer real opportunities to advance your career as we scale, making an impact in a global team that’s shaping the future of work.

At Wildix, our mission is clear: Empower companies worldwide with seamless communication solutions that drive productivity, efficiency, and growth.

About The Role…

We are looking for a Senior FP&A Manager to build Wildix’s FP&A function from the ground up. Working directly with the CFO, you will establish the financial models, forecasting and performance-management practices that enable leadership to make informed decisions and drive sustainable growth.

This is a hands-on, high-impact role for someone who enjoys turning complex business and financial data into clear insights and actionable recommendations. You will work cross-functionally with Sales, Marketing, Product/R&D, Accounting and Data/BI, while helping shape the processes, reporting and infrastructure that will support Wildix as it scales.

As the function grows, you will have the opportunity to shape its long-term strategy, processes and future team.

What You Will Do…

  • Own Wildix’sannual budget, rolling forecasts and long-term plan, connecting operational drivers to revenue, profitability and cash-flow.
  • Builddriver-based ARR and revenue models covering new business, expansion, downsell, churn, pricing, customer and partner activity.
  • DevelopWildix’s SaaS performance framework, including retention, unit economics, sales efficiency, Rule of 40 and R&D investments performance.
  • Leadmonthly financial performance reviews, explain results against budget and forecast, and recommend specific actions to address risks and opportunities.
  • Partner closely withSales, RevOps, Marketing, Product/R&D and other business leaders to improve forecasting accuracy, challenge assumptions and support ROI-based investment decisions.
  • Evaluatepricing, hiring, market, product and growth investments through scenario analysis, business cases and market, product and customer profitability
  • Prepare concise management, Board and investor reporting that clearly communicates performance, outlook, key drivers and strategic trade-offs.
  • Work with Accounting and Data/BI to reconcile KPIs to financial results and build scalable, increasingly automated FP&A processes, systems and reporting.

What You Will Bring…

  • 7+ years of experience in FP&A, Corporate Finance or Strategic Finance, ideally within B2B SaaS, technology or another recurring-revenue business.
  • Strong track record of building and owning financial models, budgets, rolling forecasts and multi-year plans, with the ability to connect operational drivers to P&L, cash flow and business performance.
  • Strong understanding of SaaS and subscription economics, including ARR/MRR, NRR/GRR, churn, expansion, CAC/payback, gross margin and sales efficiency.
  • Excellent analytical and commercial judgment, with the ability to challenge assumptions, identify business drivers and turn complex analysis into clear recommendations for senior stakeholders.
  • Strong experience with financial controls, data reconciliation and KPI governance, particularly across operational, CRM, BI and accounting data.
  • Excellent communication and presentation skills, with the ability to create clear, concise and visually compelling management and Board materials.
  • Advanced Excel/Google Sheets skills and strong data fluency, with experience working across ERP, CRM and BI environments. SQL and experience with FP&A/planning platforms are a strong plus.
  • A hands-on, ownership-driven mindset and the ability to build new models, processes and capabilities in a fast-evolving international environment.

Bonus Points If You Have

  • Experience in an international, multi-entity and multi-currency SaaS business.
  • Experience working in a partner- or channel-led commercial model.
  • Experience implementing or significantly improving an FP&A, planning or management-reporting system.
  • Exposure to due diligence, fundraising or transaction-readiness activities.

Why You’ll Love It Here

💻 Remote-First, With Office Access Where Available – Work remotely from wherever you do your best work, with the option to use one of our offices where available in your location. We trust our people to work autonomously while staying connected with their teams.

👫 Work with a Supportive, High-Performing Team – We believe in trust, autonomy, and working with bright, passionate individuals who drive real impact.

🌍 A Truly International Workplace – Join a diverse, global team and collaborate with colleagues and customers across different countries, cultures, and time zones.

🚀 Shape the Future of Global Communication – Be part of a team transforming how businesses communicate and collaborate in an era of remote work and AI-powered technology.

💼 Join a Profitable & Stable Company – We’re not a startup experiment. We’re a two-decade-old success story with sustained profitability, giving us the stability to think long-term and back bold ideas.

What We Offer

🏖️ Flexible Time Off – Take the breaks you need to relax, recharge, and come back refreshed.

💻 Great Tools & Technology – Love Mac? So do we. We provide the tools and technology you need to do your best work.

🚀 Career Growth & Development – Access learning opportunities, programs, and industry events to keep developing your skills and career.

💰 Competitive Compensation – The total compensation for this role is between €90K and €130K gross per year. The final offer will depend on your skills, experience, and work location.

And that’s not all. Our benefits are tailored to each country, so your recruiter can provide you with the full details applicable to your location.

Interview Process

🔎 Step 1: Initial Screening – A chat with our Talent Team to understand your background, experience, and motivations. (30 mins)

👤 Step 2: Role-Specific Interview – A deep dive with your manager, Chief Finance Officer, and the Chief Strategy Officer to assess your skills and fit for the role. (60 mins)

🤝 Step 3: Final Interview – A conversation with the founders and investors to ensure alignment with our expectations and company direction. (60 mins)

🎯Step 4: Final CFO Interview – A final interview with the CFO focused on your overall fit, strategic thinking, business perspective, and alignment with the company’s goals. This stage may also include a practical exercise to assess your ability to apply your expertise to a real-life business scenario. (60 mins)

We Are Wildix

Wildix is an equal-opportunity employer. We value diversity and welcome all applicants regardless of race, gender, age, religion, or any other characteristic. Everyone is encouraged to apply and is welcome to join our Blue Ecosystem.

Ready to join us? Apply Now!

Key Skills And Experience

Must-Have:

  • Strong experience with ServiceNow or other ITSM platforms.

  • Expertise in Problem, Change, Incident, and Major Incident Management.

  • Excellent stakeholder management and communication skills.

  • Strong analytical, risk assessment, and decision-making capabilities.

  • Experience managing CABs in complex enterprise environments.

We are the multicloud solutions experts. We combine our expertise with the world’s leading technologies — across applications, data and security — to deliver end-to-end solutions. You will focus on enterprise customers in the Banking, Insurance, and Wealth Management industries. This role includes responsibility for meeting sales quota and pipeline forecasting. You will build close relationships with customers, AWS, and ServiceNow field sellers while leading virtual teams including solution sales, solution consulting, partner, product, and operations.

This is a key and strategic role that requires a balance of sales, strategy and a roll-up your sleeves and 'get it done' attitude. Success requires the execution of a plan to develop and accelerate the growth of AWS revenue both with top existing customers and to land new enterprise customers. You must be a highly motivated team player with expertise working in a fast paced, cross-functional manner where change is constant. You have the ability to establish broad senior level relationships. You have a proven track record of delivering results and getting things done. You demonstrate strong business acumen, have outstanding communication skills and are able to effectively build relationships, negotiate complex contracts and influence large purchase decisions for the biggest brands in the world.

What you get to do in this role:

  • Create an AWS sales plan with Americas leadership to drive growth and then bring it to life.  Leverage your passion for driving sales results to close.

  • Build trust and deep multi-tiered relationships through the customers' organization, from business unit teams to CxO level

  • Work with the greater ServiceNow solution teams to develop a ServiceNow solution based on the customer's strategic outcomes

  • Manage relationships between ServiceNow, AWS and executive-level customers

  • Present the value of the partnership evangelizing joint innovation use cases

  • Negotiate complex contracts

  • Build mindshare within AWS field sales leadership and account teams to drive sales

  • Develop a clear roadmap across the customer, AWS and ServiceNow teams to promote an outstanding customer experience

  • Ensure customers are at the center of everything.  Deliver high-value outcomes for customers

  • Ensure alignment with Value Selling (ie: Value Prompter), NowSell principles and partner 3-way sales

  • Tackle strategic projects to smooth hyperscaler adoption across ServiceNow inclusive of operations, finance, reporting, enablement, and deal desk.

  • Responsible for weekly pipeline reporting, progress updates, customer references, deal registration

  • Work with marketing to plan events, land public customer references and drive customer engagement including stage presence at major events

In order to be successful in this role, we need someone who has:

  • 10+ years of experience in large client management, and aligning account strategies to revenue opportunities

  • 5+ years of experience as a Client Director or equivalent role with validated multi-million-dollar sales solutions experience and Executive level relationship management

  • Previous sales experience in IT Service Management, HR, Security Operations, Customer Service and IT Operations Management (within software or IT sales organizations)

  • Ability to understand broad, macro-level business and IT needs for the largest, most well-known brands in the world

  • Background experience from a career working at ServiceNow and/or AWS

  • Strong track record of exceeding sales targets by 150-200%

  • High energy, enthusiasm, and passion for the business.

  • Excellent understanding of growing and sustaining businesses in a highly competitive and changing marketplace

  • Comfortable with ambiguity, complexity, and thinking on multiple levels of abstraction; demonstrates use of critical thinking techniques.

  • Excellent spoken and written communication, interpersonal, relationship building skills

  • Experience leading virtual and matrixed teams

  • ServiceNow platform and AWS Cloud Practitioner training a plus (not required)

  • Travel up to 50%

Job Responsibilities

Shipment & Freight Coordination

  • Book international inbound sea and air freight shipments while selecting cost-effective routing options
  • Monitor cargo-ready, departure, arrival, and customs clearance milestones
  • Track delays or discrepancies and proactively implement resolution measures
  • Communicate shipping schedules, updates, and routine delays to relevant internal teams

Supplier & Broker Liaison

  • Manage day-to-day operational relationships with suppliers and freight forwarders
  • Follow up with suppliers and forwarders to ensure agreed shipping dates are achieved
  • Liaise with freight forwarders and customs brokers regarding container availability, clearance, and delivery

Documentation & System Management

  • Prepare and verify shipping documentation including commercial invoices, packing lists, bills of lading, airway bills, and certificates
  • Maintain accurate shipping records and update relevant ERP systems
  • Monitor freight costs, identify consolidation opportunities, and prepare regular operational reports

Requirements

  • Minimum 2 to 3 years of experience in international shipping, freight forwarding, or logistics
  • Demonstrated experience coordinating sea and air freight, including LCL and FCL shipments
  • Sound understanding of shipping documentation, Incoterms, and customs clearance processes
  • Awareness of freight cost drivers with a strong focus on cost-effective decision-making and space utilisation

Nice-to-Have Skills

  • Experience coordinating freight within the furniture or interior design sectors
  • Hands-on experience using ERP systems, with Options ERP highly regarded

Benefits

  • Permanent work-from-home set-up
  • Dayshift (Australian Eastern Daylight Time business hours)
  • Full-time opportunity
  • HMO (STAFF only)

  • Christmas Bonus equivalent to 1 month's wage (pro-rate)

jobs.description:
At Talkspace, we are committed to fostering a diverse, equitable, inclusive, and belonging-centered workplace where everyone can thrive while making a difference in mental health. Want to help over two million people receive quality mental healthcare? Come join our mission of getting therapy in the hands of everyone!

We are looking for a Payor Success Associate to join ourteam. The Payor Success Associate is responsible for handling a higher level of contacts and back-office processes, including Health Plan Support, Customer Success inquiries, unmatched clients/members, VIP escalations, internal escalations, and ad hoc items. They will prioritize incoming requests and adjust workflows accordingly to ensure efficient and effective resolution of issues. Additionally, they will serve as a liaison between the Payor Success team and customer support to provide assistance with client/member-facing questions. The Payor Success Associate is committed to continuous improvement and identifies, develops, and implements processes that enhance Talkspace's services, contributing to the evolution of internal processes and workflows. In close collaboration with the product team, they identify trending and new issues, proposing short and long-term solutions, while fostering teamwork by actively sharing client feedback, feature requests, and enhancement opportunities across various departments. To work at Talkspace, you need to be as passionate as we are about our work, and excited to partner with us on delivering quality mental healthcare.

This is a remote position based on Eastern Time. Talkspace Headquarters is located in NYC.

What You’ll Do

  • Payor Success Support
    • Handle higher level of contacts and back-office processes, including but not limited to:
      • Health Plan Support
      • Customer Success inquiries
      • Unmatched clients/members
      • VIP escalations
      • Internal escalations
      • Ad hoc items, as needed
    • Prioritize all incoming requests and adjust workflow as needed.
    • Assist the customer support team with client/member facing
      questions, as needed.
  • Process Improvement
    • Identify, develop and implement processes that allow Talkspace to continuously deliver new and enhanced services.
    • Identify and implement improvements to internal processes and
      workflows.
  • Team Collaboration
    • Work with the product team to identify trending/new issues, including short & long term solutions.
    • Collaborate closely with other teams, sharing client feedback,
  • Perform other related duties as assigned.

About You

  • Bachelor's Degree is preferred.
  • 2+ years of professional experience in Customer Service.
  • Proficiency working with Jira, Confluence, Google Workplace, Zendesk, Looker.
  • Attention to detail.
  • Client-centric approach to work.
  • Excellent communication and collaboration skills.

Benefits

  • Comprehensive Medical, Dental and Vision plans
  • Pre-tax benefits: HSA/ FSA
  • 401k Retirement Savings Program with matching up to 4%
  • Voluntary benefits including disability, basic life or pet insurance, etc.
  • Monthly Wellness Stipend to promote mental and physical self-care
  • Flexible PTO and Remote First Environment
  • Regular team events, including Wellness Workshops and Team Building Events
  • Free access to Talkspace products for you and one household member, as well as access to a friends and family discount!

Compensation

At Talkspace, we believe that pay transparency during the interview process is a critical part of diversity, equity, and inclusion. Our salary bands are based on internal and external compensation benchmarks, which we regularly evaluate to ensure we pay competitively.

The base salary range for this role is between $40,000 - $70,000. Within the salary bands, leveling corresponds to each candidate’s relevant experience, skills as assessed during the interview process, education, and applicable certifications.

Why Talkspace?

Talkspace is the world’s leading online therapy company, serving over 2 million users looking to begin their wellness journey through tele-health. According to the World Health Organization, close to 1 billion people worldwide live with a mental disorder, and on average more than 75% with mental, neurological, and substance use disorders receive no treatment for their condition at all. Additionally, one-third of the world’s population – 2 billion people – live in countries that spend less than 1% of their health budgets on mental health. Therapy is an universal need and it's our mission here to change the world by cultivating an intentional space for people to feel supported through quality care that is simple and accessible.

Combining our passion for innovation along with our desire to help others overcome the stigma behind “getting help,” we are transforming the way patients find the right care provider, making an otherwise impossible feat easily conquerable. Our network of licensed, accredited, and board-certified clinicians are increasing access to mental health for our members through a myriad of high quality therapy services: anytime and for a fraction of the price. Dedicated to our mission, we are looking for candidates that want to bring their talents into a diverse “for purpose” space. If you’re equally as passionate about making quality mental healthcare accessible to all then Talkspace is the right place for you!

EQUAL OPPORTUNITY EMPLOYER

Talkspace welcomes and celebrates talent from all backgrounds, perspectives, and walks of life to foster an innovative and diverse workforce. We encourage you to apply, even if you don’t meet every qualification or if your path has been nontraditional — such as not completing a formal degree program, taking a career break, or having a prior criminal record — if you believe you could make a great addition to this team. Come as you are and learn about the exciting opportunities on our team.

Individuals seeking employment at Talkspace are considered without regard to race, color, religious creed, sex, national origin, citizenship status, age, physical or mental disability, sexual orientation, marital, parental, veteran or military status, unfavorable military discharge, or any other status protected by applicable federal, state or local law.

How do we define Diversity, Equity, Inclusion, and Belonging at Talkspace?

Diversity

Diversity encompasses the unique attributes of our employees as individuals. We value and embrace the richness arising from their varied backgrounds, perspectives, and experiences, which include, but are not limited to, age, ability, ethnicity, gender, race, and cultural background.

Equity

Equity refers to a fair and impartial workplace, aiming to ensure equal growth and advancement opportunities for all employees. This involves amplifying underrepresented voices, addressing unconscious biases, and providing inclusive, culturally competent mental health care.

Inclusion

Inclusion signifies the practice of granting equal access to opportunities and resources for all employees, particularly those who might otherwise be excluded or marginalized. It ensures that everyone feels a sense of belonging, value, support, and respect as an individual.

Belonging

Belonging reflects the affinity and positive relationships that develop among employees from diverse backgrounds when businesses actively promote diversity, equity, and inclusion in the workplace.

About Zuma

Zuma is pioneering the future of agentic AI and our focus is to transform the rental market experience for consumers and property manager alike. Our innovative platform is engineered from the ground up to boost operations efficiency and enhance support capabilities for property management business across the US and Canada, a ~$200B market.
Off the back of our Series-A in early 2024, Zuma is scaling rapidly. Achieving our vision requires a team of passionate, innovative individuals eager to leverage technology to redefine customer-business interactions. We're on the hunt for exceptional talent ready to join our mission and contribute to building a groundbreaking technology that reshapes how businesses engage with customers.
Zuma has raised over $17M in funding to date and has support from world-renowned investors, including Andreessen Horowitz (a16z), Y Combinator, King River, Range Ventures, and distinguished angel investors like YC’s former COO, Qasar Younis.

The Role

As a Support Engineer at Zuma, you’ll be a bridge between our customers, engineering team, and product vision. You’ll ensure new customers onboard smoothly, integrations run reliably, and support operations scale as we grow. This is a hands-on role for someone who loves problem-solving, can dive into APIs and databases, and takes pride in clear documentation and communication. You’ll help property managers succeed with our AI platform while also driving continuous improvements in our internal tools and processes.

Why This Could Be Your Dream Role

  • You want to work at a company where customers feel your impact every day
  • You'll have autonomy to design and implement innovative technical solutions
  • Your work will directly impact thousands of apartment communities and millions of renters
  • You'll receive significant equity in a venture-backed company with strong traction
  • As we scale, your role and influence will grow with the company

Why You Might Want to Think Twice

  • This is a demanding role that will often require extended hours and deep commitment
  • As a founding team member, you'll need to wear multiple hats and step outside your comfort zone
  • You'll need to make thoughtful tradeoffs between innovation and immediate needs
  • You'll interact directly with customers to understand their needs and occasionally travel to their offices
  • We're a startup - priorities can shift rapidly as we respond to market opportunities and customer needs
  • If you're not comfortable getting your hands dirty with legacy code or speaking directly with customers, this isn't the job for you

Responsibilities

  • Maintain and help debug Zuma’s internal admin onboarding tool for new customers
  • Configure and manage backend feature flags for customers
  • Ensure API integrations between Zuma and property management systems (PMS) / CRMs are set up and fully functional
  • Keep integration documentation accurate and up-to-date (and improve it for easier adoption)
  • Debug existing integration issues when regressions occur
  • Investigate and report on basic AI hallucination issues and knowledge base inconsistencies
  • Collaborate with engineering to automate repetitive tasks and improve onboarding/support workflows

Skills & Experience

  • Basic coding ability (Python or JavaScript) for automation and small improvements
  • Familiarity with databases (MongoDB / Postgres)
  • Strong understanding of APIs and ability to debug integration issues
  • Clear written and verbal communication skills (especially in explaining technical issues to non-technical audiences)
  • Attention to detail with a knack for documenting processes clearly and efficiently
  • Bonus: Prior experience supporting SaaS or AI-driven platforms

Other Benefits

  • Great health insurance, dental, and vision.
  • Gym and workspace stipends.
  • Computer and workspace enhancements.
  • Unlimited PTO.
  • Company off-sites with the team.
  • Opportunity to play a critical role in building the foundations of the company and Engineering culture.

Pay Plan Title:Claims Specialist III

Working Title:Claims Specialist III

FLSA Status:Exempt

Office Location:Remote within North Carolina

POSTING DETAILS:

Make an Impact

Trillium Health Resources is a Tailored Plan and Managed Care Organization (MCO) serving 46 counties across North Carolina. We manage services for individuals with serious mental health needs, substance use disorders, traumatic brain injuries, and intellectual/development (IDD) disabilities. Our mission is to help individuals and families build strong foundations for healthy, fulfilling lives.

Why Work for Us?

Trillium believes that empowering others begins with supporting our team. We offer our employees:

  • A collaborative, mission-driven work environment
  • Competitive benefits and work-from-home options for most positions
  • Opportunities for professional growth in a diverse inclusive culture

Every day, our work changes lives – from children thriving through early intervention and school-based therapies, to adults with severe mental illness living independently and contributing to their communities.

If you are looking for a unique opportunity to make a tangible impact on the lives of others, apply today!

What We’re Looking For

Trillium Health Resources has a career opening for a Claims Specialist III to join our Claims team! The Claims Specialist III is responsible for managing and coordinating claim issues received by providers, members, or other entities via telephone call, email, and ticket system.The coordination of claim issues includes providing support and information to the provider community. This position will research and gather necessary information regarding claim issues and relay the resolution and/or summary of these issues to the provider community. The Claims Specialist III will also be responsible for tracking, reviewing, and coordinating timely and accurate responses that may include inquiries, claims issues, and escalations submitted by the State Department.

On a typical day, you might:

  • Coordinate and manage calls and tickets.
  • Ensure claims ticket queue and call logs are updated and responded to timely to allow for timely notifications to the provider community on the resolution and/or summary of their issues.
  • Conduct claims research, including, but not limited to, review of claims processing system, review of previous and current tickets in the Claims Support Queue, review of paper claim logs, working with other claims staff to learn history, third party biller impacts, Remittance Advice notifications and provider technical assistance.
  • Assist with drafting provider related communications.
  • Review trends of provider issues and make recommendations for updates needed in the Claims Processing System and Claims Staff training.

Employee Benefits:

Trillium knows that work/life balance is essential. That’s why we offer:

  • Typical working hours: 8:30 am – 5:00 pm; flexible work schedules with some roles with management approval.
  • Work-from-home options available for most positions
  • Health Insurance with no premium for employee coverage
  • Flexible Spending Accounts
  • 24 days of Paid Time Off (PTO) plus 12 paid holidays in your first year
  • NC Local Government Retirement Pension (defined-benefit plan)
  • 401k with 5% employer match and immediate vesting
  • Public Service Loan Forgiveness (PSLF) qualifying employer
  • Quarterly stipend for remote work supplies

Qualifications

Required:

  • High school diploma or GED and six (6) years of experience managing deadlines, preparing and reviewing written correspondence, and maintaining records or research in a healthcare or public health setting, including extensive medical claims research; OR
  • Associate's degree and four (4) years of experience managing deadlines, preparing and reviewing written correspondence, and maintaining records or research in a healthcare or public health setting, including extensive medical claims research; OR
  • Bachelor's degree and two (2) years of experience managing deadlines, preparing and reviewing written correspondence, and maintaining records or research in a healthcare or public health setting, including extensive medical claims research; OR
  • Equivalent combination of education and experience.
  • Must have a valid driver’s license.
  • Must reside within North Carolina.
  • Must be able to travel within catchment as required.

Preferred:

  • Degree in Business Administration, Healthcare Administration, Human Services, Public Administration, Liberal Arts, or Humanities.
  • Experience in the public mental health field is highly desired due to the complexity of the work of organization.

Deadline for Application:Monday September 21, 2026, at 11:59PM

How to Apply

To be considered, submit your application and resume through our ADP Career Center. Your resume must include:

  • Employer name, dates of service (month/year), average hours worked per week, and essential job duties
  • Education details (degree type, date awarded, institution, field of study)
  • Licensure/certification information, if applicable

After submission, your resume will be reviewed to ensure it meets the essential criteria for the position. You’ll be notified by HR regarding your application status as appropriate. All applicants will receive a final update once the recruitment cycle closes.

Join our Talent Community through ADP to stay informed about future opportunities. Be sure to keep your resume updated in your profile.

Trillium Health Resources is an Equal Employment Opportunity (EEO) employer and a drug-free workplace. All candidates must pass a drug test as a condition of employment.

jobs.description:
CrossCountry Mortgage (CCM) is the nation's number one distributed retail mortgage lender with more than 9,000 employees operating over 700 branches and servicing loans across all 50 states, D.C. and Puerto Rico. Our company has been recognized ten times on the Inc. 5000 list of America's fastest-growing private businesses and has received many awards for our standout culture.

A culture where you can grow! CCM has created an exceptional culture driving employee engagement, exceeding employee expectations, and directly impacting company success. At our core, our entrepreneurial spirit empowers every employee to be who they are to help us move forward together. You’ll get unwavering support from all departments and total transparency from the top down.

CCM offers eligible employees a competitive compensation plan and a robust benefits package, including medical, dental, vision, as well as a 401K. We also offer company-provided short-term disability, an employee assistance program, and a wellness program.

Position Overview:

The IT Infrastructure Manager leads a team responsible for the engineering, delivery, modernization, and continuous improvement of CCM’s enterprise infrastructure platforms. This role is accountable for designing, building, and delivering secure, scalable, resilient, and supportable technology solutions across CCM’s hybrid infrastructure environment.

This is a BUILD-focused leadership role responsible for infrastructure strategy, engineering standards, project delivery, automation, platform modernization, and operational readiness. The IT Infrastructure Manager partners closely with Enterprise Architecture, Security & Risk, Technology Operations, PMO, and business technology stakeholders to ensure infrastructure solutions are well-designed, well-documented, secure, repeatable, and ready for operational support. This role encompasses cloud infrastructure, on-premises infrastructure, network engineering, identity and access platforms, Microsoft 365 and collaboration foundations, endpoint platform foundations, automation, Infrastructure as Code, and enterprise platform delivery.

Job Responsibilities:

  • Develop and execute short- and long-term infrastructure roadmaps that support CCM’s business growth, technology modernization, and operational resilience.
  • Translate enterprise technology objectives into practical infrastructure plans across hybrid cloud, AWS, Azure, networking, identity, endpoint foundations, collaboration platforms, and core enterprise services.
  • Define and maintain infrastructure engineering standards, reference architectures, design patterns, documentation expectations, and operational readiness requirements.
  • Drive scalable, repeatable infrastructure delivery through automation, Infrastructure as Code, standard templates, reusable patterns, and disciplined change management.
  • Partner with Enterprise Architecture and Security & Risk to ensure infrastructure solutions align with enterprise architecture principles, security controls, compliance expectations, and business continuity requirements.
  • Evaluate emerging technologies, vendors, services, tools, and delivery models that improve reliability, scalability, cost efficiency, security, and engineering velocity.
  • Develop business cases, cost-benefit analyses, and recommendations for infrastructure investments, modernization initiatives, and platform improvements.
  • Lead the design, engineering, and implementation of infrastructure solutions across CCM’s hybrid environment, including AWS, Azure, on-premises platforms, networking, identity/IAM, Microsoft 365, collaboration tools, and endpoint platform foundations.
  • Oversee infrastructure project delivery from intake through design, implementation, testing, documentation, transition, and operational handoff.
  • Ensure new infrastructure solutions are secure by design, observable, resilient, cost-conscious, supportable, and aligned with enterprise standards.
  • Drive adoption of modern deployment practices, including Infrastructure as Code, Git-based workflows, CI/CD pipelines, automated configuration, scripting, and repeatable release patterns.
  • Provide leadership for infrastructure modernization efforts, lifecycle management, cloud adoption, platform consolidation, technical debt reduction, and service improvement initiatives.
  • Ensure infrastructure designs include appropriate monitoring, alerting, logging, backup, recovery, capacity, performance, and support requirements before transition to Operations.
  • Partner with Technology Operations to ensure clean handoffs, clear runbooks, escalation paths, knowledge transfer, and operational support models.
  • Manage engineering delivery across core infrastructure domains, including cloud platforms, network services, identity services, directory services, collaboration platforms, and enterprise productivity foundations.
  • Support AWS as a required platform capability and Azure as a preferred platform capability, ensuring cloud environments are built with strong governance, security, resiliency, automation, and cost-management practices.
  • Provide leadership across network engineering capabilities such as LAN/WAN, SD-WAN, VPN, DNS, DHCP, firewall coordination, connectivity, segmentation, cloud networking, and performance optimization.
  • Guide identity and access platform initiatives involving Active Directory, Microsoft Entra ID, SSO, MFA, privileged access, conditional access, lifecycle management, and least-privilege access models.
  • Support Microsoft 365 and collaboration platform foundations, including governance, platform configuration, security alignment, service enablement, and enterprise adoption needs.
  • Partner with endpoint, security, and operations teams to ensure endpoint platform foundations are standardized, manageable, secure, and aligned with enterprise requirements.
  • Partner with Security & Risk to embed security requirements into infrastructure designs, implementation plans, and operational readiness criteria.
  • Ensure infrastructure platforms support appropriate controls for identity, access, logging, encryption, vulnerability management, patching, lifecycle management, backup, recovery, and resiliency.
  • Support disaster recovery, business continuity, incident readiness, and infrastructure resilience planning.
  • Participate in major incident reviews, root cause analysis, remediation planning, and continuous improvement activities as an infrastructure engineering leader.
  • Ensure infrastructure documentation, architecture diagrams, standards, implementation records, and support procedures remain current and audit-ready.
  • Establish strong delivery practices that balance speed, quality, security, supportability, and long-term maintainability.
  • Maintain clear communication with IT leadership, project stakeholders, Technology Operations, Security & Risk, Enterprise Architecture, PMO, business partners, and vendors.
  • Provide executive-ready updates on infrastructure initiatives, risks, delivery progress, resource needs, dependencies, and decision points.
  • Define and track key performance indicators related to infrastructure delivery, platform health, project execution, technical debt reduction, automation, and operational readiness.
  • Serve as an escalation point for complex infrastructure engineering issues, major production concerns, and high-priority platform decisions.
  • Ensure infrastructure work is prioritized, planned, delivered, documented, and transitioned effectively.
  • Lead, coach, and develop a team of infrastructure engineers and technical professionals.
  • Set clear goals, priorities, standards, and expectations for team delivery, quality, documentation, collaboration, and accountability.
  • Manage team capacity, resource planning, work assignments, performance feedback, hiring, onboarding, and professional development.
  • Build a culture of ownership, continuous improvement, engineering discipline, service excellence, and cross-functional partnership.
  • Promote knowledge sharing, standardization, mentoring, and repeatable delivery practices across the infrastructure team.
  • Manage vendor relationships, technology evaluations, renewals, support agreements, and infrastructure-related procurement activities.
  • Support infrastructure budget planning, forecasting, cloud cost management, licensing reviews, and cost optimization efforts.
  • Partner with PMO and IT leadership to manage the infrastructure project portfolio, prioritize demand, identify delivery risks, and ensure alignment to enterprise objectives.
  • Evaluate infrastructure investments based on business value, risk reduction, operational impact, scalability, security, and total cost of ownership.
  • Participate in escalation support for major incidents, high-priority infrastructure issues, and critical production events.
  • Occasional work outside standard business hours may be required to support planned maintenance, production changes, incident response, and project implementations.

Qualifications and Skills:

  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.
  • One or more industry-recognized certifications in cloud technologies, infrastructure automation, project management, cybersecurity, networking, endpoint management, or IT service management, preferred.
  • 8+ years of progressive experience in infrastructure engineering, platform engineering, cloud infrastructure, network engineering, systems engineering, or related technology roles.
  • 3+ years of experience leading infrastructure, platform, systems, network, or cloud engineering teams.
  • Advanced experience delivering infrastructure solutions in a hybrid enterprise environment.
  • Experience leading infrastructure projects from design through implementation, documentation, transition, and support readiness.
  • Experience with Infrastructure as Code and automation tools such as Terraform, CloudFormation, Bicep, Ansible, PowerShell, Python, Bash, or similar technologies.
  • Experience with CI/CD, Git-based workflows, release management, configuration management, and repeatable deployment practices.
  • Experience with Microsoft 365, collaboration platforms, endpoint platform foundations, and enterprise productivity services.
  • Experience with ITSM practices, change management, incident/problem management, operational readiness, and production support transition.
  • Advanced experience in vendor management, budgeting, cost analysis, and infrastructure investment planning.
  • Experience working in a regulated or security-conscious environment; financial services or mortgage industry experience, preferred.
  • Advanced technical knowledge of AWS, Azure, hybrid infrastructure, virtualization, Windows and Linux server platforms, enterprise storage, backup/recovery, networking, and identity platforms.
  • Advanced knowledge of Active Directory, Microsoft Entra ID, SSO, MFA, conditional access, privileged access, and identity lifecycle management.
  • Knowledge of LAN/WAN, SD-WAN, DNS, DHCP, VPN, firewalls, routing, switching, load balancing, cloud networking, and network segmentation.
  • Knowledge of AWS is required; Azure experience, preferred.
  • Advanced understanding of infrastructure architecture, cloud architecture, networking, identity and access management, Microsoft enterprise platforms, automation, and operational support models.
  • Advanced understanding of monitoring, logging, alerting, observability, capacity planning, performance management, and service reliability practices.
  • Comfortable operating in a large, complex, and rapidly evolving organization.
  • Skilled in leadership, strategic planning, decision-making, and driving execution to achieve business objectives.
  • Skilled in communication, including communicating complex technical topics effectively to both technical and non-technical audiences.
  • Skilled in partnering across Infrastructure, Operations, Security & Risk, Architecture, PMO, and business teams.
  • Highly organized, delivery-oriented, and comfortable managing multiple priorities in a dynamic environment.
  • Excellent analytical and problem-solving skills.
  • Skilled in evaluating and balancing competing priorities, including quality, security, cost, delivery timelines, and operational requirements.
  • Skilled in aligning technology services with customer requirements, business objectives, and organizational reliability standards.
  • Skilled in talent development, process improvement, standards enhancement, and building effective technical teams.

jobs.description:
Founded in 1977 as the Senior Care Action Network, SCAN began with a simple but radical idea: that older adults deserve to stay healthy and independent. That belief was championed by a group of community activists we still honor today as the “12 Angry Seniors.” Their mission continues to guide everything we do.

Today, SCAN is a nonprofit health organization serving more than 500,000 people across Arizona, California, Nevada, New Mexico, Texas, and Washington, with over $8 billion in annual revenue. With nearly five decades of experience, we have built a distinctive, values-driven platform dedicated to improving care for older adults.

Our work spans Medicare Advantage, fully integrated care models, primary care, care for the most medically and socially complex populations, and next-generation care delivery models. Across all of this, we are united by a shared commitment: combining compassion with discipline, innovation with stewardship, and growth with integrity.

At SCAN, we believe scale should strengthen—not dilute—our mission. We are building the future of care for older adults, grounded in purpose, accountability, and respect for the people and communities we serve.

SCAN Temp – Peer Advocate

Location: Remote

Part-Time

Current SCAN Membership, required.

The job

A peer advocate is a professional who provides support, guidance, and advocacy for individuals who are facing challenges such as mental health issues, addiction, or other life struggles. They use their own lived experiences to connect with and empower others, offering resources, encouragement, and a listening ear to help individuals navigate their own paths to recovery and wellness. Peer advocates often work in healthcare settings, community organizations, or social service agencies to provide peer support and promote positive outcomes for those they serve.

You will

  • Make outbound calls to members based on identified health interventions or quality initiatives.
  • Build rapport with members by communicating personal experience as a member and peer to enhance the effectiveness of health education and increase likelihood of positive behavior changes.
  • Coach members to create and implement strategies that minimize risks associated with the identified common health conditions.
  • Encourage and provide assistance to members who may encounter obstacles to seeking care.

Your Qualifications

  • High School Diploma or Equivalent Experience
  • Current SCAN Membership, required.

DSR Corporation has been the ideal end-to-end solution provider for hundreds of companies, from startups to the Fortune 500, since 1998. Since then, DSR has blossomed into 11 technical divisions, with highly-skilled, technologically-agnostic engineering resources and services in full-stack web, embedded, mobile, wireless, big data / analytics, scalable databases, system software, digital media, SSI / blockchain, and AI / computer vision. The company has offices located around the world including Denver, Porto, Voronezh, Yokohama-city, and Tashkent.

Among our own products are ZBOSS, the Zigbee software protocol stack for IoT devices, zHome framework for smart home solutions (mobile app, back-end, IoT gateway), ZBOSS Open Initiative to maintain and improve the market-leading Zigbee® PRO software platform together with heavyweight IoT market players. DSR's wholly-owned subsidiary, Noema, focuses on delivering the most up-to-date and reliable AI and Computer Vision solutions for security, manufacturing, retail, healthcare and smart homes/cities businesses.

Join our multinational team of seasoned software engineers! We're passionate about tackling complex tasks and sharing our unique software development expertise, accumulated over 25 years. With well-established workflows and transparent career paths, we're geared to boost your professional growth, regardless of your current experience level.

Let's change our world for the better by doing software right!

| | | |

Job Description

We are currently looking for a Senior Embedded Systems Software Engineer for our team.

Work at DSR is your chance to dive into the interesting world of wireless devices of various types using modern IoT protocols (BLE, Zigbee, Matter, etc.). The range of tasks, which our engineers are working on includes integration of IoT devices into existing ecosystems from Amazon, Control4, Legrand, etc. and development of our own products. Our teams work on various projects, which include firmware development for MCU and wireless SoC (under RTOS control or bare metal) and development for embedded systems based on Linux.

We are developing firmware for the wide range of devices, including:

  • IoT gateways/smart home centers that support one or more IoT protocols simultaneously.
  • Sensors for smart home systems, which allow used to control various environmental conditions.
  • Wearables for sport and everyday life.
  • Smart devices for pets, allowing users to control health and location of their pets and control animals access to their house.

There is also a Zigbee stack among our products and we keep improving it to gather more and more recognition from major Zigbee device vendors and it has already become an official stack for Nordic Semiconductor, MediaTek, Espressif Systems and other vendors of Zigbee hardware.

Responsibilities:

  • Designing and developing firmware for wireless devices and/or embedded Linux-based systems.
  • Optimize code size and performance, including existing code.
  • Working with our client’s team, interacting with the client directly.

Requirements:

  • 3+ years of relevant professional software development experience.
  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Electrical Engineering, or a related field.
  • Strong proficiency in C/C++ software development.
  • Professional experience with Zigbee, including development, integration, debugging, or maintenance of Zigbee-based solutions.
  • Hands-on experience developing and debugging firmware for MCUs, with experience in OS-less, RTOS, and/or Embedded Linux environments.
  • Alternatively, experience with Linux development across different hardware platforms.
  • Ability to independently develop and take ownership of software components while communicating effectively with other team members.
  • Strong ability to collaborate effectively as part of a software development team.
  • Ability to understand, maintain, troubleshoot, and contribute to an existing codebase.
  • Ability to design, document, and implement software subsystems independently.
  • Ability to understand customer requirements and actively participate in technical meetings and discussions.
  • Good technical English, both written and spoken.

Will be a Plus:

  • Experience with wireless communication technologies and networks, such as Wi-Fi, Bluetooth, Z-Wave, etc.
  • Experience with embedded systems based on FreeRTOS, Zephyr, Linux, or similar platforms, including application- and/or kernel-level development.
  • Experience integrating embedded devices with cloud services.
  • Knowledge of Python or other scripting languages, such as Lua, Perl, or Shell scripting.

  • Experience optimizing code size and performance, including optimizing and refactoring existing code.

Job Title: Executive Director, Global Commercial Lead, Tacabrutideg

Job Location: Remote (US)

Job Location Type: Remote

Job Contract Type: Full-time

Job Seniority Level:

BeOne continues to grow at a rapid pace with challenging and exciting opportunities for experienced professionals. When considering candidates, we look for scientific and business professionals who are highly motivated, collaborative, and most importantly, share our passionate interest in fighting cancer.

As the Executive Director, Global Commercial Lead, Tacabrutideg, you will play a critical leadership role in BeOne’s Global Commercial Strategy and Operations team. You will be responsible for developing commercial strategies to drive the long-term success of BeOne’s hematology product and expanding blockbuster success. You will collaborate closely with cross-functional teams to ensure alignment with business objectives and market needs across various regions. This role requires a deep understanding of the hematology market landscape, strong leadership capabilities, and a proven track record in successfully launching products globally in competitive environments. The role reports to the Vice President, Global Commercial Hematology Franchise Lead.

Essential Functions of the Job:

  • Provide strategic leadership for Tacabrutideg , overseeing global commercial strategies, aligning with Global Product Team (GPT), major markets and senior leadership.
  • Develop and execute the overarching global commercial strategies, aligning short-, mid-, and long-term goals across the organization.
  • Lead Global Brand Team (GBT) meetings, Annual Operating Plan (AOP) and Long-Range Plan processes.
  • Represent ONE commercial voice to Global Product Team (GPT), R&D, Tech Ops, Executive leadership to drive alignment organizationally.
  • Collaborate with cross-regional, and cross-functional team members to shape disease area strategies for multiple indications.
  • Oversee implementation and execution of global lifecycle strategies in local markets and spearhead integration of major market input into global launch readiness plans.
  • Lead insight generation of brand drivers and assess performance for global success sharing.
  • Identify data gaps, barriers to brand adoption and develop plans to deliver continued brand growth.
  • Drive value maximization and recommend growth strategies to meet long-term hematology ambitions.
  • Provide commercial leadership and consolidate individual disease area/indication needs into a cohesive product view.
  • Collaborate with corporate affairs to craft and refine investor relations communications and messaging.
  • Partner with tech ops to ensure optimized supply and demand management.
  • Maintain strong relationships with both internal colleagues and external customers to address market opportunities.

Preferred Qualifications:

  • 14+ years of experience in pharmaceutical marketing/healthcare-related commercial experience.
  • Must have 5+ years of Global Marketing/New Product Planning expertise and experience in hematology/oncology.
  • Advanced or expert competency in hematology, highly competitive markets and/or experience in China pharmaceutical market preferred.
  • Demonstrated experience in leading brand strategy/new product planning at various stages of lifecycle.
  • Strong team player who can incorporate input from key stakeholders (both internally and externally) and drive cross-regional and cross-functional alignment.
  • Proven ability to inspire, motivate and lead high performance teams.
  • Highly skilled and effective in engaging, connecting, and influencing across all levels from senior leadership to local marketing teams.
  • Understanding of change management principles and experience driving change across an organization.
  • Strong ability and desire to work across time zones, geographies, and cultures to improve the lives of patients and caregivers.

Supervisory Responsibilities:

  • Yes

Travel:

  • At least 20% including international travel

Global Competencies

When we exhibit our values of Patients First, Driving Excellence, Bold Ingenuity and Collaborative Spirit, through our twelve global competencies below, we help get more affordable medicines to more patients around the world.

  • Fosters Teamwork
  • Provides and Solicits Honest and Actionable Feedback
  • Self-Awareness
  • Acts Inclusively
  • Demonstrates Initiative
  • Entrepreneurial Mindset
  • Continuous Learning
  • Embraces Change
  • Results-Oriented
  • Analytical Thinking/Data Analysis
  • Financial Excellence

jobs.title: Director of Development
jobs.excerpt: WHO WE AREFoster America’s vision is that every child, youth, and family thrives.
jobs.description:
WHO WE ARE

Foster America’s vision is that every child, youth, and family thrives. Our mission is to transform systems that serve children, youth, and families, together with communities, by innovating for a more just, equitable future.

We work alongside communities and government, centering the expertise of people with lived experience, to build a future where families have the support and resources they need to thrive. Our strategy focuses on four interconnected areas: developing and equipping leaders, facilitating aligned field action, co-designing innovative solutions, and codifying and amplifying learning. Through this work, we help turn bold ideas and community expertise into lasting systems change.

To learn more about Foster America, please visit

Role Purpose

As Foster America marks its 10-year anniversary, we stand at a pivotal moment of momentum and growth. With deep partnerships across local governments and national philanthropy, a loyal base of individual supporters, and robust internal data-tracking systems, we have built a strong foundation for our next era of growth. We are primed to expand into new revenue streams - including earned revenue, corporate partnerships, and local philanthropy - and further strengthen and diversify our philanthropic support.

To lead this effort, Foster America seeks a Director of Development to drive revenue growth, strengthen our long-term sustainability, and lead the day-to-day implementation of our fundraising strategy. Reporting to the Vice President of Development and Strategic Partnerships (VP), the Director of Development will translate organizational revenue strategy into actionable fundraising plans; manage a portfolio of institutional and individual donors; lead grant development, reporting, and stewardship; and oversee donor pipeline management and development operations.

As part of a three-person development team alongside our Development and Communications Associate and the VP, the Director will partner cross-functionally with executive leadership, program teams, finance, and communications to elevate a high-performing, disciplined development function.

Donor Cultivation & Portfolio Management (35%):

  • Grow Funder Relationships: Manage and grow a portfolio of institutional and individual donors and prospects, including cultivation, solicitation, and stewardship. Build authentic relationships that deepen donor engagement and increase long-term giving.
  • Strategic Donor Partnerships: Partner with the VP of Development & Strategic Partnerships on principal and strategically significant donor relationships, including prospect strategy, cultivation, solicitation, and stewardship.

Revenue Strategy & Institutional Giving (30%):

  • Actionable Revenue Plans: Translate Foster America’s organizational revenue strategy into actionable fundraising plans across foundations, corporate partners, government sources, and individual giving.
  • Institutional Growth: Manage institutional fundraising strategies and identify and develop high-value funding opportunities.
  • Proposal Development: Lead the development of persuasive, mission-aligned proposals in partnership with the VP, program leaders, and other organizational stakeholders.

Development Operations, Data & Systems (15%):

  • Systems Oversight: Oversee donor database systems, prospect tracking, revenue forecasting, and gift processing workflows.
  • Data Analytics: Analyze donor data regularly to evaluate trends, identify opportunities, and refine fundraising tactics.

Team Leadership & Department Management (10%):

  • Functional Coaching: Provide task prioritization, project-level guidance, and functional coaching to the Development & Communications Associate on fundraising deliverables.
  • Goal Alignment: Collaborate with the Associate to align day-to-day development activities with departmental goals and support development budget tracking.

Culture of Philanthropy & Team Enablement (10%)

  • Cross-Department Partnership: Partner across departments to demystify development and build an organization-wide culture of philanthropy.
  • Internal Coaching: Coach and equip program leaders, executive leadership, and internal staff to confidently articulate Foster America's impact, identify storytelling opportunities, and participate in donor engagement.

Success for the Director of Development means:

  • Donor Relationships & Growth: Consistently expanding the reach and depth of philanthropic partnerships, growing the donor pipeline, and securing long-term major donor commitments;
  • Culture of Philanthropy: Building an inclusive culture of philanthropy across the organization by equipping staff, leadership, and the Board with the skills and confidence to serve as effective fundraising champions.
  • Revenue & Sustainability: Contributing substantially to meeting or exceeding annual revenue goals by building a strong, diversified pipeline, maximizing donor retention and growth, and ensuring disciplined execution of the annual fundraising plan;
  • Development Systems: Building and maintaining efficient fundraising operations, donor management workflows, and reporting procedures to steward more relationships with ease and efficiency.

This is an exciting opportunity for a development professional to help shape and grow Foster America’s philanthropic reach.

You will ideally bring:

  • Experience: Minimum 5–7 years of progressive leadership experience in nonprofit development, major gift fundraising, or institutional giving.
  • Track Record: Proven track record of contributing to successful fundraising efforts totaling at least seven figures annually, including cultivating major individual donors and securing foundation grants.
  • Communication: Exceptional written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to translate complex ideas into clear, compelling donor communications and proposals.
  • Project Management: Strong project management skills, with the ability to manage multiple priorities, deadlines, and stakeholders in a fast-moving environment.
  • Leadership: Demonstrated experience guiding matrixed project teams, setting department metrics, coaching colleagues, and building cross-functional alignment.
  • Education: Bachelor’s degree or higher required.

This position will require:

  • Location: Remote (U.S.-based).
  • Physical Requirements: Prolonged periods sitting and working at a computer.
  • Travel: Up to 20% for donor meetings, team retreats, and board gatherings.

Foster America is committed to building a team that reflects the communities most affected by the systems we work to transform. We believe that diversity of lived experience, professional background, and perspective is essential to our work.

We are an equal opportunity employer and actively encourage applications from candidates of all backgrounds, identities, and experiences. For this role, we are looking for a leader with a demonstrated record of impact. We recognize that strong leaders have arrived at this work through many different paths. If you see yourself in this role description and meet most of what we're looking for, we hope you'll apply.

Benefits

Salary is commensurate with experience in the range of $120,000 – $145,500. Foster America offers a comprehensive benefits package, including medical insurance, paid vacation, paid parental leave, paid holidays, commuter benefits, participation in a retirement plan, paid sick time, and professional development opportunities.

jobs.description:
To get the best candidate experience, please consider applying for a maximum of 3 roles within 12 months to ensure you are not duplicating efforts.

Job Category

Customer Success

Job Details

About Salesforce

Salesforce is the #1 AI CRM, where humans with agents drive customer success together. Here, ambition meets action. Tech meets trust. And innovation isn’t a buzzword — it’s a way of life. The world of work as we know it is changing and we're looking for Trailblazers who are passionate about bettering business and the world through AI, driving innovation, and keeping Salesforce's core values at the heart of it all.

Ready to level-up your career at the company leading workforce transformation in the agentic era? You’re in the right place! Agentforce is the future of AI, and you are the future of Salesforce.

職位簡介

我們正在尋找對協助客戶進行數位轉型與業務流程優化有熱情、有想法的夥伴。您將主導從企業系統願景規劃、策略擬定，到實際導入與落地運行的完整流程，並帶領客戶與團隊運用 Salesforce 平台實現業務願景與目標。同時，您也將有機會持續接觸最前沿的 AI 與 CRM 趨勢及技術，拓展專業能力和職涯邊界。

職位特色

  • 結合策略規劃及落地執行：作為顧問或主要合作夥伴（Prime Vendor）的角色，參與具代表性的轉型專案，從前期策略規劃到實際導入上線，協助客戶將轉型藍圖落實為可執行的成果。
  • 應用前沿 AI 技術：協助客戶評估與導入 Agentforce 等新一代 AI 解決方案。使用各式 AI 工具，提升分析深度、設計品質與交付效率。
  • 端到端 (End-to-End) 參與：從願景規劃、架構設計到上線後的落地運行與持續優化，參與專案各個關鍵階段，累積完整且具深度的實戰經驗。

主要角色類型

依據您的專業背景，入職後將主要參與以下其中一類角色：

  • PM (Project Manager/Engagement Delivery Manager)： 負責專案規劃、進度推動與交付管理。
  • BA (Business Architect)： 負責商業策略、流程設計與應用推廣。
  • SA (Solution Architect)： 負責整體解決方案、資料模型與多雲架構設計。
  • TA (Technical Architect)： 負責技術架構、系統整合、資安與效能優化。

工作內容 (主要案件)

本職位將根據專案需求及您的專業領域，參與以下各階段的任務：

A. 戰略與轉型設計 (Strategy & Change Design) 負責制定組織及系統整體的轉型構想與藍圖。

● 組織與業務領域轉型設計

策劃業務流程改革及組織變革的整體架構。規劃組織與業務流程轉型方向，協助客戶建立整體藍圖。

  • 系統領域轉型設計

設計企業 IT 架構與 Salesforce 平台發展策略。

● Salesforce Org 戰略

制定 Salesforce Org（Instance）的活用戰略、治理戰略及發展藍圖規劃 Salesforce Org 的治理模式、使用策略與長期發展方向。

  • Salesforce CTO 顧問

從企業架構或 CTO 顧問角度，協助客戶推動 AI 與數位轉型。

  • 變革推動與應用推廣落地

規劃變革管理與推動方案，應用推廣，提升解決方案導入後的落地成效。

  • 概念驗證 (PoC)

參與 PoC 設計與驗證，評估方案可行性。

B. 專案執行與支援 (Project Execution & Support) 從需求定義到上線發佈，在各階段提供支援或執行實務工作。根據專案特性選擇瀑布式（Waterfall）或敏捷式（Agile）開發。

  • 專案管理

參與專案規劃、進度推動與執行管理。

  • 需求定義

進行需求訪談、需求分析與流程引導。

  • 設計

主導或參與應用設計、架構設計與詳細設計，並審查相關成果。

  • 開發與測試

領導實作與測試工作，或制定開發標準及品質管理流程。

  • 遷移與部署

執行資料遷移與部署上線，或制定遷移策略並支援執行。

  • CI/CD

協助建立開發標準，開發環境設計、構建與運維等 DevOps 流程。

C. 治理與最佳化 (Governance & Optimization)

● Salesforce 治理 (Governance)

協助建立 Salesforce 治理機制與 CoE (Center of Excellence) 運作模式。

  • 設計權威 (Design Authority)

建立或參與設計審查與架構治理流程，確保設計品質。

  • 設計品質最佳實踐 (Best Practice)

提供設計最佳實務與優化建議，提升專案交付品質。

  • 架構最佳化 (Architecture Optimization)

針對既有環境進行 Org 健檢、架構診斷與最佳化建議。

資格要求 (応募要件)

【必備條件 (Must)】

實務經驗

● 在以下任一領域具備 7 年以上的實務經驗，並曾擔任主要推動角色：

A. 策略規劃與轉型設計 (Strategy & Change Design)

B. 治理與持續優化 (Governance & Optimization)

C. 專案推動與執行 (Project Execution & Support)

領導力

● 具備 3 年以上團隊帶領或專案領導經驗（職稱不限）。

溝通能力

  • 能與客戶高階主管（含C-Level）及相關利害關係人進行有效溝通，推動共識形成與專案進展。

● 具備良好的跨部門及跨角色溝通與協作能力，能與不同成員有效合作。

學習及理解力

● 能快速理解業務需求、Salesforce 相關技術概念及專案方法

● 具備學習新技術的意願與行動力，並願意善用 AI 工具提升工作效率與產出品質

核心思維

  • 具備實踐「批判性思考 (Critical Thinking)」與「歸零學習 (Unlearning)」的能力。
  • 不過度執著於過去的成功經驗，能針對 AI 等新技術靈活調整自身的思考模式與方法論。

語言能力

● 中文： 母語等級。

● 英文： 商務英文溝通能力。

【加分條件 (Want)】

  • AI 與數據領域實務經驗：具備 AI、資料應用、資料治理或 AI Agent 相關專案經驗。

● 全球化專案執行能力：具備以英文進行專案溝通與跨國協作的實務經驗。

  • 運用 AI 提升業務效率之績效：曾在顧問服務或系統建置過程中，實際運用 AI 工具提升工作效率或交付品質。
  • 認證：具備 Salesforce 相關認證者佳，如 Application Architect 或 System Architect等

本職位提供的職涯價值

  • 成長為全方位架構師： 透過參與不同階段的轉型專案，累積策略規劃、架構設計、專案交付與治理優化等完整實務經驗。
  • 拓展 AI 與 CRM 專業能力： 持續接觸 AI 與 CRM 領域的最新趨勢與技術應用，拓展專業深度與職涯發展空間。
  • 累積關鍵轉型專案歷練： 透過參與具挑戰性與代表性的客戶專案，強化架構判斷、跨部門協作與專案推動能力。
  • 發展多元職涯方向： 我們將依據您的專業背景、職涯方向與個人特質，提供合適的發展機會與成長舞台。

Unleash Your Potential

When you join Salesforce, you’ll be limitless in all areas of your life. Our benefits and resources support you to find balance andbe your best, and our AI agents accelerate your impact so you cando your best. Together, we’ll bring the power of Agentforce to organizations of all sizes and deliver amazing experiences that customers love. Apply today to not only shape the future — but to redefine what’s possible — for yourself, for AI, and the world.

Application Security Engineer

Parallels is seeking a highly motivated and talented Application Security Engineer to join our team. In this role, you will make security decisions that impact millions of our customers while gaining hands-on experience in exploit development and CVE discovery. The ideal candidate will combine an attacker mindset with the humility and detail-oriented attitude required to coordinate fixes and security architecting with busy engineers.

Your primary responsibility will be to coordinate with more senior members of our team to write exploits and design fixes for existing application vulnerabilities. You will also help search for new critical/high risk vulnerabilities in our codebase. In addition, you will assist in vulnerability disclosure processes and help implement repeatable secure development practices.

As issues are uncovered, you will communicate with the appropriate technical and leadership teams to ensure a focus on risk mitigation – allowing for business continuity, but without negligent risk. Application security engineers are constantly assessing applications for weaknesses and finding resolutions before they can be abused.

Parallels: anytime, anywhere, any-device productivity.Why Parallels, why now?

The top creative and technical minds could sell anywhere. So why are so many choosing Parallels? Three reasons:

This is the moment.It's an exciting time at Parallels — strong leadership, a refreshed brand, and a whole new approach to how the world works. The EUC market is shifting fast, and we're at the front of that wave. We want you riding it with us.

We want you to be you.Too many companies tell you about their culture and then expect you to fit it. Ours is built from the people who work here. We want you to feel safe being who you are, taking risks, and showing us what you've got.

It's your world.We know you have a life. We want to be part of it — not all of it. At Parallels, we're serious about empowering people to work when, how, and where they want. Couch? Sweatpants? Cool with us. Happy sellers mean happy customers. That's why we hire amazing people and get out of their way.

Sound good so far? Awesome. Let's talk about the role

What you'll do:

  • Reproduce and triage incoming vulnerabilities from security automation/bug bounty programs, then propose granular fixes to engineers
  • Discover vulnerabilities and construct exploits for core Parallels applications such as Parallels Remote Application Server
  • Assist in the CVE disclosure process
  • Provide threat models and design reviews for teams throughout the company
  • Assist in tuning existing static analysis, dynamic analysis, and dependency management tools

Desired Qualities:

  • An attacker mindset: engineers will often want proof before fixes are implemented
  • Eagerness to learn – you are not expected to know everything coming in, but you should continuously learn new techniques on the job
  • The ability to communicate clearly, acknowledge mistakes, and disagree when necessary
  • Demonstrable passion for offensive security
  • Experience reading, writing and debugging C++ and Python code
  • Basic experience with memory exploitation techniques
  • Demonstrable experience with web exploitation techniques and tools (e.g. PortSwigger lab scoreboards)
  • Excellent written and oral communication skills

Ideal Candidate Will Have:

  • BSc/MS in computer science or a related field
  • Previous CVEs in desktop applications
  • Proficiency with reverse engineering tools
  • Significant experience in memory exploitation techniques (e.g. gaining code execution from memory vulnerabilities in modern operating systems)
  • Familiarity with cloud security best practices
  • 3+ years of industry experience
  • OSCP/OSWE/OSED/RET2 certification

What are you waiting for? Apply now. We can't wait to meet you.

(FYI, we're lucky to get a lot of interest and we appreciate every application — please note we'll only reach out if you've been selected for an interview.)

Parallels is a top VDI/EUC product helping businesses since 1999. Whether it's desktop or cloud, on-prem or hybrid, Parallels delivers speed, security, and affordability for the modern work environment.

Als Senior IT Program Manager (gn) übernimmst Du die bereichsübergreifende Steuerung aller IT-Projekte und -Programme über vier Fachbereiche hinweg: Infrastructure, Cloud & AI Platforms, Security und Application Management.Du bist die zentrale Klammer die verhindert, dass Bereiche aneinander vorbei projektieren. Du machst das Gesamtportfolio transparent, steuerst den Eingang neuer Projekte, löst Abhängigkeiten und Ressourcenkonflikte frühzeitig und eskalierst wenn nötig – nicht als Entscheider, sondern als Enabler.

Deine Mission bei uns

Bereichsübergreifendes Projektportfolio

  • Aufbau und Pflege eines transparenten IT-Projektportfolios über alle vier Bereiche – du machst sichtbar was läuft, was geplant ist und was sich gegenseitig blockiert
  • Priorisierung in Abstimmung mit den Heads: welche Projekte haben welche Abhängigkeiten, wo sind Ressourcenkonflikte, was muss warten
  • Steuerung bereichsübergreifender Projekte: neue Cloud-Dienste, Internationalisierung, AI-Rollouts, Standortaufbauten die mehrere Bereiche betreffen
  • Regelkommunikation zum VP: Portfoliostatus, Risiken, Entscheidungsbedarf – kurz und mit klaren Status (Rot/Gelb/Grün)

 Führung IT Project Manager (Matrix)

  • Steuerung von IT Project Manager– du definierst Prioritäten, Qualitätsstandards und Arbeitspakete
  • Gemeinsame Projektplanung: du hältst den Gesamtplan, die operative Umsetzung liegt sowohl bei dir als, auch bei den Projekt Manager
  • Sparring und Weiterentwicklung: du bringst Methodenkompetenz ein und hilfst den Project Managern sich weiterzuentwickeln

Projekt-Intake & Demand Management

  • Aufbau und Betrieb eines verbindlichen Projekt-Intake-Prozesses: kein Projekt startet ohne definierten Scope, Business Owner und Ressource-Check — unabhängig davon, über welchen Kanal die Anfrage kommt
  • Bewertung eingehender Anfragen: Du triffst diese Unterscheidung konsequent und verhinderst so, dass operative Tätigkeiten als Projekte geführt werden

Abhängigkeitsmanagement & Eskalation

  • Identifikation und Auflösung von Abhängigkeiten zwischen Infrastructure, Cloud & AI Platforms, Security und Application Management
  • Frühzeitige Eskalation an den VP wenn Projekte sich gegenseitig blockieren oder Ressourcen fehlen
  • Sicherstellung, dass alle IT-Projekt – unabhängig ihrer Herkunft – durch den Portfolio Prozess laufen
  • Sicherstellung sauberer Übergaben von Projektergebnissen in den Betrieb – Dokumentation, Einweisung, Supportkonzept
  • Etablierung einheitlicher Projektstandards: Templates, Statusberichte, Meilensteine – pragmatisch, nicht bürokratisch

Deine Erfahrung & Skills

Fachlich

  • Mehrjährige Erfahrung in der Steuerung von IT-Projektportfolios in technisch komplexen Umgebungen
  • Nachweisbare Erfahrung in der Koordination bereichsübergreifender IT-Projekte – nicht nur Einzelprojekte
  • Verständnis für IT-Infrastruktur, Cloud- und AI Plattformen, Application Management und Security auf einem Niveau das fachliche Diskussionen mit den Heads ermöglicht – du musst nicht alles können, aber verstehen was die Teams tun
  • Erfahrung mit Projektportfolio-Management: Priorisierung, Abhängigkeitsanalyse, Ressourcenplanung
  • Pragmatische Methodenkompetenz: du kennst agile und klassische Ansätze und wählst was zur Situation passt – kein Dogma
  • Kenntnisse in IT-Governance-Frameworks (ITIL COBIT) sind von Vorteil – nicht zwingend

Persönlich & methodisch

  • Fähigkeit über Matrixführung Ergebnisse zu erzielen – ohne disziplinarische Weisungsbefugnis, durch Überzeugung und Klarheit
  • Kommunikationsstärke auf allen Ebenen: technische Diskussionen mit Admins, strategische Abstimmung mit Heads, Eskalation an den VP
  • Strukturierte Arbeitsweise: du bringst Ordnung in Komplexität ohne bürokratische Overhead zu erzeugen
  • Konfliktkompetenz: wenn zwei Bereiche um dieselbe Ressource streiten, findest du eine Lösung oder eskalierst sauber
  • Eigenverantwortung: du baust eine neue Einheit auf – nicht alles ist vordefiniert, du gestaltest aktiv
  • Erfahrung in der Zusammenarbeit mit unterschiedlichen Stakeholdern auf unterschiedlichen Ebenen
  • Sehr gute Deutschkenntnisse, gute Englischkenntnisse

Warum wir?

Bei The Quality Group arbeiten über 1.200 Menschen mit einer gemeinsamen Mission: Ernährung neu zu denken - gesünder, smarter und mit echtem Mehrwert für die Community.
Wir glauben an Teamgeist, Eigenverantwortung und den Mut, Grenzen zu verschieben. Dabei zählt jeder Beitrag, unabhängig vom Standort oder Bereich.
Je nachdem, wo du bei uns einsteigst, erwarten dich unterschiedliche Benefits, unter anderem:

  • Attraktive Mitarbeiterrabatte auf Produkte von ESN & More
  • Flexible Arbeitszeiten & Homeoffice-Möglichkeiten
  • Zuschüsse zu Mobilität & Fitness (z. B. Wellpass, Deutschlandticket)
  • Betriebliche Altersvorsorge
  • Workation-Optionen und mehr

Im Bewerbungsprozess erfährst du, welche Vorteile dich an deinem Standort konkret erwarten und was es heißt, Teil von TQG zu sein: Ein Unternehmen, das mit Leidenschaft, Qualität und Mut die Zukunft von Ernährung gestaltet.

Über uns

The Quality Group (TQG) ist ein innovativer Anbieter von Sporternährungsprodukten und vereint seit 2021 die erfolgreichen Marken ESN und More Nutrition.

ESN ist seit 2004 deutscher Marktführer für Sporternährung und bietet Produkte wie Proteinpulver, Riegel und Supplements, die auf ambitionierte Fitnessziele ausgerichtet sind. More Nutrition, gegründet 2017, steht für gesunde, zuckerreduzierte Ernährungsprodukte und bietet Lösungen für bewusste Ernährung und Gewichtsmanagement – ohne Verzicht.

Die Vision von TQG ist es, Menschen dabei zu unterstützen, die beste Version ihrer selbst zu werden. Mit Leidenschaft und Innovationskraft entwickelt das Unternehmen hochwertige Produkte, die Gesundheit, Leistung und Lebensfreude fördern. Mit einer agilen Unternehmenskultur und spannenden Karrieremöglichkeiten ist TQG nicht nur für Kunden, sondern auch für Mitarbeitende ein starker Partner.

Das sind wir – The Quality Group – nice to meet you! Now it’s your turn!Wir freuen uns auf deine Bewerbung! Unabhängig von Geschlecht, Alter, Herkunft oder Identität – bei uns zählt, wer du bist und was du einbringst. Werde Teil unseres Teams und wachse mit uns.
