The Technical Project Manager – Data & Databricks is responsible for driving the day-to-day execution of complex data and Databricks engagements. This is a hands-on project leadership role for someone who combines strong project management discipline with deep experience delivering data, analytics, cloud, or data platform initiatives.

This person does more than manage a project plan. They understand the technical work being performed, can follow the details of architecture and engineering conversations, recognize dependencies and delivery risks, and ensure the team is following HIKE2’s technical and project delivery playbooks.

The Technical Project Manager reports into the PMO and partners closely with Databricks architects, data engineers, technical leads, consultants, and client stakeholders.

What You'll Do

  • Own the day-to-day execution and operating rhythm of assigned Databricks and data projects.

  • Own the connection between technical delivery, client priorities, and the business outcomes the platform is intended to enable.

  • Maintain the Jira board as the source of truth for project execution, including backlog, stories, tasks, dependencies, blockers, owners, and status.

  • Ensure work is appropriately defined, prioritized, assigned, estimated, and progressing through the delivery lifecycle.

  • Run project ceremonies including stand-ups, planning, backlog reviews, status meetings, and retrospectives as appropriate.

  • Produce and distribute the Weekly Pulse Report, clearly communicating progress, accomplishments, upcoming work, risks, decisions, dependencies, budget/burn, and items requiring attention.

  • Maintain project plans, milestones, RAID logs, decisions, action items, resource plans, and other required PMO artifacts.

  • Understand the technical delivery plan and ensure the team is following the established Databricks/data technical playbook.

  • Track technical dependencies across data sources, environments, pipelines, integrations, architecture, security, testing, deployment, and client teams.

  • Identify delivery risks early and drive issues to resolution rather than simply reporting status.

  • Ensure client and HIKE2 stakeholders have clear visibility into project health, decisions, risks, and next steps.

  • Partner with technical leads to translate technical work into an executable project plan and clear client communication.

  • Escalate issues through the PMO and delivery leadership when additional support or decisions are required

Requirements

  • 5+ years of project or program management experience, with significant experience leading data, analytics, cloud, or data platform implementations.

  • Demonstrated experience managing technical engineering teams and complex technical workstreams.

  • Demonstrated ability and willingness to continuously deepen technical knowledge across Databricks, modern data architecture, cloud platforms, analytics, and emerging AI/ML capabilities."

  • Strong working knowledge of Jira and Agile delivery practices.

  • Experience with Databricks strongly preferred; experience with comparable modern cloud data platforms may be considered.

  • Ability to understand technical architecture, engineering terminology, dependencies, and delivery sequencing.

  • Ability to translate those complex technical concepts into business terms for non-technical audiences

  • Strong client-facing communication and executive-level status reporting skills.

  • Comfortable operating in fast-moving projects where requirements, technical decisions, and priorities evolve.

  • Strong ownership mindset with the ability to move between detailed project execution and broader project health.

This role requires meaningful experience with data and technical delivery. The Technical PM does not need to be the project's architect or lead engineer, but they must be technically fluent enough to understand what the team is building and how the pieces fit together.

They should be comfortable discussing and managing work involving:

  • Databricks and modern data platforms, including how they support analytics, AI/ML, and GenAI workloads

  • Data engineering and data pipelines

  • ETL/ELT and data integration

  • Data architecture and modeling

  • Cloud data environments

  • Source-to-target mapping and data migration

  • Development, testing, deployment, and environment management

  • Data quality, governance, security, and access

  • Technical dependencies and integration points

  • Agile technical delivery and engineering backlogs

The expectation is that this person can sit in a technical working session, understand what is being discussed, capture the implications for the project, ask intelligent questions, and translate the conversation into actions, risks, dependencies, and Jira work.

What Success Looks Like:

  • Jira accurately reflects the work being performed and provides a reliable view of project status.

  • Weekly Pulse Reports are timely, concise, accurate, and give leadership and the client a clear picture of business outcomes and project health.

  • Risks and blockers are actively managed and escalated early.

  • Project milestones, commitments, and deliverables are consistently met.

  • The technical team can focus on delivery because the project is well organized and decisions, actions, and dependencies are actively managed.

  • Clients experience strong communication, transparency, and confidence in how the project is being led.

  • Projects consistently follow HIKE2 PMO standards and the applicable Databricks/data delivery playbook.

jobs.description:
What you will do:

As an independent contractor, you will be working from home as a freelance transcriptionist and translator, making an accurate text document of the contents of audio, video, typed or handwritten material.

We transcribe oral history interviews (with WWII veterans, women in academia, farmers, midwives…), focus groups, financial forecasts or quarterly reports, tech webinars, commencement addresses, interviews about NGO work, educational reform or health care access, or anything else you could think of, and even occasionally TV shows. We don't do medical transcription.

Who we’re looking for:

  • U.S. Citizens or U.S. Resident Alien as described on IRS form W-9.
  • Bilingual transcriptionists/translators of Spanish and English.
  • Fast and accurate typists (minimum of 80 wpm), who can deliver files on deadline without question.
  • People with a wide range of interests or educational experiences. As the subject matter varies broadly, it’s easier to understand the flow of conversation when you have some context for what is being discussed.

Requirements

  • Strong language, style, and punctuation skills, and the capability and willingness to follow our transcription style manual as well as project-specific instructions.
  • Ability to verify names and terms via brief internet research. Much of the work we do is for archives, so these transcripts will become part of a historical record and need to be of high quality to reflect that permanence.

What you will need

  • A reliable internet connection is a must. ATC sends project files via Dropbox links, so no special FTP setup is necessary.
  • For confidentiality reasons, we require that you use an email address that no one else has access to.
  • Transcripts should be returned to ATC as .doc files. You are not strictly required to use Microsoft Word; you can also use Open Office or some other program that has the capability to save as a .doc file as long as the formatting requirements are met and the functionality of the end product is indistinguishable from a document completed in Word.
  • ATC highly recommends the use of transcription software (such as ExpressScribe) controlled via hotkeys or a foot pedal, and the use of good-quality headphones to cut down on ambient noise while you are transcribing.

How do I get hired as a freelance transcriptionist?

No calls, please. File your online application here and include:

  • Current resume (PDF)
  • Cover letter (PDF)
  • A screenshot of the results from a three-minute typing test on www.typingtest.com (our minimum requirement is 80 wpm with 98% accuracy)

jobs.description:
Our Purpose

At SentinelOne, we are driven by a clear purpose: to give the advantage to those who secure our future. As AI reshapes how organizations build, operate, and innovate, the responsibility to protect them becomes more critical than ever. When you join SentinelOne, your work helps protect global enterprises, critical infrastructure, and the technologies shaping tomorrow. If you are motivated by meaningful challenges and want your impact to be real, measurable, and global, you will find purpose here.

About Us

SentinelOne is a company at the intersection of AI and security, pioneering a new operating model for cybersecurity. Our AI-native platform unifies protection across endpoint, cloud, identity, data, and AI systems to deliver autonomous detection and response with clarity and speed. By combining real-time analytics, intelligent automation, and a unified data foundation, we reduce noise, simplify complexity, and empower security teams to focus on what truly matters.

Our teams are builders, problem-solvers, and innovators committed to shaping the future of security. If you are excited to solve hard problems alongside talented, mission-driven people, we invite you to help us build a safer future for humanity.

What Are We Looking For?

We’re looking for people who are relentlessly curious and committed to continuous learning. AI is reshaping every function across our business, and we enable every team member, regardless of role or level, to build fluency in AI tools and concepts. Those who thrive here actively seek out new solutions, experiment thoughtfully, and apply what they learn to drive better, faster, smarter outcomes.

As a Senior Software Engineer on the Agent Platform team, you will help secure tens of millions of devices across Windows, Linux, and macOS while processing billions of security events every day as part of SentinelOne’s Endpoint Protection product line.

We are looking for an excellent software engineer with a reliability-first mindset who thrives on solving complex distributed systems challenges in production and turning those learnings into durable platform improvements and long-term engineering ownership.

You’ll help drive customer-critical incident response across the Agent Platform, rapidly build context across multiple platform services, and partner with engineering teams to continuously improve the platform’s reliability, operability, and scalability as a whole.

You will build and evolve the high-throughput, highly available services responsible for policy, configuration, and command distribution to millions of agents worldwide, while contributing to the agent platform protocols that enable other SentinelOne teams to deliver new security capabilities safely and at scale.

This role offers broad technical ownership, the opportunity to work across service boundaries, and the ability to influence the design and reliability of critical platform capabilities used throughout the Agent Platform at SentinelOne. You’ll solve some of the company’s most complex production challenges while helping shape the future of our platform.

What Will You Do?

Primary responsibilities include:

  • Drive rapid response to customer-critical incidents by diagnosing, triaging, and resolving complex production issues that span multiple services across the Agent Platform.
  • Lead systematic root-cause analysis and translate incident learnings into durable reliability, scalability, observability, and operability improvements.
  • Quickly build a systems-level understanding of unfamiliar services and codebases, collaborating closely with engineering teams to resolve complex cross-service issues.
  • Design, develop, test, document, deploy, and operate large-scale, high-volume, low-latency distributed systems processing millions of events per second.
  • Understand, maintain, and continuously improve existing services through refactoring, feature development, and architectural enhancements.
  • Maintain application stability and data integrity by monitoring key metrics, improving operational visibility, and continuously strengthening the codebase.
  • Translate business and functional requirements into robust, scalable, and operable technical solutions.
  • Partner closely with engineering teams across SentinelOne to solve cross-functional problems, influence technical direction, and deliver solutions that scale.
  • Continuously evaluate and adopt technologies that improve the platform’s scalability, reliability, and operational excellence.

Your Toolkit

  • Our backend services are primarily developed in Java, with Go and Python also playing important roles.
  • We use gRPC, REST, GraphQL, and Kafka for service communication.
  • Our data layer includes Redis, PostgreSQL, Cassandra, ClickHouse, and our own columnar time-series database.
  • Our services run across multiple AWS and GCP regions on Kubernetes, using Docker, GitHub, and ArgoCD.
  • We provide engineers with modern AI-powered tools to improve both engineering productivity and software quality.

What Skills and Knowledge Will You Bring?

Ideal candidates will have:

  • 5+ years of professional backend software engineering experience with deep expertise in at least one of Java, Go, or Python, and the willingness to work across all three as needed.
  • A reliability-first mindset with a proven ability to solve complex production incidents, perform systematic root-cause analysis, and implement durable engineering solutions that prevent recurrence.
  • Demonstrated ability to quickly understand unfamiliar distributed systems, navigate large codebases, and troubleshoot complex failures across service boundaries.
  • Strong hands-on experience designing, building, and operating large-scale distributed systems, with a deep understanding of failure modes, performance trade-offs, resilience patterns, and operational excellence.
  • Experience with AWS, GCP, or similar cloud platforms, as well as Docker, Helm, and Kubernetes.
  • Experience with messaging systems and data platforms such as Kafka, PostgreSQL, Redis, Cassandra, ClickHouse, or similar technologies.
  • Excellent communication and collaboration skills, with the ability to work effectively across engineering teams, Product, Technical Account Managers, and other stakeholders, influence technical direction, and mentor fellow engineers.
  • A high degree of ownership, autonomy, curiosity, and the ability to drive ambiguous technical problems to successful outcomes.
  • Experience in an enterprise SaaS or cybersecurity software company is highly desirable.

Why SentinelOne?

AI is redefining how the world operates and rewriting the rules of security in real time, and SentinelOne was built for this moment. From day one, we architected an AI-native platform designed to operate at machine speed, not as an add-on to legacy systems but as the foundation itself. If you want to build where innovation and impact move together, this is that place.

We invest in our Sentinels with comprehensive, competitive benefits designed to support you and your family:

Our goal is simple: bring in someone who can jump in, take ownership of our growth engine, and take Folqs to the next level.

What you'll own

  • Paid media: Own and scale Meta as the primary acquisition channel, with additional experience across Google and/or TikTok Paid
  • Creative strategy: Identify winning customer angles, hooks, messaging, formats, and concepts based on performance data and customer research

  • AI: Use AI aggressively to accelerate research, creative ideation, scripting, production, analysis, and workflows

What success looks like

We don't measure activity; we measure results. This is a 100% performance role focused on scaling spend while maintaining CAC ceiling.

Success means:

  • Scaling paid spend while maintaining healthy unit economics
  • Improving ROAS and reducing CPA
  • Increasing creative win rate and testing velocity
  • Finding new winning angles and audiences
  • Improving conversion rates across the funnel
  • Building a repeatable creative and media-buying system

You are

  • 4–6+ years of experience creating performance creatives for D2C/eCommerce brands or eCommerce agencies (not B2B, not a generalist)
  • A proven Meta media buyer who has personally scaled campaigns, not just overseen them (at least $50k/month in ad spend)
  • Equally strong on creative strategy and performance marketing
  • Deeply experienced with direct-response advertising and customer psychology
  • Able to look at an ad account, creative performance, and funnel data and immediately identify what needs to change
  • Experienced scaling DTC/eCommerce brands - not B2B, SaaS, lead generation, or general marketing
  • Hands-on with creative: you can write or heavily edit hooks, scripts, headlines, briefs, and landing page copy
  • Experienced managing creative production with UGC creators, editors, and designers
  • An operator, not a consultant. You don't just make recommendations - you execute, test, learn, and scale
  • Comfortable working directly with founders and taking significant ownership with minimal hand-holding
  • AI-native: you use AI daily to accelerate research, creative development, analysis, and execution
  • Fast-moving, highly analytical, and obsessed with finding what works

  • Experience with Outbrain or Taboola
  • Experience with tools such as Triple Whale, Northbeam, Motion, Foreplay, or similar

Important: Who this role is NOT for

We want someone who can walk into an eCommerce brand, look at the numbers and the creative, figure out what's broken, and start making it better immediately.

About Stripe

Stripe is a financial infrastructure platform for businesses. The Link Partnerships team sources, develops, and manages relationships with the payments ecosystem partners that power Link, Stripe's consumer wallet. Our team drives the growth and utility of Link by building partnerships with card networks, card issuers, local payment methods, crypto providers, and emerging commerce platforms. We execute on high-impact, cross-functional initiatives that expand Link's acceptance, improve performance, and enable new payment experiences—including agentic commerce. These partnerships have a significant impact on Stripe and the products used by millions of our users.

What you’ll do

We're looking for a Partner Development Manager who builds and manages Link's payments partnerships with card networks, card issuers, local payment method providers, and crypto and stablecoin providers. You'll own the strategy and execution of partnerships that expand Link's payment capabilities, improve transaction performance, and position Link as the default payments layer for agentic commerce. You'll negotiate commercial agreements, drive technical integrations, and shape Link's payments roadmap in collaboration with these partners. As part of these efforts, you'll collaborate closely with cross-functional stakeholders, including Product, Engineering, Legal, Finance, Risk, and others. You'll also lead relationship management and partner closely with external partners' executive leadership.

You're a skilled dealmaker and a strategist by nature. You understand how to work closely with Product and Engineering teams and can formulate partner strategies that drive tangible and measurable results.   • Experience building a new partnership category or vertical from zero—defining the strategy, establishing first partnerships, and scaling the program

Who we are

Samsara (NYSE: IOT) is the pioneer of the Connected Operations™ Cloud, which is a platform that enables organizations that depend on physical operations to harness Internet of Things (IoT) data to develop actionable insights and improve their operations. At Samsara, we are helping improve the safety, efficiency and sustainability of the physical operations that power our global economy. Representing more than 40% of global GDP, these industries are the infrastructure of our planet, including agriculture, construction, field services, transportation, and manufacturing — and we are excited to help digitally transform their operations at scale.

Working at Samsara means you’ll help define the future of physical operations and be on a team that’s shaping an exciting array of product solutions, including Video-Based Safety, Vehicle Telematics, Apps and Driver Workflows, and Equipment Monitoring. As part of a recently public company, you’ll have the autonomy and support to make an impact as we build for the long term.

About this role:

Renewals are the heartbeat of Samsara’s long-term success. As a Renewals Account Executive for our Canadian Mid-Market segment, you will lead the commercial strategy for a portfolio of 50–75 high-value accounts per quarter. This is a high-impact role where you will be responsible for securing favourable renewal terms while minimizing financial attrition, identifying growth opportunities, passing findings and insights back to the business, and closing 36-month renewal deals.

Your mission is to balance efficiency with high-touch strategic negotiation, ensuring our Canadian customers continue to see Samsara as their "source of truth" and long term partner for physical operations.

You should apply if:

  • You want to impact the industries that run our world: Your efforts result in real-world impact—helping to keep the lights on, get food into grocery stores, and ensure workers return home safely. You have an innate curiosity about how businesses work, whether you’re diving into the inner workings of a food distribution center or a waste management firm to understand how our technology makes them better.
  • You thrive in a competitive arena and play to win: You aren't intimidated by a "save" cycle; you lean into it. You are a creative thinker who can confidently advocate for a customer’s resources at time of renewal and prove why Samsara remains their best-in-class partner. You expect to win because you believe in our value, and you have the grit to defend our footprint against any competitor.
  • You are a Master of Prioritization: You know how to triage a book of business, while dedicating deep strategic work to your six-figure "anchor" accounts. You take pride in a clean forecast, and know that deal execution is an essential part of hitting your numbers.
  • You are a Value Architect who builds genuine relationships: You don’t just "process" a contract; you re-confirm the business case. You build trust quickly, and you can articulate ROI to a CFO or operational value to a Fleet Manager with equal fluency.
  • You can navigate internal complexity to win as a team: You recognize that sales is a team sport. You are comfortable collaborating with Deal Desk, Legal, and Finance to navigate custom terms and "get to yes" on agreements, all while sharing best practices to help the broader team succeed.
  • You want to be with the best: You thrive in a high-performance culture where you are surrounded by top-tier talent. You are looking for a role that challenges you to go farther than you have before, moving with urgency and a growth mindset to secure the revenue that fuels Samsara’s mission.

In this role, you will:

  • Own the Canadian Mid-Market: Act as the primary commercial lead for a portfolio of 50–75 renewals per quarter. You will manage high-touch accounts ranging from $25k to $300k+, serving as a dedicated expert on the Canadian business landscape, local competitors, and regional market trends.
  • Drive Full-Cycle Commercial Execution: Lead every stage of the renewal process, from initial quoting and complex negotiations to securing internal approvals. You will prioritize 36-month terms to stabilize the partnership and maximize long-term Lifetime Value (LTV).
  • Forecast with Precision: Maintain impeccable Salesforce hygiene to ensure your pipeline is a "single source of truth." You will provide leadership with scenario forecasting, clear visibility into territory risks, and data-driven insights that make your outcomes predictable.
  • Strategize Across the Account Team: Partner seamlessly with CSMs and AEs to map out expansion opportunities. You will bridge the gap between retention and growth, identifying expansion opportunities while ensuring a frictionless, unified experience for the customer.
  • Operate as a Business Owner: Take full accountability for your territory’s health. You don't just manage a list; you proactively solve for churn, advocate for the needs of the Canadian market, and lean into the "owner" mindset to hit and exceed your retention targets.

Minimum requirements for this role:

  • Experience: 2+ years of full-cycle closing or strategic renewals experience, specifically managing Mid-Market or Commercial accounts.
  • Commercial acumen: Proven track record of managing $1M+ in quarterly quota with deal sizes above $100k
  • Canadian Market Context: Experience navigating the Canadian business landscape (familiarity with regional industries like transport, construction, or field services is a plus).
  • Negotiation Prowess: Ability to manage multi-stakeholder "save" cycles and handle complex procurement/legal requirements.
  • Operational Excellence: Expert proficiency in Salesforce and a disciplined approach to pipeline management.

$104,550—$135,300 USD

Total Rewards

At Samsara, we build for the people who keep the global economy moving. We want owners, not passengers, which is why our rewards are designed to fuel high-impact builders. The Media Specialist executes optimization actions, prepares performance reporting, and escalates delivery risks for senior review.

This is a developing practitioner role. The ideal candidate has foundational platform experience in at least one performance media channel, strong attention to detail, and a demonstrated interest in building channel depth. Experience in a financial institution, agency, or other regulated marketing environment is preferred but not required.

Campaign Activation and Management (50%)

jobs.excerpt: Who we are.  Newfold Digital is a leading web technology company serving millions of customers globally.
jobs.description:
Who we are.

Newfold Digital is a leading web technology company serving millions of customers globally. Our customers know us through our robust portfolio of brands. We have some of the industry's most prominent and storied go-to-market brands, including Bluehost, HostGator, Domain.com, Network Solutions, Register.com and Web.com. We help customers of all sizes build a digital presence that delivers results. With our extensive product offerings and personalized support, we take pride in collaborating with our customers to serve their online presence needs. The strength of our company lives in the intersection of our people, our customers, and our brands.

About the role:

Security Operations Analyst is responsible for the day-to-day monitoring, analysis, and investigation of security threats across enterprise systems and networks. The role triages and responds to security alerts and incidents, working both independently and in collaboration with senior analysts on known or suspected threats.

The analyst supports incident response, threat intelligence, and forensic analysis activities in alignment with established security best practices and control frameworks. This includes identifying anomalies, escalating issues as appropriate, and contributing to the improvement of detection and response processes.

Security Operations Analysts may work shifts and participate in on-call rotations to support global operations and ensure continuous security monitoring coverage.

What you’ll do & how you’ll make your mark:

  • Develop and deliver security reports and metrics to support operational awareness and leadership decision-making.

  • Identify and support mitigation of information security risks, including evaluating projects and initiatives for alignment with security requirements, policies, and standards.

  • Support internal and external audits by collecting and analyzing evidence, assessing control effectiveness, and ensuring adherence to established security frameworks and policies.

  • Track and manage remediation activities, including corrective action plans and audit findings, ensuring timely resolution of identified security issues.

  • Identify, investigate, and respond to security incidents, including analyzing root cause and impact to contain threats and reduce organizational risk.

  • Maintain and support security tools, controls, and monitoring capabilities to ensure effective detection and response.

  • Develop, implement, and continuously improve threat-informed detections and automated response playbooks, including use case development, rule creation, tuning, validation, and optimization through incident feedback and testing.

  • Monitor systems and security telemetry for violations, vulnerabilities, and anomalous activity.

  • Analyze and apply threat intelligence to enhance detection, response, and situational awareness.

  • Identify and support onboarding and validation of security telemetry to ensure effective detection and visibility.

  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams to support incident response, remediation, and security improvements.

  • Assist in the evaluation and selection of security technologies and solutions to support detection, monitoring, and response capabilities.

Who you are & what you’ll need to succeed:

  • A degree in Cybersecurity, Information Technology, Computer Science, or related field is desirable.

  • Industry-recognized certifications are a plus and may include: CompTIA Security+ or CySA+, Microsoft SC-200, GIAC Security Essentials (GSEC), GIAC Certified Incident Handler (GCIH), GIAC Certified Intrusion Analyst (GCIA), GIAC Cyber Threat Intelligence (GCTI), GIAC Security Operations Certified (GSOC), Certified Information Systems Security Professional (CISSP), Certified Information Security Manager (CISM), and relevant cloud or security vendor certifications (e.g., SIEM, SOAR, endpoint, or cloud security platforms).

  • 5-7 years of experience in security operations or related disciplines. with demonstrated expertise in security analysis and incident response.

  • Working knowledge of security controls including access control, authentication, encryption, system integrity, and logging as applied to security monitoring and detection.

  • Experience with security operations including monitoring, incident response, and incident management procedures, with the ability to investigate, escalate, and respond to security events.

  • Ability to develop, modify, and maintain threat detection rules within SIEM platforms, including tuning alerts and improving detection fidelity.

  • Understanding of security telemetry, including log collection and ingestion (e.g., syslog, Windows Event Forwarding, ELK), normalization, and data quality considerations to support effective detection and visibility.

  • Strong knowledge of operating systems (Windows, Linux, macOS), identity systems (e.g., Active Directory), and network fundamentals (TCP/IP, DNS) as they relate to security monitoring and investigation.

  • Experience with endpoint, network, and host-based security tools including EDR, IDS/IPS, firewalls, vulnerability scanners, and host-based detection/prevention systems.

  • Ability to analyze and correlate data across multiple security and telemetry sources to identify patterns, anomalies, vulnerabilities, and potential security threats.

  • Experience applying security frameworks such as MITRE ATT&CK to map adversary behaviors and support detection and response development.

  • Experience with malware analysis, network forensics, and digital forensics concepts and tools; reverse engineering skills are a plus.

  • Ability to assess security threats and implement timely mitigations under pressure.

  • Experience using scripting languages such as Python, PowerShell, or equivalent to support automation, analysis, and response activities.

  • Strong collaboration and communication skills with the ability to build effective relationships across technical and non-technical teams.

  • Experience with security platforms and tools including SIEM, SOAR, EDR, vulnerability management, and threat intelligence tools (e.g., Google SecOps/Chronicle, Microsoft Defender for Endpoint, SentinelOne Singularity, Tanium Threat Response, Recorded Future).

  • Experience with cloud security monitoring and native security services across AWS, Azure, Google Cloud, or OCI is a plus.

Position Summary

The Maintenance AI Technology Training Specialist is responsible for developing, delivering and continuously improving enterprise-wide training programs that accelerate adoption of digital maintenance tools, mobile technology and AI-supported troubleshooting across Newell Brands manufacturing sites globally.

Building on deep, hands-on maintenance expertise, this individual designs curricula tailored to adult learners on the shop floor and delivers instruction in person and remotely across North American and international sites. As the enterprise subject-matter authority on digital maintenance practices, the Global Training Lead partners with technicians, maintenance leaders and ERA/IT teams to drive measurable improvements in equipment uptime, work order quality and first-time-fix rates.

Responsibilities:

Curriculum Design & Adult Learning

  • Design, develop and maintain a structured maintenance digitization curriculum — including course outlines, learning objectives, assessments and job aids — grounded in adult learning principles (e.g., experiential, competency-based instruction).
  • Create and update quick-reference guides, e-learning modules and blended learning materials that translate complex digital tool workflows into practical, shop-floor-ready instruction.
  • Continuously evaluate and improve training content based on learner feedback, adoption metrics and evolving tool capabilities.
  • Adapt delivery formats and instructional approaches to diverse learner populations, including frontline technicians, lead technicians and maintenance supervisors.

Training Delivery — In Person & Remote

  • Deliver instructor-led training on-site at manufacturing facilities globally, including hands-on, shift-integrated coaching sessions.
  • Facilitate virtual instructor-led training via video conferencing platform for remote sites and follow-up reinforcement sessions.
  • Provide real-time floor coaching to reinforce skills immediately after formal training, bridging the gap between classroom instruction and day-to-day practice.

Global Travel & Site Support

  • Travel globally (estimated 50% annually) to support site deployments, conduct in-person training and assess adoption health — including travel internationally as the program expands.
  • Serve as the on-site training authority during go-live periods, providing sustained presence and support through the critical adoption window.
  • Develop site-specific training plans that account for shift schedules, language considerations and local maintenance practices.

Digital & AI Tool Enablement

  • Train maintenance teams on tablets, mobile devices, CMMS platforms, digital work order workflows and AI-supported diagnostic tools, including image-based troubleshooting.
  • Serve as a primary liaison between ERA, IT, and site maintenance teams to ensure training content reflects current tool configurations and release updates.
  • Identify capability gaps and design targeted intervention programs to close them efficiently.

Adoption Measurement & Continuous Improvement

  • Define and track leading training indicators — learner completion, assessment scores, tool utilization rates and work order quality metrics — to demonstrate training effectiveness.
  • Provide structured feedback to ERA and enterprise product teams on usability, tool gaps and enhancement opportunities observed during training delivery.
  • Capture and codify lessons learned, success stories and site-specific best practices to build a reusable training knowledge base scalable across the enterprise.
  • Contribute to regional and global maintenance excellence forums to share best practices and inform program direction.

Qualifications:

Education & Experience

  • Required: High school diploma or equivalent; technical certification or trade school credential strongly preferred.
  • Required: 5+ years of hands-on maintenance experience in a manufacturing or industrial environment, with demonstrated proficiency in equipment troubleshooting and end-to-end maintenance processes.
  • Required: 2+ years of experience training or teaching adult learners in a manufacturing, technical or industrial setting — including development of training materials and facilitation of structured learning sessions.
  • Required: Demonstrated experience developing and executing training curricula or instructional programs specifically designed for adult learners (e.g., competency-based training, on-the-job training frameworks, blended learning programs).

Delivery & Communication Skills

  • Proven ability to deliver effective instruction both in person on the plant floor and via remote/virtual platform.
  • Strong facilitation skills — able to engage mixed-experience audiences, manage group dynamics and adapt delivery pace and depth in real time.
  • Ability to translate complex technical concepts into clear, practical guidance accessible to frontline technicians.
  • Comfort presenting to and collaborating with maintenance leadership and cross-functional stakeholders.

Technical & Digital Proficiency

  • Proficiency with tablets, mobile devices and standard productivity applications; ability to quickly learn and teach new digital tools.
  • Familiarity with AI-enabled diagnostic tools or strong aptitude and curiosity for rapidly adopting emerging technologies.

Travel & Mobility

  • Ability and willingness to travel globally — approximately 50% annually — to manufacturing sites across North America and internationally as the program expands.
  • Valid passport or ability to obtain one.

Leadership & Professional Capabilities

  • Proven track record of driving change in a peer or coaching capacity — influencing adoption without formal authority.
  • Continuous improvement mindset with a bias toward scalable, practical solutions.

Instacart's Strategic Finance team partners across the business to drive disciplined growth and long-term value creation. As Director, Strategic Finance – Consolidation, you will own this responsibility and sit at the center of our financial ecosystem — integrating inputs from Accounting, other parts of StratFin, Business Operations teams, Investor Relations, and more — into one coherent, reconciled, and forward-looking view of the company.

This is a high-visibility role at the heart of Instacart's financial governance. Reporting to the Vice President of Investor Relations and Strategic Finance, you will be the architect of our consolidated P&L forecast, our long-range financial model, and the financial narratives that inform our Board, investors, and executive team. As Instacart continues to mature as a public company, this function is foundational to how we govern the business and tell our financial story.

The ideal candidate is a rigorous financial operator and natural integrator — someone who sees the forest, not just the trees. You know how to land the quarter while simultaneously anticipating what's around short-, medium-, and long-term corners. You consolidate narratives and key business insights across teams into a single, coherent point of view. You earn the trust of senior stakeholders through consistently high-quality work, lead a high-performing team, and set the bar for what great looks like.

Own the consolidated financial view

  • A single, reconciled consolidated P&L forecast is in place and trusted — integrating inputs from the broader StratFin team, Accounting, Business Operations, Investor Relations and more.
  • The monthly and quarterly close cycle runs on time and at executive-quality standards, with variance analysis and management reporting packages that connect results to business drivers — not just numbers on a page.
  • A GAAP and non-GAAP long-range financial model (5-year) reflects current strategy and updated assumptions, with scenario analysis that helps leadership anticipate what's around the corner.
  • The annual budgeting process is orchestrated end-to-end, with company-level targets set clearly and cross-functional alignment secured.

Be the financial narrator for Instacart's story

  • Board decks, investor materials, and quarterly business review packages are delivered consistently — accurate, insightful, and requiring minimal revision from senior leadership.
  • Our weekly consolidated P&L outlook is a trusted executive staple, surfacing not just what happened, but what it means and what's coming.
  • Cross-team narratives and business insights are synthesized into a single, coherent point of view — so leadership always knows where the business stands and what decisions need to be made.

Build the infrastructure that makes it all scalable

  • Internal capital allocation decisions are timely, organized and effective — providing financial frameworks to seamlessly align and execute key business decisions.

Grow the team and raise the bar

Reddit is a community of communities. It’s built on shared interests, passion, and trust, and is home to the most open and authentic conversations on the internet. Every day, Reddit users submit, vote, and comment on the topics they care most about. With 100,000+ active communities and approximately 130 million daily active unique visitors, Reddit is one of the internet’s largest sources of information. For more information, visit .

About the Team

Reddit's developer ecosystem is one of the biggest opportunities to make Reddit more useful, expressive, extensible, and valuable. Today, most people who build on Reddit are developers: they write code, use Devvit, work with APIs, and ship apps or games through a relatively technical workflow. That ecosystem is growing quickly and remains critical.

But the future is bigger than developers alone. AI-assisted building is changing who can create software. The next generation of Reddit apps, games, tools, community agents, content formats, and workflows should be buildable by many more people: developers, technically curious creators, moderators, community builders, game designers, data partners, and eventually people who can describe what they want without needing to code it by hand.

The Developer Ecosystem team owns the product systems that help this broader set of builders discover opportunities, create successfully, launch high-quality apps and games, reach the right users and communities, adopt new platform capabilities, and keep improving after launch. This includes surfaces and systems like developers.reddit.com, AI-assisted creation, app review, developer and creator onboarding, app marketplace experiences, platform capabilities, best practices, and support for emerging creator categories.

About the Role

We are looking for a Staff Product Manager to lead Reddit's Builder Ecosystem product strategy. This person will define the roadmap for how Reddit moves from a developer-only ecosystem to a broader builder ecosystem where AI-assisted and no-code creation become first-class parts of the platform.

The role spans developer growth, creator onboarding, AI-assisted building, app quality, ecosystem incentives, platform capabilities, app marketplace strategy, operational tooling, feature adoption, and new builder categories.

This is a high-ambiguity platform role with direct business, product, and community impact. The right PM will be able to bridge two worlds: they should understand the needs of serious developers and platform engineers, while also having strong conviction that Reddit can unlock a much larger wave of builders by making creation more accessible, guided, AI-native, and outcome-oriented.

What You'll Do

  • Define the product strategy for Reddit's Developer Ecosystem, including the transition from code-first developers to a broader base of AI-assisted creators.
  • Own the roadmap for developers.reddit.com as the primary builder portal, including onboarding, docs, app management, analytics, review status, feature access, education, examples, templates, and AI-assisted creation entry points.
  • Lead strategy for AI-assisted app creation, including prompt-to-app workflows, AI building tools, no-code or low-code experiences, reusable templates, generated scaffolds, and systems that help creators turn ideas into useful Reddit-native apps.
  • Build the product approach for an App Marketplace that helps users, moderators, communities, and internal teams discover high-quality apps, games, agents, tools, and community experiences.
  • Improve app review and ecosystem operations through tooling, automation, and AI-assisted workflows, including LLM-powered app review, policy checks, quality signals, and reviewer efficiency.
  • Partner with Engineering to prioritize core platform capabilities and performance improvements such as webhooks, webviews, APIs, SDKs, tooling, observability, and other primitives builders need to create reliable apps.
  • Drive more successful, retentive, and popular apps and games by identifying best practices, improving templates, shaping incentives, and creating clearer paths from idea to launch to growth.
  • Identify and support new creator and developer categories
  • Partner with internal teams such as Contribution, Community Builders, Games, Search, Recommendations, Safety, and Ads to help them launch new functionality through the developer ecosystem.
  • Define and improve feature adoption programs so builders understand, test, and successfully use new platform capabilities.
  • Work with developer relations to establish the measurement system for the ecosystem, including weekly active developers/creators, NPS/CSAT, app launches, app retention and more
  • Create clear frameworks for when Reddit should build platform primitives, launch templates, fund builders, partner with external teams, promote apps, or shut down low-quality or low-trust ecosystem behavior.
  • Lead cross-functional alignment across Product, Engineering, DevRel, Community, Data, Safety, Legal, Policy, Support, BD, and senior leadership.

What We're Looking For

  • Experience leading high-ambiguity platform, developer ecosystem, creator ecosystem, marketplace, gaming, AI tooling, or developer experience products.
  • Strong product judgment for creation platforms: understanding what makes a platform powerful for advanced developers, approachable for new creators, trustworthy for communities, and worth sustained investment.
  • Comfort with code, APIs, developer tools, technical platform tradeoffs, and engineering conversations, paired with strong conviction that AI-assisted and no-code creation will expand who can build on Reddit.
  • Ability to reason across multiple sides of the ecosystem: developers, creators, users, moderators, communities, internal teams, partners, and Reddit's business priorities.
  • Experience improving developer or creator onboarding, docs, portals, SDKs, APIs, marketplaces, app review, app distribution, AI creation tools, or app-building workflows.
  • Strong analytical judgment and comfort defining metrics for ecosystem health, builder productivity, app quality, retention, distribution, and business impact.
  • Ability to partner deeply with Engineering on platform capabilities, performance, reliability, primitives, observability, and build-vs-buy decisions.
  • Strong product sense for apps, games, agents, content creation tools, community-native experiences, and the kinds of lightweight software that should exist inside Reddit communities.
  • Comfort working with AI-assisted creation tools, LLM-based workflows, prompt-to-app systems, or other emerging ways of helping more people build software.

jobs.description:
About 2070 Health

2070 Health is India's first venture studio, established by W Health Ventures. It builds healthcare companies from scratch by identifying gaps in the market that remain unserved. Unlike an accelerator, the studio is directly involved in idea generation, daily operations, and strategic decisions as each company grows. Companies established in the last 24 months include Elevate Now, Nivaan Care, Reveal Healthtech, BabyMD, Everhope Oncology, and Everbright Health.

About the role

The Growth and Outreach role is responsible for running the studio's outbound engine end to end. This is not a standard SDR position. The role covers AI-assisted outreach across email and LinkedIn, with ownership of every component: data, sending infrastructure, copy, testing, and results.

This is a non-client-facing role. It builds and runs the outbound engine. Booked conversations and any client, customer, or investor relationships are handled by the research and investment teams, not by this role.

End-to-end experience required

This role requires hands-on experience across the entire outbound workflow. Candidates who have owned only individual parts of the process, with other functions or agencies handling the remainder, are not suited to this position. The workflow, owned end to end, includes the following.

  • Data sourcing. Building target lists from a defined ICP rather than inherited or purchased lists.
  • Data enrichment and hygiene. Verifying, deduplicating, and completing records.
  • Sending infrastructure. Setting up domains, mailboxes, warmup, and sending limits, whether directly or through a platform such as Instantly, with a clear understanding of how each functions.
  • Deliverability. Diagnosing and resolving bounces, spam placement, and declines in reply rates.
  • Copywriting. Producing cold emails that generate replies from a US audience, without reliance on mail-merge.
  • Campaign execution. Running multi-touch sequences across email and LinkedIn, including follow-ups.
  • Measurement and optimization. Tracking performance, running tests, and improving reply rates and meetings booked.

This experience must be current and hands-on, not drawn from a role held several years ago.

Scope of work

The role supports two use cases.

1. New thesis research and early sales. Working with the research team to test new company ideas in healthcare. This involves identifying the experts, clinicians, operators, and potential customers worth engaging, running outreach to book those conversations, and returning the resulting signal in a form the team can act on.

2. Fund outreach. Expanding the fund's relationships through researched, personalized outreach to downstream investors and potential LPs, including building and maintaining target lists, running sequences, and managing follow-up.

Working model

The role operates on a project basis. Deliverables and timelines are defined at the outset, after which the consultant sets priorities independently and reports progress on an agreed cadence. Performance is measured on outcomes rather than daily activity. The role does not include daily task assignment or supervision.

AI fluency

AI fluency is central to this role. The expectation is practical, demonstrated use rather than familiarity. Relevant capabilities include the following.

  • Researching accounts and personalizing outreach at scale using tools such as Claude, rather than generic templates.
  • Building AI steps into the pipeline, for example Clay AI columns or prompt chains, so that repetitive work is automated.
  • Connecting tools through light automation using Zapier, n8n, or custom scripts.
  • Evaluating new tools as they become available and retaining those that add value.
  • Primary tools: Apollo, Clay, Smartlead or Instantly, and a CRM such as HubSpot.

Requirements

Requirements

  • 5 to 7 years of experience, the majority in hands-on cold outreach that booked meetings, with campaigns run directly by the candidate.
  • A record of owning a metric such as reply rate, meetings booked, or pipeline, with accountability for the outcome rather than task completion.
  • Direct experience at an early-stage company where outreach was owned as a sole function. Additional experience at a larger, more structured organization is an advantage, as it indicates exposure to outreach at scale.
  • Experience running outreach to US prospects, with the ability to write for that audience.
  • Strong written English, producing cold emails that read as though written by a person.
  • The ability to learn quickly, given limited ramp-up time.
  • Healthcare experience is an advantage but not a requirement.

This role is not a fit if

  • Campaign experience is limited to data, sending infrastructure, and copy prepared by others.
  • Daily direction and task management are required to remain productive.
  • Outreach experience is several years old and has since given way to a management role rather than direct execution.
  • Only parts of the workflow described above have been performed, with the remainder to be learned on the job.
  • Experience comes from a large organization in which separate teams owned each stage of the process and only one stage was owned directly.

jobs.description:
We're transforming the grocery industry

At Instacart, we invite the world to share love through food because we believe everyone should have access to the food they love and more time to enjoy it together. Where others see a simple need for grocery delivery, we see exciting complexity and endless opportunity to serve the varied needs of our community. We work to deliver an essential service that customers rely on to get their groceries and household goods, while also offering safe and flexible earnings opportunities to Instacart Personal Shoppers.

Instacart has become a lifeline for millions of people, and we’re building the team to help push our shopping cart forward. If you’re ready to do the best work of your life, come join our table.

Instacart is a Flex First team

There’s no one-size fits all approach to how we do our best work. Our employees have the flexibility to choose where they do their best work—whether it’s from home, an office, or your favorite coffee shop—while staying connected and building community through regular in-person events. Learn more about our flexible approach to where we work.

Overview

The Advertiser Optimization team is the decision-making engine of Instacart's $1B+ ads business. We own the systems responsible for Bidding, Pacing, Budgeting, and Targeting: converting stated advertiser goals into real-time auction actions. Our mission is to maximize realized Advertiser Value by deciding when to participate, how much to bid, and how fast to spend, all while balancing User Experience and Platform Revenue.

We are hiring a Senior Applied Scientist II to lead the algorithmic direction of these systems. This is a role for someone who thinks in terms of control theory, constrained optimization, and auction economics, and who can translate those frameworks into production code that makes millions of decisions per day. You will formulate problems from first principles, shape the technical roadmap, and own systems end-to-end from mathematical design through production deployment through impact measurement.

About the Job

  • Design and evolve real-time bid optimization systems that translate advertiser goals (target ROAS, budget constraints) into optimal auction bids under uncertainty. Formulate the bidding problem as constrained optimization and build the feedback mechanisms that keep bids aligned with realized outcomes.
  • Build intelligent budget pacing algorithms that distribute spend across time and auction opportunities. The core challenge: allocating a finite daily budget across stochastic demand while maximizing total value, subject to advertiser constraints and time-varying conversion dynamics.
  • Develop the analytical frameworks that connect bidding, pacing, and budgeting into a coherent optimization objective.
  • Shape auction mechanics including reserve pricing, multi-slot allocation, and bid-to-price mapping. Reason about mechanism design tradeoffs between advertiser outcomes, platform revenue, and marketplace efficiency.
  • Own the full research-to-production loop: diagnose system behavior from large-scale data, formulate hypotheses, design experiments, ship production code, and measure impact. Write technical strategy documents that set the algorithmic direction for the team.

About You

Minimum Qualifications

  • Graduate degree (Masters or PhD) in operations research, applied mathematics, control systems, computational economics, or a related quantitative field.
  • 8+ years of experience building and deploying optimization or control systems in production environments (not just research prototypes).
  • Strong foundation in at least two of: feedback control theory (PID, MPC), convex and stochastic optimization, auction theory and mechanism design, dynamic programming.
  • Proficiency in one of the following languages: Go, Java, C++ for production systems and Python for data analysis and offline pipelines.
  • Demonstrated ability to translate mathematical formulations into production code that runs at scale (millions of decisions per day, sub-100ms latency constraints).

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience with real-time bidding systems, ad auction optimization, or computational advertising at scale.
  • Background in budget-constrained allocation methods. Experience with adaptive control or model-predictive control in production systems.
  • Familiarity with causal inference and experimental design for evaluating algorithmic changes in marketplace settings.
  • Track record of shaping technical strategy and driving cross-functional alignment between engineering, product, and data science.

We are looking for a SIEM Platform Engineer to design, implement, operate, and continuously improve the security information and event management platforms that support Coalfire’s managed security and compliance services. This role owns the reliability and scalability of SIEM platform capabilities across cloud and high-compliance environments, including log collection, data onboarding, platform health, retention, performance, access, integrations, and operational automation.

The SIEM Platform Engineer partners closely with detection engineering, security operations, cloud engineering, compliance, and client stakeholders. The role ensures that SIEM platforms deliver high-quality, accessible, and appropriately governed security data while supporting continuous monitoring and regulatory requirements such as FedRAMP.

Our Purpose

At SentinelOne, we are driven by a clear purpose: to give the advantage to those who secure our future. As AI reshapes how organizations build, operate, and innovate, the responsibility to protect them becomes more critical than ever. When you join SentinelOne, your work helps protect global enterprises, critical infrastructure, and the technologies shaping tomorrow. If you are motivated by meaningful challenges and want your impact to be real, measurable, and global, you will find purpose here.

About Us

SentinelOne is a company at the intersection of AI and security, pioneering a new operating model for cybersecurity. Our AI-native platform unifies protection across endpoint, cloud, identity, data, and AI systems to deliver autonomous detection and response with clarity and speed. By combining real-time analytics, intelligent automation, and a unified data foundation, we reduce noise, simplify complexity, and empower security teams to focus on what truly matters.

Our teams are builders, problem-solvers, and innovators committed to shaping the future of security. If you are excited to solve hard problems alongside talented, mission-driven people, we invite you to help us build a safer future for humanity.

What Are We Looking For?

We’re looking for people who are relentlessly curious and committed to continuous learning. AI is reshaping every function across our business, and we enable every team member, regardless of role or level, to build fluency in AI tools and concepts. Those who thrive here actively seek out new solutions, experiment thoughtfully, and apply what they learn to drive better, faster, smarter outcomes.

As a Director of Product Management, you will be tasked with owning the strategy, roadmap, and business outcomes for a core segment of SentinelOne's Cloud Security portfolio, which delivers real-time protection, detection, and response across workloads, containers, identities, and data spanning public cloud, private cloud, and hybrid environments. This is a player-coach role in which you will set direction and build and lead a team of product managers while staying close to the market, the data, and the product to make sharp calls under ambiguity. You will serve as the connection between engineering, sales, marketing, and customers, translating market signals into a roadmap that wins deals and a product that customers renew.

What Will You Do?

Primary responsibilities include:

  • Own and evangelize the strategy and vision for your area of the Cloud Security portfolio, grounded in a clear point of view on where the market is heading.
  • Build, lead, and grow a team of product managers; set the bar for the quality of PRDs, roadmaps, pricing/packaging analysis, and customer-facing communication.
  • Maintain the product roadmap and make explicit tradeoff and prioritization calls, with the expectation of saying no to good ideas in service of the few that matter most.
  • Define and report against key business metrics for your product area, including pipeline influence, win/loss trends, retention, and usage, not just feature ship dates.
  • Partner directly with engineering leadership on architecture and sequencing decisions that affect time-to-market and total cost of ownership.
  • Work hand-in-hand with sales, solutions engineering, and marketing to sharpen positioning, train the field, and support strategic deals.
  • Engage directly with customers, prospects, and analysts to pressure-test roadmap assumptions and stay ahead of where the market is moving.
  • Represent Cloud Security in company-wide planning, tying product decisions back to revenue, margin, and competitive positioning.

What Skills and Knowledge Will You Bring?

Ideal candidates will have:

  • 8 or more years in product management at enterprise SaaS or infrastructure companies, including 2 or more years leading and managing other product managers.
  • Direct experience owning a cloud security or cloud-native product (CWPP, CSPM, CNAPP, DSPM, or adjacent), with an understanding of the buyer, the competitive landscape, and the technical tradeoffs, not just the acronyms.
  • Excellent business judgment, including the ability to build a pricing model, read a win/loss report, and connect a roadmap decision to its effect on ARR and margin without a finance partner walking you through it.
  • Working technical fluency with cloud architecture (AWS/Azure/GCP), containers/Kubernetes, and the shared-responsibility model, sufficient to earn credibility with engineering and with technical buyers.
  • A track record of shipping and defending a roadmap in front of skeptical stakeholders, including sales leadership, customers, and engineering counterparts.

jobs.description:
Lead Data Platform Engineer, External Data Analytics

College Board - Technology – InfoSec & Infrastructure

Location: This is a fully remote role. Candidates who live near CB offices have the option of being fully remote or hybrid (Tuesday and Wednesday in office). All CB employees are required to occasionally travel to meet in person for business purposes.

Type: This is a full-time position

About the Team

The External Data Analytics team builds and operates the data platform that powers trusted, timely analytics across College Board's exam and AP Classwork programs, including AP Classwork's continuous, year-round data needs. We're a small, closely knit, cross-functional team (~7 engineers today, and growing) with a mix of data engineering and full-stack backgrounds. We value ownership, thoughtful automation, clear documentation, pragmatic architecture, and keeping students top of mind in everything we build.

About the Opportunity

As the technical lead for the platform, you'll own architecture end-to-end and serve as the final technical authority on the team's hardest problems, operating a level above a senior IC. You'll stay hands-on yourself, writing production infrastructure-as-code and setting the coding standards the team follows, while leading design and implementation across streaming and batch ingestion, curated analytical data products, and reliable data-consumption patterns. Because our immediate priority is AP Classwork analytics, you'll be designing for continuous, steady-state, year-round throughput and long-running data quality, often working through ambiguity as requirements and priorities evolve; not just a single test-day spike.

You will work with contributing domain teams to establish data contracts and ensure data is accurate, governed, secure, and ready for analysis, making and communicating tradeoffs involving scale, performance, reliability, cost, and operational complexity along the way. You'll also set the standard for how the team uses AI-assisted coding responsibly, establishing review practices and guardrails for AI-generated code, and, as a technical anchor for the team, mentor engineers and raise engineering standards across the platform.

In this role, you will:

  • Own the technical direction, architecture, evolution, and reliability of a shared enterprise data and analytics platform, serving as the team's final technical authority and escalation point.
  • Lead the hands-on design and implementation of streaming and batch data pipelines supporting real-time and historical analysis, independently writing production infrastructure-as-code (CDK/TypeScript).
  • Design curated, governed analytical data products that provide consistent and trusted information for reporting and decision-making, including for a continuous, year-round data load rather than single-event spikes.
  • Ensure the platform can scale efficiently while meeting expectations for performance, availability, reliability, and cost, including safe recovery from retries and failures.
  • Establish data contracts with contributing teams, including expectations for schemas, data quality, service levels, and change management.
  • Embed security, access controls, lineage, classification, auditability, monitoring, and operational readiness into the platform.
  • Partner with domain, product, operations, security, and governance stakeholders to translate business and reporting needs into sustainable technical solutions.
  • Lead code and design reviews, set and enforce coding standards, mentor engineers across varying experience levels, and promote strong practices in data engineering, automation, observability, and platform reliability.
  • Establish and enforce responsible AI-assisted coding practices for the team, including reviewing AI-generated code and setting guardrails so AI-assisted development doesn't compromise shared infrastructure.
  • Respond to incidents and drive platform reliability across the team's services.
  • Evaluate emerging tools and architectural patterns and recommend changes when they improve outcomes, simplify operations, or reduce risk.

About You:

You bring experience across the capabilities below. We do not expect candidates to have worked with our exact tool stack for everything; comparable tools and the judgment to map your experience onto ours quickly matter.

  • Strong, current, hands-on coding experience in TypeScript and/or JavaScript with AWS CDK is required. You'll be writing production infrastructure-as-code yourself and setting the coding standards the rest of the team follows from Day 1, not just reviewing architecture from a distance.
  • Demonstrated experience owning, not just contributing to, the technical direction and architecture of a scalable cloud data platform in production; you can point to a specific system you were accountable for end-to-end, built on technologies such as Kinesis, Data Firehose, Flink, Lambda, EventBridge, SNS/SQS, Redshift, Athena, Glue, EMR, S3, DynamoDB, or comparable.
  • Strong experience with analytical data modeling and curated, layered data architectures (e.g., medallion-style), plus monitoring/observability (CloudWatch, Grafana, InfluxDB, or similar) as a core part of platform design.
  • A track record of designing for scalability, performance, cost efficiency, data integrity, and safe recovery from retries or failures; you've personally debugged issues like out-of-order processing, duplicate delivery, or hot partitions in production.
  • Experience establishing data contracts and implementing schema evolution, data quality, access control, classification, lineage, and auditability practices.
  • A strong point of view on how to use AI coding tools responsibly at the team level, able to set guardrails and review standards, not just use the tools personally.
  • Demonstrated success of mentoring engineers, leading code and design reviews, being the escalation point on hard problems, and communicating across technical and nontechnical teams.
  • Helpful but not required: SaaS/multi-tenant or cell-based architecture, DuckDB, ML/AI-enabled analytics tools (e.g., SageMaker), a regulated/high-governance data environment, experience hiring or growing a data team, presenting technical roadmaps to non-technical stakeholders, multi-account AWS at org scale, or familiarity with the education technology domain.

All roles at College Board require:

  • A passion for expanding educational and career opportunities and mission-driven work
  • Curiosity and enthusiasm for emerging technologies, with a willingness to experiment with and adopt new AI-driven solutions and comfort with learning and applying new digital tools independently and proactively.
  • Clear and concise communication skills, written and verbal
  • A learner's mindset and a commitment to growth: welcoming diverse perspectives, giving and receiving timely, respectful feedback, and continuously improving through iterative learning and user input.
  • A drive for impact and excellence: solving complex problems, making data-informed decisions, prioritizing what matters most, and continuously improving through learning, user input, and external benchmarking.
  • A collaborative and empathetic approach: working across differences, fostering trust, and contributing to a culture of shared success
  • Authorization to work in the United States

About Our Process

  • Application review will begin immediately and will continue until the position is filled. This role is expected to accept applications for a minimum of 5 business days.
  • While the hiring process may vary, it generally includes: resume and application submission, recruiter phone/video screen, hiring manager interview, performance exercise such as live coding, a panel interview, a conversation with leadership and reference checks.

What We Offer

At College Board, we offer more than a paycheck: we provide a meaningful career, a supportive team, and a comprehensive package designed to help you thrive. We’re a self-sustaining nonprofit that believes in fair and competitive compensation grounded in your qualifications, experience, impact, and the market.

A Thoughtful Approach to Compensation

  • The hiring range for this role is $185,000–$200,000.
  • Your exact salary will depend on your location, experience, and how your background compares to others in similar roles at the College Board.
  • We aim to make our best offer upfront, rooted in fairness, transparency, and market data.
  • We adjust salaries by location to ensure fairness, no matter where you live.

You’ll have open, transparent conversations about compensation, benefits, and what it’s like to work at College Board throughout your hiring process. Check out our careers page for more.

jobs.description:
About the Role

Together AI runs one of the largest GPU fleets in the world. The Infra Agent Systems team builds the software systems that power and automate that infrastructure.

We develop production AI agents that diagnose hardware failures, investigate incidents, correlate signals across the fleet, and automate operational workflows. Alongside these agents, we build the platform they run on, including knowledge graphs, retrieval systems, orchestration frameworks, and developer tooling.

You’ll work across two areas:

Infrastructure Agent Systems — Build production AI agents that help operate our GPU fleet by diagnosing failures, investigating incidents, gathering evidence from live systems, and assisting with remediation. These agents are used every day by our infrastructure and datacenter teams through APIs, CLI, dashboards, and Slack.

Core Agent Platform — Build the platform that powers these agents, including knowledge graphs, search and retrieval, orchestration, evaluation, and the tooling that enables agents to reason, act, and continuously improve.

We’re working on something that hasn’t really been done before: building knowledge graphs and self-improving AI agents that understand, operate, and continuously improve large-scale AI infrastructure.

This is an opportunity to work at the intersection of AI agents, distributed systems, infrastructure, and automation, solving challenging engineering problems with real production impact. There’s an enormous amount to build, learn, and shape as we define the future of autonomous infrastructure.

responsible for delivering the software but also for operating and supporting it in production.

Why this Role

You’ll work on two hard problems at the same time: making AI agents trustworthy enough to operate production infrastructure, and building the knowledge, retrieval, and distributed systems that make those agents effective.

You’ll have the opportunity to build foundational systems from the ground up, work on infrastructure at massive scale, and help define how self-improving AI agents operate real-world AI infrastructure.

Remote based in the UK


Responsibilities

  • Design and build production AI agent systems that diagnose, investigate, and remediate infrastructure issues across one of the world’s largest GPU fleets.
  • Build the distributed services, orchestration framework, knowledge graph, and retrieval systems that power infrastructure agents.
  • Develop fleet intelligence systems that combine telemetry, infrastructure state, operational knowledge, and historical incidents to help agents make better decisions.
  • Integrate with observability, incident management, ticketing, fleet inventory, source control, chat, and internal infrastructure systems through well-designed APIs.
  • Own services end to end, including architecture, implementation, testing, deployment, observability, and production operations.
  • Improve agent performance through evaluations, retrieval improvements, better tools, and production feedback loops.
  • Turn what agents learn in production into reliable, reviewed software and automation.

Requirements

  • 5+ years of experience building production backend systems, distributed systems, or infrastructure platforms.
  • Strong systems design skills and experience owning significant systems from design through production.
  • Depth in at least one of the following:
    • AI agent systems, orchestration, tool use, evaluation, or grounding
    • Knowledge graphs or graph data modeling
    • Search, retrieval, ranking, RAG, or semantic search systems
  • Strong backend engineering experience, including API design, service boundaries, data modeling, and integrations across complex systems.
  • Experience with Kubernetes, GitOps such as ArgoCD, infrastructure-as-code, and cloud platforms.
  • Comfortable working across languages such as Go, TypeScript, Python, or Rust.

Experience in the following is a plus:

  • GPU infrastructure, datacenters, bare-metal systems, hardware failure modes, BMC/IPMI, or cluster schedulers
  • Graph databases
  • Event-driven systems and messaging platforms such as NATS or Kafka
  • Observability platforms such as Prometheus and Grafana
  • Building evaluation frameworks or improving the quality and reliability of LLM-powered systems

About Together AI

Together AI is a research-driven artificial intelligence company. We believe open and transparent AI systems will drive innovation and create the best outcomes for society, and together we are on a mission to significantly lower the cost of modern AI systems by co-designing software, hardware, algorithms, and models. We have contributed to leading open-source research, models, and datasets to advance the frontier of AI, and our team has been behind technological advancement such as FlashAttention, Hyena, FlexGen, and RedPajama. We invite you to join a passionate group of researchers and engineers in our journey in building the next generation AI infrastructure.
